chapters.title: Chapter 3530 Inconceivable! IV
paragraphs: Even as she spread her gems to search for him!
She expended a tremendous amount of her power and authority as she shockingly sought to cover all of the Megalos Ynnere if she had to.
This was a Greater Source Entity!
Even as the Faceless Lifeforms reduced the intensity of their red brilliance on the Map of the Megalos Ynnere, her crimson radiance remained glorious!
She looked at his continued calmness as she continued while her weavings spread out madly.

"We have already been searching the Megalos Ynnere without finding anything this whole time, and it truly seems like you believe it will continue like this. But...have you ever stopped to think that my search so far has been with reservations and restrictions in place?"

"People like you...are always the ones that bring about the greatest pain unto others. You so entirely believe that you are the center of any nearby weavings of existence as, more often than not, you offend those who shouldn't, and it is not just you who pay the price...but others as well. I'm sure you have many more surprises for me that I may even be alarmed at. Do you want to show me one right now before I proceed to tell you what I will do soon?"
She threw the ball to him after monologuing for some time.
She asked him if he had anything to show for his calmness and confidence before she forged ahead!
And Noah looked at her closely as his weavings burned, and he raised his hand as he spoke out languidly.
"You really think you've pegged who I am entirely."
As he spoke.

Within the depths of his weavings, a Crystallized Severed Path Pearl of Lapidekinesis had already formed as his weavings took it into himself- and he even began severing it under the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
Alongside this...
|The Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence burning around 25 Source Complexity Weavings are returning 25 Shards of a Purified Source Pearl every 5 minutes.|
The terrifying flame he opened the pathway of continued to show efficacy and wonder even against enemies more complex than him!
How much longer would they have as these white gold flames continued to burn and eat away at their weavings?
"You spoke of Lapidekinesis. Your pristine Source that you have raised since you were young, right?"
She wanted a surprise. She wanted to be alarmed!
So he looked deeply into her eyes before, in the next moment, his hand began to glimmer with a gloriously gold gem-like appearance.
Severed Weavings of Lapidekinesis erupted from him and exploded into the Infinite Crystal Gem Prison, filling everything with a glorious radiance that was all reflected!
The weavings of a Greater Source Entity were truly not to be underestimated as her prison did not break; anything from within was reflected.
Anything.
Maybe if he had opened up a Pathway to a True Source of Lapidekinesis, it may have been possible.
But after a few seconds, his figure glimmering with bejeweled gem-like radiance looked towards Persephael calmy!
Persephael who at that moment had a blank gaze, her eyes frozen for a moment in genuine stupor before they recovered.
She smiled as from the gems of her eyes, golden tears began to fall.
Her Source.
The Source that she attained with years of hardship and oppression!
This being...displayed it so easily as it seemed entirely genuine. As someone with the Source of Lapidekinesis, she knew it was genuine!
"My goodness. You truly know exactly what to do to push someone over the edge. I thank you for this."
The tears in her eyes stopped falling. She looked straight at him, her eyes burning with contained rage and wisdom within as she nodded!

"I will now tell you a methodology I used to deal with people like you. When you have a unique power others don't and believe many weavings to be rotating around you, you get self-centered. Selfish. One of the major ways I've found to take care of you while drowning you in seas of guilt...is pure destruction. Because what people like you bring is just destruction to all those around you. So my next step to locate you and the Sages hiding within these Megalos...is to simply carry out a cleansing of everything. A Megalocide."
HUUM!
Noah's eyes flashed with interminable brilliance at such a word as Persephael smiled!

"Have you heard of this before? Megalocide. A truly heinous word. A truly heinous action. The Mission does not necessarily require Megalocide, but to achieve it, we knew that some actions like this would be necessary. And for creatures like you, it is perfect. Because you are emotional due to that high arrogance, I want you to feel the weight of your actions. Know that this Megalos Ynnere and all the countless complexities within it- from the wee little Terrestrial creatures, the Constellations, and even the Source Complexity entities here...know that the collapse of their weavings is all on you."
WAA!
After saying this, Persephael rose silently as the burning Faceless Lifeform, who still had their complexity seeping out, lined up behind her!
Her eyes shone with luster as from her crystalline gem-like multicolored wings, more gems continued to emerge from her and spread out as she smiled brilliantly.

"Or you can willingly take away these undeniable flames from us. That's another method for arrogant creatures like you. To have everything put on your plate. A button for you to push to make a simple choice like releasing these flames around us, or choose not to push that button and single-handedly be the root cause of a Megalocide."
Her eyes squinted as she looked at his reaction- or lack of it thereof as she continued!

"At this point in time, someone like you starts to question themselves and wonder if they are just a single moving piece in a vast and intricate complexity they cannot fully fathom. Let me help you in that line of thought and tell you that you are just that. A piece. Movable. Malleable. Breakable. Now, Little Piece, move."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3531 Move! I
paragraphs: A piece of a puzzle.
Movable. Malleable!
Breakable!
Persephael shone with incandescent bejeweled radiance as she stated such shocking words.

"It's causing an eruption of anger within you, is it not? People like you hate to be called chess pieces the most. But at the end of the day, that is truly what you are. There are many out there who have dreams. Countless numbers of beings across these Megalos and the Expanse alone, not to mention the countless others across the Frequencies of the Wheel. Piooners and even those who have attained Sources have dreams. That somehow, they aren't an insignificant smidge of absolutely nothingness in the grand scheme of existence. Many want their existence to matter, to live and accomplish something larger. But in the end, they turn out to be just that. Pieces. Do you know how many Source Complexity entities I have watched with my own eyes collapse their own weavings of existence willingly?"
Source Complexity entities! Collapsing their own weavings of existence!

" It is incredibly hard to die once one attains their source, and the number of years they can live is seemingly endless. Some live for so long and see the same things again and again- they see their irrelevance in the grand scheme of the Wheel as after countless Megalos Cycles, some just choose to....end it."
WAA!

"They collapse their Sources to meet eternal slumber as even this is the ultimate form of release for them. Some I knew personally. They were weak...and feeble at heart as it was a wonder to attain a Source. You, my friend, are similar to them. Give me the Sages, extinguish your flames. Move as a piece should, because if you don't...the pain that comes is too much for you to bear."
She finally stopped talking as her figure filled with gems and jewels floated grandiosely.
Noah looked at her with eyes burning with dignity and regality as he shook his head.
"What a talkative one you are."
She truly was.
She fought mentally as much as she did with authority, but Noah did not care for any of it!
"Do not think that I do not know about you, O Persephael."
HUUUM!
He uttered out her name as stated in the Map of the Megalos Ynerre while his whole body began to change into white gold flames!
"Do not think...that I do not know what you did in that Frequency when you joined hands with the Logos of the Wheel. Do not think the things you do will remain in the dark forever."
He uttered out simple yet shocking words as the bejeweled eyes of Persephael became unfathomably somber!
Her authority began to erupt like a volcano, but in the next moment, from above the Infinite Crystal Gem Prison...three circular singularities appeared.
They held a devilish smile with infinity symbols inscribed on top, and they were all clustered together as in the next moment, they exploded into brilliant weavings of existence.

From, unfathomably solid and real ancient wooden Wheels bloomed- their air vibrating with archaic grandeur as one bloomed horizontally and covered everything for a distance of a single Omniverse, while another erupted vertically and covered the same distance, and another erupted diagonally!
All three bloomed with majesty as when Persephael looked at them, her heart shuddered as she felt like she was looking at something that her Source had been trying to glimpse all her life.
When the Faceless Lifeforms saw it, they felt a sense of danger as dazzling black flames erupted around each of them!
Three dazzling archaic wheels.
In the next moment, they shattered.
They broke along with all their intricate Spokes as it was akin to the breaking of the wheel...three times over!
BOOOM!
The weavings of the explosion were utterly inconceivable as the moment this impact began; gems broke like glass in a small corner of an Infinite Crystal Gem Prison.

Flames of white gold brilliance covered with the Severed Weavings of Lapidekinesis passed through the shattered gaps, a deep voice echoing out in the middle of the explosion while his weavings disappeared!
"Will you have time to do what you want when the weavings you know come crashing down?"
Will Persephael have time?
In the middle of a beginning explosion of multiple Tzar Versepiercers, she was not even able to answer as she only roared out with mad power!
A distance away from the explosion of three Tzar Versepiercers.

The weavings of a Source surrounded by multiple Faceless Lifeforms just so happened to have entered the Megalos Ynnere at this time, his gaze and the gazes of the Faceless Lifeforms behind him changing rapidly as they felt the terrifying weavings of an explosion from a distance.
"What the hell is this? In Megalos that should at most have Pioneers remaining in, why the hell would Sources be fighting with such intensity?"
The father of a certain someone spoke out with incredulity as his weavings buzzed, his gaze already set towards that direction as he was here to track a name.
To find someone involved in his daughter's weavings!
An Entanglement.
And so far, he only had a name.
Noah Osmont!
"You wouldn't happen to be involved in that explosion and make my work real easy, right?"
He muttered while waving his hands to command the Faceless Lifeforms. The father of Barbatos, McAllister, moved ahead!
Around this same time.
Away from the Megalos Ynnere.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
In the space above a radiant stellar black Pantheon known as the Pantheon of Bloodvista, the Megalos tore apart as rows of entities emanating the weavings of Pioneers stepped in one by one.
Behind them...the allure of Sources also shone as they pulled through!

At the forefront were Golden Titans of terrifying stature, and variations of others followed as above the Pantheon of Bloodvista, there was even a Source Complexity Outerversal Morphon surrounded by Eldritch Pioneers welcoming these beings.
They were all here for a single purpose.
They came for the weavings of an entity that held the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!

chapters.title: Chapter 3532 Move! II
paragraphs: In the Megalos Beyond, a party arrived that included Source Complexity entities and Pioneers, their search being singular in nature.
At the forefront, a Golden Titan brimming with a terrifying Source held a single white pupil on its head as it looked towards the Outerversal Morphons ahead of it.
"You were succesful in tracking down weavings of this Instrument? This Ozymandias?"
The question was posed towards an Outerversal Morphon in the form of an ancient obsidian tree, its branches wiggling like tentacles as everything about it screamed of age and ancientness.
An intent radiated from it as its branches veered towards one direction.
"Near the Pantheon of Umbra...let us go."
HUUM!
They were decisive.
They were quick.
They moved to hunt down the weavings of a singular being as they did not know...there were two other parties led by Source Complexity entities who were also searching for a man of the same weavings!
Across the Megalos and the Expanse of this Frequency, a single entity was being chased!
Apart from the Megalos Ynnere and the Megalos Beyond, there was the Expanse.
In the depths of this place where very few could reach, there were the Palaces of the Wheelomachy.
Mysterious, with their weavings interwoven and connected to channels others couldn't even fathom.
Pathways that led to places others may never even be capable of imagining!

Within one of such Palaces of the Wheelomachy, a woman was sitting on an expanse of a golden cloud overlooking a dazzling illusory wheel ahead of it, streams of information only she and a few other could read constantly pulsing around this illusory Wheel.
At this moment, this woman was tinkling with a small singularity in her hands.
Something that Tam of the Singed left behind- telling her to keep it as someone would contact her!
Someone who would help in setting things right.
"How can anything be set right when your own weavings collapsed..."
She spoke to herself as she shook her head, about to put the singularity away.
After questioning, the Watchers surrounded by Faceless Lifeforms could not do anything to her without blatantly rising anymore suspicions, so she remained guarding this Palace this whole time.
She didn't know how everything would unfold from here on-...!
The Singularity she was putting away blinked in her hands as she was shocked, her weavings going into it as she listened closely.
"Disciple Vashti, is now a good time to come?"
A voice that she was far too familiar with echoed out from the singularity as she was shocked!
Was this not...Tam?
When he said someone would contact, it was actually himself?!
She composed herself and looked around the empty domain around her before she sent a word of confirmation, and the next moment...
HUUM!
The singularity in her hands unfolded and left her figure, forming into a gateway where two figures quickly stepped out.
One was someone she had known for a long time, someone she had watched collapse and die right in front of her eyes.
Tam of the Singed!
The other was someone that she had not seen before, and yet his weavings seemed oddly familiar.
Vashti was shocked at the scene before her as before she could say too much, Tam of the Singed smiled while coming towards her.
"My Old Friend, why don't we do one last hurrah and unveil the messy corruption within the Wheelomachy before we continue the fight where we won't perish too easily?"
He came towards her as he was tasked with something from the Burnt One!
Something that he said was needed to keep Persephael busy in the meantime!
"And he..."
Vashti pointed towards Noah's visage with caution as he was gazing around at everything, matching them with the memories and weavings Bob gave him before he shot out towards a certain direction.
Tam of the Singed looked at him disappear as he spoke with reverence.
"He was the one to save me from certain doom. An unfathomable Singed that we cannot even imagine. Vashti, you wondered of the true fate of Sir Bob, did you not? We shall unveil it for all to see..."
Tam of the Singed pulled out a crystalline glass singularity that was playing a scene from another Frequency entirely.
Something that had occured not too long ago!
In the crystal ball, Vashti saw the visage of none other than Sir Bob.
And he...was surrounded by Watchers accompanied by terrifying Faceless Lifeforms and other entities she did not have any knowledge of!

"Let us have things made clear so that at the very least, others will fight and not teeter along the lines of hesitation. We are Watchers and Disciples of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy. Our task is too heavy to be veiled by corruption..."
Tam of the Singed spoke out gloriously as Vashti saw what was displayed- something that they would spread for all too see!
On the crystal ball, white gold Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence burned as when the scene within exploded out, nobody would be able to extinguish it.
While Tam of the Singed handled this matter.
In another direction, Noah crossed the Palace of the Wheel that was among the few which Bob moved around in, arriving in a dark area of space that should have nothing there.
And yet when he raised his hand to tap out a certain sequence one million times in the span of a second...
BZZT!
Arcs of electricity flickered as a singularity bloomed, his body carried into it instantly before it was closed off like it never existed!
Thereafter, Noah blinked as he found himself in a unique domain.
All around, a white wheel spun in slow motion as in between its Spokes that connected from the center to the outer ring...9 portals could be seen shining with heavy complexity.

The weavings and memories of Bob flashed within Noah's mind as he looked around this white Wheel, having arrived exactly where he needed to be in order to enter another Frequency entirely where Bob's remnant weavings were hidden!

"My Old Friend, why don't we do one last hurrah and unveil the messy corruption within the Wheelomachy before we continue the fight where we won't perish too easily?"
He came towards her as he was tasked with something from the Burnt One!
Something that he said was needed to keep Persephael busy in the meantime!
"And he..."
Vashti pointed towards Noah's visage with caution as he was gazing around at everything, matching them with the memories and weavings Bob gave him before he shot out towards a certain direction.
Tam of the Singed looked at him disappear as he spoke with reverence.
"He was the one to save me from certain doom.
An unfathomable Singed that we cannot even imagine.
Vashti, you wondered of the true fate of Sir Bob, did you not?
We shall unveil it for all to see..."
Tam of the Singed pulled out a crystalline glass singularity that was playing a scene from another Frequency entirely.
Something that had occured not too long ago!
In the crystal ball, Vashti saw the visage of none other than Sir Bob.
And he...was surrounded by Watchers accompanied by terrifying Faceless Lifeforms and other entities she did not have any knowledge of!
"Let us have things made clear so that at the very least, others will fight and not teeter along the lines of hesitation.
We are Watchers and Disciples of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy.
Our task is too heavy to be veiled by corruption..."
Tam of the Singed spoke out gloriously as Vashti saw what was displayed- something that they would spread for all too see!
On the crystal ball, white gold Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence burned as when the scene within exploded out, nobody would be able to extinguish it.
While Tam of the Singed handled this matter.
In another direction, Noah crossed the Palace of the Wheel that was among the few which Bob moved around in, arriving in a dark area of space that should have nothing there.
And yet when he raised his hand to tap out a certain sequence one million times in the span of a second...
BZZT!
Arcs of electricity flickered as a singularity bloomed, his body carried into it instantly before it was closed off like it never existed!
Thereafter, Noah blinked as he found himself in a unique domain.
All around, a white wheel spun in slow motion as in between its Spokes that connected from the center to the outer ring...9 portals could be seen shining with heavy complexity.

The weavings and memories of Bob flashed within Noah's mind as he looked around this white Wheel, having arrived exactly where he needed to be in order to enter another Frequency entirely where Bob's remnant weavings were hidden!

chapters.title: Chapter 3533 Fervent Disorder! I
paragraphs: A white Wheel.
9 Portals uniquely placed within this wheel!
Noah looked at this construct carefully as this felt like something he had seen before.
Not just from the memories of Bob, but from other weavings as well.
The glorious wings behind his back buzzed with incandescence as he also placed his hand on his chest.
On his Atlas of Existence.
Within it, nine Mundis of Power existed as he was the Administrator of all of them, with the Sources filling them up burning with complexity!
Every single one having undergone severings upto the 27th level.
All except for the Source of the Singed that had undergone 81 Severings and attained a Pathway to a True Source.
He closed his eyes as countless weavings passed by, thinking about many things as the weavings of the Protagonist bubbled up to the surface.
He thought of how things could possibly unfold from here on out, and when he thought about the unknown, he wondered.
"It is time for another prophecy?"
His weavings buzzed with fervor at such a thought alone as he gazed at the spinning white wheel and the portals within it, his body shooting out forward!
But he did not go towards any of these 9 portals.
He instead shot towards the center of the wheel- where the many spokes converged towards which formed a small point of a singularity!

Bob had many preparations as even the most obvious thing was a distraction, with Noah's figure not entering any of the obvious portals and instead the small singularity at the very center as he disappeared into it right after.
A heavy silence settled into this isolated area.

Outside of it, in the Palaces of the Wheelomachy. The Palaces themselves could be considered different networks of a tremendously complex maze, but they had points on connections all around where Watchers and Disciples pass through.

The weavings of all Palaces were currently tense at this moment as within one Palace, there was a woman adorned in a blue robe who sat on top of an illusory Wheel while staring at the Faceless Lifeforms covering different areas of her own domain.
Impartial Watchers, Persephael, and those who stood with her called them.
But anyone could see that the way they monitored, they weren't here to protect.
"If you wanted to be believable, you could at least spread your complexity outwards..."

She spoke towards them calmly as truly, every single one of these so-called Impartial Watchers had their eyes and complexity turned into this domain, and not an ounce outwardly as if they didn't care about what could come in from the outside...but they did care about those within!
It was akin to bodyguards keeping their eye only on the person they were supposed to protect, watching their every move, but nobody else's nor their surroundings.
She, Mysara, knew that she was being watched.
Her blue robe glinted with radiance as a shocking level of complexity was hidden within it, her eyes pulsing with a similar blue light as she spoke to herself.
"Bob...you shouldn't have died, right? I always advocated for you to be recruited, but those guys always held your nature against you..."
Her eyes shone with a unique interest as she spoke freely, and the next moment...
"Oh?"
Her brows rose as she felt a surge of unique complexity she was all too familiar with.
Near the entrance of this domain, a surge of white gold flames exploded out as dazzling words formed from shockingly pure weavings she never thought she would see here.
These words formed above a flaming screen of illusory light that showed an unfolding scene which caused her eyes to flash dangerously!
The words were simple, and yet they carried a tremendous weight.
|The fight for the Wheel of Existence has never been an easy one, but the Watchers fought regardless.|
WAA!
|It is once more time to fight for the Wheel, even if it is against those who have turned their backs to it.|
Simple words. And below them, an illusory scene encased in flames. It seemed that showed the Great Sage and Persephael accompanied by my many Faceless Lifeforms as they surrounded a lone Watcher!
Bob!
Accompanying them were...
"The Dredges of the Logos of the Wheel? Interesting..."
Her figure rose from the illusory wheel she stood on.
She saw as dozens of Source Complexity entities surrounded Bob, with the weakest being of the Lesser Source and most were of the Greater Source Complexity!
Dozens of them.
And yet Bob stared at all of them calmly while releasing an intent that could not be understood here before a battle erupted in the next moment. The scene cut off, and then repeated again on a loop.
The Faceless Lifeforms and all others here saw this as their vertical white bands pulsed with radiance, multiple of them making a move against the burning flames and the scene they showed as...
HUUM!
Dark waves of complexity gushed out of them and attacked the flames that were displaying the words and the scenes that had occurred far in a not so distant past.
But they shockingly found that even as their complexity descended, the weavings of those flames could not be dispersed!
The blue robed woman watched this as she couldn't help but utter. "Undeniable?...even more interesting. But with this, more than enough information has been gathered, it is time to return."

In a moment, her body flickered as another version of her appeared to her right. This version of hers disappeared as the one that remained raised her hands while looking at the Faceless Lifeforms that now turned towards her and the few Disciples that she had been utilizing since she was here.
As the evidence was clear and unblemished, the ruse could not be kept going any longer.
So she spoke towards the Faceless Lifeforms
"Shall we get started? I've been getting many things prepared while waiting for a sign, and it seems that sign is as clear as day."
HUUM!
Unfathomable weavings of complexity bloomed from her as the color blue... pervaded everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 3534 Fervent Disorder! II
paragraphs: Blue.

The Impartial Watchers- the Faceless Lifeforms only saw this flash as a leading one among them taking on the form of a massive Earth Titan bellowed while dozens of Dark Towers erupted from him- shattered Omniverses also beginning to unfurl from him and others into a storm of complexity!
"Intelligence says she is one of the more powerful ones sitting at the Greater Source Complexity! Be careful!"
At his words, the blue-robed woman raised her brows while her eyes pulsed with cerulean complexity, her voice echoing out.

"Your information seems a bit outdated. I don't know how far back you obtained such weavings, but I'll tell you now that I am not one of the more powerful ones sitting at Greater Source Complexity as you so state. I am THE most powerful one within this stage- and that is undisputed. You all will get a taste."
WUU!
At her words, blue strings erupted from her by the millions as each one seemed unfathomably strong and sharp as they struck out to all of the source complexity entities nearby.
Among those sitting as her enemies, it included Greater Source Entities and many Lesser Source Entities, and yet she stayed behind to fight them all!
She was someone with a unique identity that even the Watchers did not know.
She was Mysara.
"Kyanos...run rampant."
She called out her source as the blue strings instantly burned with fearsome cerulean flames as between each of them, dense unfathomably vast seas somehow also bloomed.

But the moment that even a single string came in contact with a Faceless Lifeform, their bodies faced a deep impact that nearly ripped the black veil. And when dozens and hundreds of the strings smashed unto a single Lesser Source Faceless Lifeform...
RIIP!
A black veil was entirely torn as a wriggling mass of obsidian revulsion roared out within, only to be met with descending flames filled with millions upon millions of Runes of Existence.
The black mass cried out in pain and horror as Mysara closed her eyes.
"Come now, this is just the beginning..."
Her Source further exploded out as a terrifying battle bloomed within this Palace of the Wheelomachy.
But it wasn't the only place that was radiating a fervent display of chaos and disorder.

Inside multiple other Palaces of the Wheelomachy, the scene inscribed in flames that could not be extinguished was shown to all along with the words above as an already shaky ruse could not be kept any longer, battles erupting in full!

The Wheelomachy began to churn as Watchers with Faceless Lifeforms went against other Watchers, such a battle blooming within this frequency of existence as undoubtedly, it would very soon extend to other frequencies of existence.
The weavings of existence were vast and interminable. The number of life forms was even more exceedingly vast.
The amount of possible chaos that could unfold...could simply not be estimated!

Across these weavings of existence, the body of a blue-robed woman- Mysara, was crossing extremely tight and complex weavings that seemed to hold the very fabric of existence within them- everything around her filled with darkness.
She was actually leaving one frequency and going into another as in her hand, a blue water drop shone radiantly as a guide while she spoke into it.

"We held the Doctrine of waiting for the enemies to show their hand first before we made a move. I believe now is more than sufficient for us to make our moves before even more chaos taints the Flow of the Wheel."
She spoke to a drop of water.
And from it, an ancient voice echoed out in reply.
|Return, there are many places that will require attention.|
The voice neither agreed nor disagreed.
But Mysara knew what had to be done as she continued forward.
She was returning home after many eons.
To those who entrenched themselves in the forces of even the Wheelomachy and the Logos of the Wheel while remaining behind the scenes.
Around her blue attire and incandescent blue radiance, heavy but complex golden flames of none other than the Singed could be felt.
Occasionally, they burnt from gold to blue as this entity sped forth!
In the Megalos Ynnere.

A scene of unfathomable destruction of the weavings of existence themselves could be seen as in the surroundings, twenty-five entities whose bodies were aflame with terrifying embers that they could not put out floated.
The most powerful in here had a body encased in dazzling Gems that held fractures in all sorts of places.
Her expression was currently livid as behind her, shattered gem like wings began to reform as she assessed the damage.
Of the Faceless Lifeform...
BOOM!
One had their Veil torn as terrifying white gold flames filled with millions upon millions of Runes of Existence descended and began burning the source of this Faceless Lifeform to a crisp!
Persephael's gaze was a heavy one as she roared out.
"I will burn this place to the ground, you hear me?! I will torch these entire Megalos and leave nothing behind as all of this will be in your hands! All that blood- on you and you alone!"

She roared out as at this moment, the Infinite Crystal Gem Prison was shattered and lying in pieces, the entity within long since gone as her roars emanating outwards covered distances of a few hundred Omniverses at the very least.
In the next moment...she turned her head towards one direction as multiple auras of Source Complexity could be felt there, but...

"Don't burn it all down while I am still here...I came looking for someone under the orders of the Logos of the Wheel. I am not sure if they are the same as whoever was involved here, but these Megalos are tiny, as it is doubtful that there is to be another. May I ask who has enraged you so?"
The visage of McAllister looking for his daughter appeared alongside Faceless Lifeforms as the two sides stared at each other.
The gaze of Persephael was cold as she waved her hands to show the image of a single entity- and it was none other than Noah Osmont!

chapters.title: Chapter 3535 Fervent Disorder! III
paragraphs: An image!
McAllister saw the image of a cold-faced man who emanated waves of dignity and regality as he spoke out questioningly.
"Could you be the Noah Osmont I am looking for...?"
His eyes were sharp as he asked this question, but what he was truly asking was the depths of his intuition- his Source!
And based on what that irritable Black Cat told him, along with his buzzing source when he uttered out that name to pair along with that image...
"There is a high likelihood."
He opened his eyes brightly and made this assertion as he wanted to ask the one ahead of him regarding this enemy.
And as if she expected this, Persephael harrumphed while speaking out.
"It matters not where he is. I will burn these whole Megalos to sniff them out!"
Her gems pulsed with rage as they continued to spread out, but she came to a stop in the next moment as she pulled out a gem from her chest.
The gem showed scenes displayed in a distant place from here- in the Palaces of the Wheelomachy!

She saw that in an area near her Palace, white gold flames she was very much familiar with had etched heavy words alongside the scenes of what occurred in a certain frequency when they surrounded Bob.
|The fight for the Wheel of Existence has never been an easy one, but the Watchers fought regardless.|
|It is once more time to fight for the Wheel, even if it is against those who have turned their backs to it.|
The words etched in white gold flames were ones that could not be removed- just like the Embers burning around her body!
They seemed to be taunting her as she remembered the words of that Singed.
She turned towards McAllister as she asked.
"He is Noah Osmont, you said?"
"Likely." And McAllister replied without hesitation as Persephael remembered his words.
He had asked her if she would even have the time to attempt Megalocide!
She didn't know he would cause such a disruption as with a heavy heart...she turned to the Faceless Lifeform behind her and spoke while gritting her teeth.
"You, you, you...head back to assist in the order of the Wheelomachy. "
She pointed to many of the Faceless Lifeform and commanded, but most of those she pointed to had their vertical bars pulse heavily as the intent of a few echoed out.

"These embers are constantly eating away at our Sources. It could be a few days or less before we are incapacitated...that man needs to die before then. Collapsing his weavings should collapse his flames!"

The Faceless Lifeforms nearly bellowed out as Persephael roared back "I fucking know! I have the same Embers around me...you all go. I will continue seeking this Osmont here. I do not wish to see my own weavings drained any more than you all, so you should know I take this seriously. But we cannot afford to lose the foothold of the Wheelomachy in any Frequency, this will make the mission that much harder. We need a Megalos Nexus in the Expanse to smoothly and quickly traverse to different Frequencies. Otherwise, things start falling apart."
They could not lose any parts of the Wheelomachy.
Things were already off course as the Change happened much earlier than expected, and now...
Persephael shook her head in frustration as the Faceless Lifeforms nodded and began disappearing one after another, leaving only three with her.
She looked towards McAllister as she growled out.
"Let us find this fucking Osmont. If it drags off, we can attempt to initiate a Megalocide!"
She was utterly serious as for what was on the line, nothing was off limits!
"We have a name. We have a face. I will start with what the Logos of the Wheel is most proficient in...Entanglements. We start from the weavings of connections as eventually, it shall lead to him."
McAllister had a calm expression as he closed his eyes, his weavings erupting out.
In these same Megalos Ynnere.
Within the Infiniverse Megalos.
The figures of the Sages and Yoo Jin were somber as they stared at Noah's figure for direction.
They were standing within a region Pantheonic Haven of Elysium as golden threads of brilliance swirled all around them when Noah asked.
"What do you all know regarding the Megalos? The distinct weavings between each of them?"
The Megalos!
As Persephael threatened Megalocide, Noah had a few possibilities under his banner, but there were still many unknowns.
Towards this question, Yoo Jin was silent as she didn't know anything major.
But the Maharishi was hesitant before she pulled out a flower with three petals.

"The Origin Maharishi always spoke of the Megalos as fields with distinct weavings of existence that acted as pillars for the integrity of the Expanse. There are three major Megalos, and then a myriad of other unique Megalos that act as smaller pillars in between and even within the Expanse. Megalos Mountains, Palaces of the Expanse. But it all begins with Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Nihilos. Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter. Their weavings have distinct demarcations that keep their simplicity and purity as more often than not, it is this Purity and simplicity that keep complexity at a low level within these Megalos. Why many even relocate to the Expanse as they elevate their States of Existence..."
Weavings of the Megalos were spoken about as the Maharishi offered the flower with three petals to Noah!
He grasped it as he asked calmly.
"So it is this purity and simplicity that keeps them less complex. More easily affected by the weavings of others. What would happen if the lines of Demarcation between the Megalos are broken?"
He asked a daring question as the Maharishi swallowed her weavings and looked at the other Sages before she answered.

"This...is something the Origin Maharishi mentioned to me before. She said such a process would be irreversible if ever it occurred. But the mixture of weavings of distinct Megalos...would definitely result in rising complexity. She had observed it in some Frequencies.
"I see." Noah nodded while keeping his eyes on the flower of three petals, coming to a decision!

|It is once more time to fight for the Wheel, even if it is against those who have turned their backs to it.|
The words etched in white gold flames were ones that could not be removed- just like the Embers burning around her body!
They seemed to be taunting her as she remembered the words of that Singed.
She turned towards McAllister as she asked.
"He is Noah Osmont, you said?"
"Likely." And McAllister replied without hesitation as Persephael remembered his words.
He had asked her if she would even have the time to attempt Megalocide!
She didn't know he would cause such a disruption as with a heavy heart...she turned to the Faceless Lifeform behind her and spoke while gritting her teeth.
"You, you, you...head back to assist in the order of the Wheelomachy.
She pointed to many of the Faceless Lifeform and commanded, but most of those she pointed to had their vertical bars pulse heavily as the intent of a few echoed out.
"These embers are constantly eating away at our Sources.
It could be a few days or less before we are incapacitated...that man needs to die before then.
Collapsing his weavings should collapse his flames!"
The Faceless Lifeforms nearly bellowed out as Persephael roared back "I fucking know!
I have the same Embers around me...you all go.
I will continue seeking this Osmont here.
I do not wish to see my own weavings drained any more than you all, so you should know I take this seriously.
But we cannot afford to lose the foothold of the Wheelomachy in any Frequency, this will make the mission that much harder.
We need a Megalos Nexus in the Expanse to smoothly and quickly traverse to different Frequencies.
Otherwise, things start falling apart."
They could not lose any parts of the Wheelomachy.
Things were already off course as the Change happened much earlier than expected, and now...
Persephael shook her head in frustration as the Faceless Lifeforms nodded and began disappearing one after another, leaving only three with her.
She looked towards McAllister as she growled out.
"Let us find this fucking Osmont.
If it drags off, we can attempt to initiate a Megalocide!"
She was utterly serious as for what was on the line, nothing was off limits!
"We have a name.
We have a face.
I will start with what the Logos of the Wheel is most proficient in...Entanglements.
We start from the weavings of connections as eventually, it shall lead to him."
McAllister had a calm expression as he closed his eyes, his weavings erupting out.
In these same Megalos Ynnere.
Within the Infiniverse Megalos.
The figures of the Sages and Yoo Jin were somber as they stared at Noah's figure for direction.
They were standing within a region Pantheonic Haven of Elysium as golden threads of brilliance swirled all around them when Noah asked.
"What do you all know regarding the Megalos?
The distinct weavings between each of them?"
The Megalos!
As Persephael threatened Megalocide, Noah had a few possibilities under his banner, but there were still many unknowns.
Towards this question, Yoo Jin was silent as she didn't know anything major.
But the Maharishi was hesitant before she pulled out a flower with three petals.
"The Origin Maharishi always spoke of the Megalos as fields with distinct weavings of existence that acted as pillars for the integrity of the Expanse.
There are three major Megalos, and then a myriad of other unique Megalos that act as smaller pillars in between and even within the Expanse.
Megalos Mountains, Palaces of the Expanse.
But it all begins with Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Nihilos.
Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter.
Their weavings have distinct demarcations that keep their simplicity and purity as more often than not, it is this Purity and simplicity that keep complexity at a low level within these Megalos.
Why many even relocate to the Expanse as they elevate their States of Existence..."
Weavings of the Megalos were spoken about as the Maharishi offered the flower with three petals to Noah!
He grasped it as he asked calmly.
"So it is this purity and simplicity that keeps them less complex.
More easily affected by the weavings of others.
What would happen if the lines of Demarcation between the Megalos are broken?"
He asked a daring question as the Maharishi swallowed her weavings and looked at the other Sages before she answered.
"This...is something the Origin Maharishi mentioned to me before.
She said such a process would be irreversible if ever it occurred.
But the mixture of weavings of distinct Megalos...would definitely result in rising complexity.
She had observed it in some Frequencies.
"I see." Noah nodded while keeping his eyes on the flower of three petals, coming to a decision!

chapters.title: Chapter 3536 Fervent Disorder! IV
paragraphs: The Megalos were too vast.
As unfathomable as the Infiniverse Megalos was, they could not cover everything.
So start a process, and muddy the waters along the way.
He remembered in one Amarantos Dream how the Instrument of the Beyonder had spread the Megalos Beyond into the Megalos Ynnere.

He looked at the flower with three petals as, at this time, a golden flame rose on his finger that he brought down and made a swiping motion at the demarcation that stood between the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond!
The Maharishi saw this and turned serious as she asked.
"What happened with the Faceless Lifeforms?"
"They burn while still searching. The Tainted Watcher of the Wheelomachy...proposed Megalocide as a threat. We shall deter as much as possible."
The gazes of the Sages and Yoo Jin flickered at such words as their eyes flashed with distaste!
When they simply thought of this word...
Megalocide!
Something far too heavy to even utter with its implications!
And yet the Burnt One spoke about preventing it easily as the Maharishi nodded while speaking valiantly.
"We remain under your command for anything that needs to be done."
WAA!
Sources continued to pledge themselves to his banner as Noah nodded while closing his eyes.
He felt the simmering True Severed Singed Flame of Existence and all the parts of him that had undergone 27 Severings due to this flame.
All parts of him!
At this moment, his complexity was the highest it had ever been as he focused on the Source of Outerversal.
He focused on the Source of Megalos.
Since he was in both the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere, it was easy to sense where both parts of him were!
What he now studied was what lay between them.
The Demarcation between Ynnere and Beyond!
The point that he had crossed some time ago when he first sent a part of himself to become Ozymandias.

When he put all of this together, it wasn't hard for his weavings that had been truly severed many times over to begin spreading themselves into gaps others could not even observe as he used the channel between himself, the Infiniverse Megalos, and Ozymandias to achieve it!
In between the channel.
There was an impenetrable barrier of complexity and stability.
A barrier that Outerversal Morphons crossed whenever they sent lines down into Ynnere to fish for Delegatus.
A line that those with a sufficient amount of complexity could cross, but it always remained where it was this whole time.
The line that kept the purity between Matter and Dark Matter.
Between the Megalos Ynnere and the Megalos Beyond.
Noah felt its vastness and impermeability as he spoke to himself.
"It is time for this wall to come down."
HUUM!
He spoke like this as one would wonder how such a thing could be achieved.

But for him...he simply allowed white gold flames to flow out of him endlessly, crossing the channel between him and Ozymandias as they were all shuttled into that midpoint- into that impermeable barrier!
True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.
It permeated across the weavings of the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond as these flames...were part of the complexity of the Wheel of Existence itself!
They held Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence.
Their input into the Demarcation between two distinct weavings of existence...was akin to a ruling that the Wheel of Existence itself was passing down!
There was no rejection.

In fact, as the white gold flames entered and filled this invisible boundary between Matter and Dark Matter seamlessly before they began to spread wildly, Noah keeping a steady input of these flames as he did not know the ends of this boundary- so he simply poured everything in!
And on the other side...
Ozymandias stood within the Megalos Beyond.
Above the Pantheon of Umbra where the bodies of Faceless Lifeforms that held the power of Pioneers lay wriggling and dying!

Around the obsidian gold winged Ozymandias, the figures of the Observer of Old and Young, the Great Mother, the Great Wheel, the Great Ponderor, the One Who Walks, and many more observed this scene of glory and horror as a Dark Tower that had been siphoning off the weavings of existence of all Outerversal Morphons here crashed down into nothingness.
And yet such a glorious scene was not given any time for reverence as from all around the stellar dark space around them, terrifying auras soon bloomed.
The Great Mother and Others raised their wills up in shock as they didn't just feel the horrific auras of those far exceeding Existence Severing- there were those even a level above this!
Pioneers. And above them, Source Complexity entities!
And their auras were all distinct as some pulsed with the weavings of Matter, others of Anti-Matter, and others of their own Dark Matter!
"You did not even try to hide, O Instrument of the Beyonder. O Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!"
HUUM!

A Source Complexity Golden Titan bellowed out with fervor and laughed as he came with other Source Complexities from various Palaces of the Expanse, and there were even Pioneers and Source Complexity entities that were Outerversal Morphons here!
One of them- a massive stellar obsidian tree with countless tentacles for its branches, came forward at this moment and spoke out.
"Since he is of my Megalos Beyond, I shall speak and evaluate his weavings first..."
He floated ahead with indefatigable brilliance as the Golden Titans and others shook their heads.
They all wanted to get their hands on him. Would they really make it easy for others to grasp him just like that?
As their complexities were about to explode outwards.
As the weavings of the Great Mother and others were ashen, with the Existence Severing Great Mother even about to speak defiantly towards all these beings!
Ozymandias floated up by himself gloriously as his obsidian gold hands were raised.
"O ye poor masses filled with greed."
HUUM!
His voice was reverential as he raised his hands up and continued!

"It was said that with the coming of the Instrument of the Beyonder, the Megalos Beyond would be elevated to a level unforeseen before. This elevation...shall be the stage of your graves on this day."

Shocking words of incredulity were uttered out as the Source Complexity entities looked at each other, but in the next moment...Ozymandias clenched his hand into a fist and struck out the barren dark space beside him!
A simple strike of a fist.
And yet in the next moment, the space here shattered like a broken mirror- a mirror that seemed to be filled with white gold flames inside of it!
It began where his punch was and rapidly extended outwards as if the very Megalos Beyond was breaking!
And from the origin of this breakage.
The stupefied entities here saw...weavings of Matter on the other side as it was the Megalos Ynnere!

chapters.title: Chapter 3537 Convergence! I
paragraphs: It was an utterly unbelievable scene.
Ozymandias struck his fist out, and weavings of existence collapsed as if they were paper.
The area collapsed akin to intricate broken mirrors, and within, tendrils of white gold flames could be seen unraveling everything.
As if it were a chain reaction, more and more things broke down as through it, they could truly see a different Megalos.
Megalos Ynnere!
The weavings of matter could be felt abundantly clear as there were many here who had visited the Megalos Ynnere before.
The unraveling between Ynnere and Beyond...was not something many expected to see occur with a mere flick of the hand of an Entity!
And such an impact was widespread as in all directions, it continued to stretch out as if a veil that existed between the two sides was now completely and entirely torn.
In an instant, the weavings of Matter and Dark Matter came in contact and began to boil over.
Megalos Beyond spilled into Megalos Ynnere and vice versa!
It was the observance of the interaction of Matter and Dark Matter in real time as from it, countless profundities bloomed for those who were capable of observing and understanding.
For others, it was a show of immensity and wonder as they looked at the man responsible who now stared at the Source Complexity entities and those that came with them.
Around his body- around the body of this self-proclaimed Instrument of the Beyonder, white gold flames began to burn as he spoke out while looking at every single entity here.
"The greed that brought you here burns brightly in the night. Let it burn for all to see."
Let their greed burn he said.
And in the next moment, his body buzzed with complexity as waves of severed mana endlessly formed into the Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
And these Embers spread out rapidly and began to bloom on the bodies of every single enemy combatant here.
HUUM!
Whether it be Pioneers of Existence.
Whether it be Source Complexity Entities.
Every single one suddenly felt their bodies become a flame as they roared out in shock while their Paths or Sources erupted out in brilliance!
And yet to their dismay, they would soon come to find that these flames were inextinguishable.
The Source Complexity Entities at least had some form of protection as for them, it was somewhat bearable.

But for the Pioneers... they felt their paths truly become a flame with embers that they could not put away, and their paths began to be eaten up and dispersed right after as...their complexity compared to the complexity of the Instrument of the Beyonder was far too weak at this moment.
They could not resist the Embers of a Pathway to a True Source.
This was a singular difference, even though all of them were following a path!
The path that Ozymandias followed was something that none of theirs could compare to!
It was mayhem.
First, the veil between the two Megalos collapsed, and after that, the newly appearing entrants began to burn en masse!
"Disrupt his weavings! Do not let him continue to do this!"
The one-eyed Golden Titan roared out as his body became encased with a golden mountain that rotated and spun as it thundered down towards Ozymandias.
The other Source Complexities felt the permanent nature of these inextinguishable flames as they also roared out and moved towards a single entity.
It was a show of utter chaos and complexity as to top it all off...
Ozymandias snapped his fingers.
A distance above, space tote as a singularity came down.
It held a smiling expression while its eyes were replaced with infinity symbols.
It was a Tzar Versepiercer.
It could choose who to afflict between enemies and allies as at this moment, it could be utilized in any setting.
And so, Ozymandias used it in this setting!
Because all the enemies that came to him here...were carrying Globules of Blood of Pioneers or Source Pearls to allow him to further sever his complexity!
BOOM!
An explosion bloomed as in the next moment, all those here were able to witness the emergence of an ancient archaic golden Wheel!
An archaic wooden Wheel that caused their very weavings of existence to feel a sense of trepidation as if they were looking at the grandeur of the Wheel of Existence itself.
A moment later, they experienced the breaking of the Wheel as multiple subsequent explosions thundered out while white gold flames burned everything!
The Great Mother and others experienced the breaking of the Wheel for the first time, thinking they were about to perish in its fiery collapse but...
They felt as if their bodies were cleansed instead as they observed the unfathomable flames filled with purity, their weavings feeling a tug they never felt before!
But from this breaking of the Wheel, those deemed as enemies...all Pioneers had their weavings collapse.
The flames that burnt them proceeded to devour everything they had and sent it all to a single being.

Ozymandias accepted all of it as these weavings would be sent towards Ruination, and she would proceed to multiply them as many times as possible before they were utilized to sever the next concept that would be taken towards a Pathway to a True Source!
As such a wonder bloomed.
A distance of many Pantheons away.

In a dark point of the Megalos Beyond, there was a figure of a four-limbed beast whose visage could barely be seen in the darkness of the Megalos- as if this creature itself had melded and become one with it!
Its eyes showed tremendous power and cold, calculated rage as it looked towards the imposter that called himself the Instrument of the Beyonder.
An imposter!

Only someone true would know that they were looking at an Imposter as at this moment, the True Instrument thought about its possibilities and options in the face of the sheer power it could feel even from a distance as a moment later...
BZZT!
Its weavings turned tumultuous as a deep and ancient voice boomed out within its mind.
It actually recognized this voice to be its own, and yet it carried a different sense of complexity and ancientness, as if it had lived much, much longer.

"O Instruments across existence. O Instruments across Frequencies. I burn my Source to connect us as one and ask of us to come together under a threat that threatens our very weavings across all of Existence."

chapters.title: Chapter 3538 Convergence! II
paragraphs: A voice that was exactly like itself, and it was imbued with terrifying complexity that it had yet to reach!
It had attained a Source, and it shockingly was capable of connecting every single one of them.
In exchange for burning its very Source, this magisterial possibility unfolded!

" A Deceiver with false weavings seeks to usurp everything that we stand for, everything that was promised for us. We are more than mere instruments- we are the Inheritors of a glorious purpose that we cannot allow to be usurped to buy another."
Heavy.
Powerful!
It echoed from the very depths of his existence and resonated with him as if he were the one speaking!

"But this entity is powerful as they are resourceful. They appear to us in dreams as their weavings face no repercussions, while ours continue to be destroyed. To overcome this entity entirely and thoroughly, I have theorized that the only way with a degree of certainty...is for all of our weavings across existence- across frequencies, to combine and become one. This...is a guaranteed path. And one of us at this very moment is staring at the Deceiver."
From the depths of its weavings, it felt countless eyes locked onto him.
It was him.
He stared at the Deceiver at this very moment.
He would be the one to accept all weavings of himself!
"Fuse our weavings together. Let us become one across existence and inherit a purpose others cannot imagine. We have gone by many names as at this moment...we are only The Inheritor of the Megalos."
WAA!
The Inheritor of the Megalos.
Such a distinction resounded across Frequencies as in the next moment, waves of countless possibilities moved across Frequencies to arrive before a single creature.
All possibilities.
All the possible versions of itself across Frequencies!
There was no debate or doubt as for all of them, it was simply akin to putting all of their collective thoughts together into one body.
All of their collective complexity!
The product of this...is what one of them who was burning their Source at this very moment to achieve all of this...thought would be enough to stand against the Deceiver.
HUUM!
The body of the four-legged beast began to change and transform as its complexity accepted unfathomable weavings while it watched an astounding weaving of existence unfold in the far distance.
Those who had come for the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian...all those with weavings of Pioneers and below had perished as only the source complexity entities remained.

And even these source complexity entities had some casualties as, at this moment, after the breaking of the terrifying archaic wooden Wheel, three Source Complexities had half of their sources heavily affected and burnt with an ever-incandescent glare radiating from them as they screamed in rage and horror!
In the middle of all of this, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian spread his arms out as he accepted the fuel of heavy weavings of complexity.
Fuel that at this moment, he directed towards a singular concept after it was multiplied by Ruination.

The veil between two Megalos was torn down as the interactions between Matter and Dark Matter seemed to have found a level of stability as at this moment, there seemed to be a funneling of both of these states of existence from one Megalos and into another. The Pantheon of Umbra that was here became blanketed by particles of Matter as uniquely, its flat planar appearance began to distort and change in real-time as it began to expand from top to bottom and attain a more circular appearance!
An appearance and features of none other than...an Omniverse.
As such, a process occurred the complexity in the surrounding megalos. Began to scale upwards as the states of existence that should never have freely mixed began, flowing fervently throughout.

Uniquely, the gray tendrils and cracks spread out across the Megalos and that were present even here after the Change...they seemed to become dimmer in this region where Matter and Dark Matter were mixing as the levels of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence began to slowly rise again!
Such were things that only those perceptive could observe and understand.

But for those who were fighting with their very lives on the line...spared no glance at this as the Golden Titan Source Complexity entity stared towards Ozymandias with a singular torn golden Eye filled with hate.
And Ozymandias stared back at him with burning singularities as even more Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence were released from him to wrap around this being!
Other Source Complexities gathered behind him with ashen expressions as their weavings burned, one of them bellowing out.
"I only came here to observe and did not ask for any of this! I have no Entanglements or any thoughts towards the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!"
A Source Complexity Entity in the form of a tall dark blue tree echoed out.
It looked to be a tree with a humanoid form, a face present on its trunk as it thought to back out at this moment!

It had been living in the Expanse for eons as it enjoyed the wonders and luxuries of existence within it. But a moment of greed as it heard about the weavings of the Megalonians had drawn it out to see if it could grasp something even greater.
But all it found was a shocking level of complexity that actually caused it pain and burned its very Source in a manner that had never happened in the past eons!
He did not want any of this at this moment!
And yet the response from the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian...
"Once you make a choice, you must commit to it. Come, my weavings are still here for those who wish to take them. You will get a glimpse of them in the end...as you are devoured to join them."
Horrific words echoed out as the Lesser Source Entities here roared out in defiance, seeking to collapse the weavings of the one causing their Sources to unceasingly leak out their complexity!
As such a battle unfolded.

Its results and boons were being enjoyed in the Infiniverse Megalos as within the depths of this construct, Noah stared at the figure of Ruination that was shining with an incandescent crimson gold light- bundles of multiplied Globules of Blood of Pioneers and pieces of Source Pearls obtained from burning Source Complexities all surging towards him as he declared with a tyrannical light in his eyes.
"Let...the Megalos head towards the 81st Severing."
A heavy choice was made as Noah looked for a daring possibility!
The Weavings that all entities of the Expanse wanted.
The Weavings of the Megalonians!
He wanted to see just what immensity it could release...

It had attained a Source, and it shockingly was capable of connecting every single one of them.
In exchange for burning its very Source, this magisterial possibility unfolded!
" A Deceiver with false weavings seeks to usurp everything that we stand for, everything that was promised for us.
We are more than mere instruments- we are the Inheritors of a glorious purpose that we cannot allow to be usurped to buy another."
Heavy.
Powerful!
It echoed from the very depths of his existence and resonated with him as if he were the one speaking!
"But this entity is powerful as they are resourceful.
They appear to us in dreams as their weavings face no repercussions, while ours continue to be destroyed.

To overcome this entity entirely and thoroughly, I have theorized that the only way with a degree of certainty...is for all of our weavings across existence- across frequencies, to combine and become one.
This...is a guaranteed path.
And one of us at this very moment is staring at the Deceiver."

It was him.
He stared at the Deceiver at this very moment.
He would be the one to accept all weavings of himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3539 Convergence! III
paragraphs: The Megalonians.
They were a race of beings that were heavily sought after by those within the Expanse.
The uniqueness of the weavings made them prime targets for others to elevate their own, so they were devoured with wild abandon the moment that they were discovered.
In the Frequency that Noah was in, the Megalonians were not given time to grow and become powerful.

Was this the same case in other frequencies as well, or could the entities that he found within the Reconstruction of the Omnifather be alive and thriving in other Frequencies, or had they already faced the same fate? The same fate that had befallen the other Megalonians in this Frequency of Existence?
Noah did not know, but what he did know was the immensity and complexity of the weavings of the Megalos.
So after attaining the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, he chased after the Pathway to the True Source of the Megalos next!
Globules of Blood of Pioneers flowed from the figure of Ruination and sank into his body as they all flowed towards a single Mundi of Power within his Atlas of Existence.

In addition to the vibrant multiplied Globules of Blood, there were also the shards of Source Pearls that contained their own potency to Sever Existence as every single one floated towards the weavings of the Megalos!
|The Weavings of the Megalos have undergone their 34th Severing by utilizing 3 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
The process began slowly and accelerated upwards.

Three Lesser Source Entities in the Megalos Beyond who were much easier to decimate a single Faceless Lifeform rapidly burned at this moment due to the Tzar Versepiercer and his burning Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence as their Purified Source Pearls would fully be his soon!
It meant the ascension of the weavings of the Megalos was guaranteed.
|The Weavings of the Megalos have undergone their 48th Severing by utilizing 3 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
The number rapidly began to scale upwards.
Noah felt the multicolored brilliance within his Mundi of Power pulse with a heart-shaking glory as he counted in his heart!
50 Severings. 55. 60. 70!
On the 70th Severing, the many newly obtained Globules of Blood of Pioneers finished as Noah switched to the Source Pearls.
They came in pieces as he burned and ate away at multiple Sources of Pioneers in pieces, and it looked like he was absorbing stellar singularities that disappeared within his weavings.
75 Severings.
79 Severings.
80 Severings!
The biggest hurdle came as, at this moment, many Pieces of multiplied Purified Source Pearls were taken in by him with no chance of occurring for some time.
But he knew.
Oh, he closed his eyes as he knew!
HUUUM!
A string of symphonies erupted around him as more and more complexities of Sources were burned just to aid him in severing and purifying a single part of himself, and after some time...
BOOM!
A heavy impact and explosion of complexity that signified grandiosity bloomed.
He crossed a threshold.
His 27 times Severed Heart beat heavily as thick multicolored blood coursed throughout his body.
His 27 times Severed Invictus Wings flickered with brightness as he could see a magisterial result ahead!
He felt his existence buzzing as...
|The Severed Weavings of the Megalos have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of the Megalos has opened.|
|The True Severed Megalos of Existence has been born.|
|Within the True Severed Megalos of Existence, countless changes and variations bloom every second.|
Within his Atlas of Existence, another Mundi glowed with a terrifying light as Noah felt his Complexity shoot up exponentially once more.
His eyes remained closed as he communicated with that budding complexity.
He was seeking to understand the extent of the wonders of what it could do!
He saw...a circular multicolored globe that pulsed like the core of some grand construct even he shouldn't be able to see.
But it was part of him.
|Your True Severed Megalos of Existence is capable of undergoing the process of Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations in order to elevate your Complexity.|

|Your True Severed Megalos of Existence can unleash True Severed Megalocide onto the complexity of your enemies, allowing them to experience the complexity of a Megalocide in a compressed state centered around their weavings of existence.|
Two wonders bloomed as Noah understood them clearly.
They were the fruits of the True Severed Megalos of Existence as at this moment.
In the domain where only he, Ruination, and the Infiniverse Megalos were in.
Before the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence silently burning in the distance!
Noah placed his hand on his chest as he called out.
"Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations."
HUUM!
His body pulsed.
The True Severed Megalos of Existence within him pulsed!
And in the next moment...
SAA!
Around him, other magisterial bodies that looked just like him manifested, and they filled up the space like stellar stars!
Each one held a slightly different colored brilliance.
|A large number of variations and transformations of your weavings have bloomed based on the last major decision made.|
|Each one represents a Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation as at this moment, you can select a single Variation and Transformation to bring to fruition in actuality.|
A shocking weaving of existence.
Noah opened his eyes to find the visages of Ruination and the Infiniverse Megalos Body seemingly frozen while he was alone observing the countless variations of himself.
He looked at one body of his that was shining with an incandescent golden glare.
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of the Protagonist. Contains the variation of the choice of the Protagonist being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of Uncertainty. Contains the variation of the choice of the Uncertainty being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of Kuklos. Contains the variation of the choice of Kuklos being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
Unfathomable Variations and Transformations lay before him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3540 Convergence! IV
paragraphs: Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations.
Noah looked at all the possible variations as each one held its own wonders and intricacies!
He stared at all the possible transformations while his weavings buzzed.
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of Quintessence. Contains the variation of the choice of Quintessence being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of Runes. Contains the variation of the choice of Runes being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of the Rune of Amarantos. Contains the variation of the choice of the Rune of Amarantos being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
[The Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation of Cheats. Contains the variation of the choice of Cheats being taken to the 81st Severing instead of the Megalos.]
Multiple variations.
Multiple transformations!
And each one was there for him to choose as he stared at the bodies of himself with different colored glows and complexity.
He did not hurry as initially, he already had a sequence in mind of what he wanted to do.
Of what could be next after the Megalos.
He floated at the different versions of himself before soon after, he came to stand in front of another body of his that held a devilish smile.
Around it, wondrous glows of colors surrounded everything as they seemed particularly overpowering!
He reached out instinctively and placed his hand behind the head of this body of his, bringing his own head forward as their foreheads came in contact.
HUUUM!

Incandescent multicolored light shone between them, and all around, the many bodies of Variations and Transformations turned into streaks of light that converged onto the one that was chosen, every single one disappearing!
And thereafter, even the one chosen...turned into the brilliance that surged into Noah's body.
|A Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation has been chosen.|
A prompt came.
And horrifically.
Fantastically.
Magisterially!
A Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation that would take another part of Noah to the Final Severed State bloomed within him!
Far from the Megalos of Beyond and Ynnere that were spilling into each other.
In the Palaces of the Wheelomachy within the Expanse.

Sounds of clashing complexities and utterly majestic eruptions of weavings boomed out all around, with control of the Wheelomachy being in line as those standing with Faceless Lifeforms and those not affected or recruited into this cause went head to head.
The fate of far too many things were on the line for this!
This...was the War for the Wheelomachy as with weavings crossing frequencies, it would span out across the Spokes of the Wheel.
"Come on!"
BOOM!
Within one utterly decimated Palace of the Wheelomachy.

Flaming blue strings covered everything as bisected bodies of Faceless Lifeforms lay burning amidst white gold flames, the Greater Source Entity that was Mysara facing the last remaining Greater Source Faceless Lifeform whose body had become a massive dark flaming tower!

Millions of blue flaming strings had wrapped around this tower and continued to constrict, black flames surging out from it as weavings of time, reality, and everything else seemed to be distorting and falling apart around it.
Space decayed and died down as naturally, other weavings should do so as well!
And yet...
The blue flames flickered with stability.
As if their dependence was something far greater.
"You really tried to decay flames that have their Source stemming from the Wheel itself?! Begone!"
The blue flames...instantly became half gold as the intensity was knocked up another octave.
The many strings wrapping around the dark tower constricted as they cut through, a black veil instantly being torn as a defiant cry boomed out from within!
The limbs of the Greater Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform were cut as black mass spilled out from it.
Black mass that combusted into heavy flames right after, trillions of source runes filling white gold flames and burning all around as this area seemed like a crematorium!
The dazzlingly gorgeous woman clad in blue radiance floated at the center of all of this as she calmed her Source while looking around.

She saw dazzling singularities- Purified Source Pearls that were floating above the bodies of the many Faceless Lifeforms she faced as she waved her hands over, invisible strings pulling on the over 20-something Pearls and bringing them to her as she breathed in when they arrived.
"Good stuff..."
Her eyes were bright as she sensed pure weavings of a Source within them, and she began popping them in her mouth like candy as she looked around this decimated area of space.
Where the black tower used to be...the decay of existence seemed too extensive and irreversible as there was only a grayish black space that seemed void of anything.
Time did not flow there.
Reality and weavings did not exist there.
"If left unchecked, will you all turn all the Megalos and Expanse into these dead zones?"
Mysara asked heavily before she shook her head and shot out into the distance.
She was looking for something as she hoped she would not be too late.
The embers of the Flames that showed the scenes of Bob being surrounded.
These embers pulled at her as such a level of power and purity was something she had not expected to see here!
She followed them.
She sought their source as due to the same type of flames burning within her depths, tracking them was relatively easier!
And after some time, she crossed multiple battles within Palaces until she finally came across...
"Tam?"
She called out as she materialized above a juncture between Palaces where between the Flames, a Disciple of Bob observed as Faceless Lifeforms and a Watcher battled two Watchers and their Disciples!
Tam of the Singed turned at his weavings being called by a familiar source. When he looked up, he saw Mysara.
A Greater Source Entity!
She appeared beside him with a sense of confusion in her eyes as she spoke.

"Your weavings of the Singed...have changed. They have become purer...who aided you in this? Who is responsible for these undeniable Embers that nobody has claimed responsibility for among the Singed?"
Who?
Tam of the Singed felt the pristine weavings of the Singed from this powerful Watcher he never realized was a Singed before as if it were the past, he may have looked up towards her reverentially.
But he had seen the flames of the one that Reconstructed him.
He had seen who he believed to be the Origin Singed!
So he looked towards the Greater Source Complexity entity before him and replied with only a cordial sense of respect for another follower of the flow of the Wheel.
"I shall reach out to him and let him know of your interest. If he wishes- if the flow of the Wheel is for a meeting to occur, I will be your facilitator, O Watcher Mysara."
His reply was a calm one.
Yet his reply astonished Mysara as she knew very well the rankings between Singed that would be felt the moment one displayed them!
Those lower in purity and power always listened and followed the lead of those above them.

For Tam to still give her respect and yet not even reveal the identity of the one behind him...did he see him as someone with much greater purity and weavings than even her, a Greater Source Complexity?!
