A Myriad Megalos Variation and Transformation that would take another part of Noah to the Final Severed State bloomed within him!
Far from the Megalos of Beyond and Ynnere that were spilling into each other.
In the Palaces of the Wheelomachy within the Expanse.

Sounds of clashing complexities and utterly majestic eruptions of weavings boomed out all around, with control of the Wheelomachy being in line as those standing with Faceless Lifeforms and those not affected or recruited into this cause went head to head.
The fate of far too many things were on the line for this!
This...was the War for the Wheelomachy as with weavings crossing frequencies, it would span out across the Spokes of the Wheel.
"Come on!"
BOOM!
Within one utterly decimated Palace of the Wheelomachy.

Flaming blue strings covered everything as bisected bodies of Faceless Lifeforms lay burning amidst white gold flames, the Greater Source Entity that was Mysara facing the last remaining Greater Source Faceless Lifeform whose body had become a massive dark flaming tower!

Millions of blue flaming strings had wrapped around this tower and continued to constrict, black flames surging out from it as weavings of time, reality, and everything else seemed to be distorting and falling apart around it.
Space decayed and died down as naturally, other weavings should do so as well!
And yet...
The blue flames flickered with stability.
As if their dependence was something far greater.
"You really tried to decay flames that have their Source stemming from the Wheel itself?!
Begone!"
The blue flames...instantly became half gold as the intensity was knocked up another octave.
The many strings wrapping around the dark tower constricted as they cut through, a black veil instantly being torn as a defiant cry boomed out from within!
The limbs of the Greater Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform were cut as black mass spilled out from it.
Black mass that combusted into heavy flames right after, trillions of source runes filling white gold flames and burning all around as this area seemed like a crematorium!
The dazzlingly gorgeous woman clad in blue radiance floated at the center of all of this as she calmed her Source while looking around.

She saw dazzling singularities- Purified Source Pearls that were floating above the bodies of the many Faceless Lifeforms she faced as she waved her hands over, invisible strings pulling on the over 20-something Pearls and bringing them to her as she breathed in when they arrived.
"Good stuff..."
Her eyes were bright as she sensed pure weavings of a Source within them, and she began popping them in her mouth like candy as she looked around this decimated area of space.
Where the black tower used to be...the decay of existence seemed too extensive and irreversible as there was only a grayish black space that seemed void of anything.
Time did not flow there.
Reality and weavings did not exist there.
"If left unchecked, will you all turn all the Megalos and Expanse into these dead zones?"
Mysara asked heavily before she shook her head and shot out into the distance.
She was looking for something as she hoped she would not be too late.
The embers of the Flames that showed the scenes of Bob being surrounded.
These embers pulled at her as such a level of power and purity was something she had not expected to see here!
She followed them.
She sought their source as due to the same type of flames burning within her depths, tracking them was relatively easier!
And after some time, she crossed multiple battles within Palaces until she finally came across...
"Tam?"
She called out as she materialized above a juncture between Palaces where between the Flames, a Disciple of Bob observed as Faceless Lifeforms and a Watcher battled two Watchers and their Disciples!
Tam of the Singed turned at his weavings being called by a familiar source.
When he looked up, he saw Mysara.
A Greater Source Entity!
She appeared beside him with a sense of confusion in her eyes as she spoke.
"Your weavings of the Singed...have changed.
They have become purer...who aided you in this?
Who is responsible for these undeniable Embers that nobody has claimed responsibility for among the Singed?"
Who?
Tam of the Singed felt the pristine weavings of the Singed from this powerful Watcher he never realized was a Singed before as if it were the past, he may have looked up towards her reverentially.
But he had seen the flames of the one that Reconstructed him.
He had seen who he believed to be the Origin Singed!
So he looked towards the Greater Source Complexity entity before him and replied with only a cordial sense of respect for another follower of the flow of the Wheel.
"I shall reach out to him and let him know of your interest.
If he wishes- if the flow of the Wheel is for a meeting to occur, I will be your facilitator, O Watcher Mysara."
His reply was a calm one.
Yet his reply astonished Mysara as she knew very well the rankings between Singed that would be felt the moment one displayed them!
Those lower in purity and power always listened and followed the lead of those above them.

For Tam to still give her respect and yet not even reveal the identity of the one behind him...did he see him as someone with much greater purity and weavings than even her, a Greater Source Complexity?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3541 Convergence! V
paragraphs: Mysara stared at Tam as if she couldn't believe that he had met someone outside of those that she knew and that they would have a level of purity and complexity related to the Flame of the Wheel of Existence that even exceeded hers.
But she knew there were many oddities and wonders of the Wheel as she would not be too averse to it.
So she simply nodded at Tam as she looked around at the chaos still unfolding from the hands of Faceless Lifeforms.
She remained where she was while her hands struck out as if she were playing at the piano, and radiant blue strings burning with scorching blue flames erupted out and shot into the distance!

For the Weavings of Existence, every single entity had a part to play. These Faceless Lifeforms and whatever mission they thought they were accomplishing were also part of the Weaving of the Wheel, even if they were trying to go against it...they simply did not know.
As she sniped off and attacked those that she could in the distance, the figure of Tam blinked beside her before he smiled and stated simply.
"It seems that the flow of the Wheel is favorable towards this, and the Origin Singed is also interested in meeting you."
The Origin Singed!
Mysara heard this name as she was initially alarmed before turning somber. Such a thing was not what she expected to hear at this moment in time.
Origin.

When attached to any term, this was something far too pristine to even imagine as, at this moment, she became even more unfathomably curious about what being would exactly be called something like that when they were not part of those she knew!
"Follow me please."
Tam smiled as a golden rift of fire opened up beside him, and he stepped into it silently and left behind the chaos and war of the Wheelomachy!
Within the Megalos Ynnere.

Across an unknown number of Omniverses, there was the Omniverse of the Protectors that had faced the assault of Faceless Lifeforms and come out on the other side safe due to the intervention of an entity bathed in flames.
Tam of the Singed!
An entity that stemmed from the weavings of someone they actually knew.

Old Man Eudemus had a blank expression as he looked at what remained of the Commonwealth. Since at this moment...he confirmed that he could no longer communicate with the weavings of the Sword of the Commonwealth or anybody else from Omniverse X-1. Around him, there were Protectors in mourning as they looked at the desolation around them. Their eyes were filled with a fierce light of rage and a sense of stupefaction as they also lived with the gray cracks in space and the lowered Atmospheric Weavings of Existence.
Old Man Eudemus looked past all of this as he thought of the reconstruction of the Omnifather and the Tresoverse Primaltree of Existence.
He thought of the Omnifather and other powerful weavings.
He wondered of all the ancient powers that stemmed from the Megalos Ynnere as he found himself asking...where were they now?!
In his state of desolation, he pulled down something from the depths of his weavings that the core leaders of the commonwealth were given- only to be taken out in states of emergencies.
It was a crystalline medallion that was forged with the likeness of the simians as, at this moment, its calm eyes were glowing with a crimson light that only meant a single thing.

This item was called the Core of the Commonwealth as Old Man Eudemus held one, the Sword of the Commonwealth held another, and all previous rulers of the Commonwealth who came and went would also hold one!
The red glow meant the other two had their weavings either destroyed or lost.
So Old Man Eudemus sent his weavings in as the Core of the Commonwealth activated, and a major part of his weavings were pulled into it.
When he reappeared, he found himself in a space that was filled with golden clouds stretching out in all directions, and the only person here was the lone figure of the Sword of the Commonwealth.
His Simian features were younger and less complex even though his eyes held the same level of hardness, pride, and arrogance!
He looked towards Old Man Eudemus- the Shield of the Commonwealth, as he began to speak.
"Our Commonwealth...held a great purpose. Our task was an important one as if I am here, it means that everything has collapsed and the very weavings of these Megalos run the risk of being lost."
A somber statement as there was a moment of silence thereafter.

"You and I never truly saw eye to eye, Eudemus. But even if it is you, it is more than enough to see whether we can save these Megalos from certain destruction, and possibly continue the lineage of the Commonwealth. The purpose handed down since ancient times..."
The Remnant Weavings of the Sword of the Commonwealth spoke out as Old Man Eudemus listened calmly.

"One of the things that we found, which the forces of the Outerversal Morphons found out about from obtaining access to our core forces over the years...was a Phantom Trace of the Wheel of Existence itself."
WAA!

"This tracing was something too profound as the Founders of the Commonwealth did not share exactly where they obtained it, but it was within the Heart of these Megalos themselves! Since the day that we obtained this tracing; we have kept that location secret and hidden as we felt that if it was ever exposed, the type of power that could be unleashed was something these Megalos could not possibly handle. Whether the continuation of the eons to come remained or became entirely destroyed...depends on us."

"Head to the Heart of the Megalos Ynnere. Unveil entirely what we were too scared to take out before. If a mere Phantom Trace of the Wheel could grant us so much power, with the treasure within fully unveiled and under our control...the revival and sustenance of the Commonwealth is guaranteed under you, Old Friend Eudemus."
The Heart of the Megalos Ynnere!

chapters.title: Chapter 3542 Convergence! VI
paragraphs: A secret the Founders of the Commonwealth kept veiled until today.
And now, it fell in the hands of Old Man Eudemus as he received weavings of information of a certain location within these Megalos!
His eyes were hazy as his whole life, he had been looking for a solution.
A solution to a problem of three parts.
The Three Body Problem! At this moment, in the depths of desolation and loss, he wondered if he went to that place...would it have the answer that he sought?
He sat in contemplation for some time. And moments after he received the weavings of a certain location, Old Man Eudemus set off alone from the Omniverse of the Protectors.
He did not know that on the other side of the Megalos, a man had raised his fist and brought down an insurmountable veil that had been filled with countless threads of white gold flames!
He did not know that a possible variation of an answer to a question he was seeking the answers to may have actually appeared in a distant place.
His eyes were set elsewhere as he went to what he knew to be...the Heart of the Megalos.

On the other side of the Megalos where at this moment, a deluge of Matter and Dark Matter mixed in all at once. In the center of all of this, the figure of Ozymandias looked at the cluster of remaining Source Complexity entities.
Every single one of them was burning with Embers of his True Severed Singed Flame of Existence as this alone was not enough to entirely wipe out even a Lesser Source Entity.
The utilization of the Tzar Versepiercer made many more things possible as its impact could disrupt the weavings of the Source enough to heavily increase the damage.
But even then, he could not instantly kill even Lesser Sources.
His perspective when it came to defeating enemies was being capable of killing them in a few moves, as this would mean a domination of complexity and a one-sided beating.
He did not like fights that dragged out for even longer than a few seconds as that would mean that the difference in complexity was too big and that he was simply wasting his time there.

After a few more minutes, or even a few more hours, or at most a day or 2 passed...his complexity would have likely risen enough for him to not need to spend even a second on the enemies that he could not defeat before!
And such a thing was exactly what happened at this moment as the Map of the Megalos Ynnere was gradually changing.
It was expanding as with the fracture of the veil between Matter and Dark Matter matter, what was known to be Megalos Beyond was gradually becoming part and mixing with Megalos Ynnere.

So the map was becoming singular in nature as at this moment, the names of the Source Complexity entities from the Palaces of the Expanse became clear. They were red to indicate greater complexity, but at this time...the spread color gradually faded away and turned into an orange brilliance.
Orange!
An indication of similarity in terms of Complexity as they may pose a level of danger, but it was nothing major for him.
This came as a result of another Pathway to a True Source being opened as after Singed, the Pathway to the True Source of the Megalos bloomed!
Alongside their emergence were the Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations as, at this very moment, another path was selected and chosen to be an actuality.
During such a time.

Noah's weavings coursed through the other part of him that was Ozymandias as he looked at the Source Complexity entities here, especially the three most grievously injured ones as he called out in a voice that felt like the ringing bells of the end!
"True Severed Megalocide."
HUUM!
He repeated it three times.
His weavings trembled three times as a significant usage of authority was detected.
And...
Above three injured Lesser Sources, their weavings looked up in alarm as they saw...clusters of millions of miniaturized multicolored Omniverses and Pantheons bloom.
Millions.

And each one was akin to a grain of sand in size, all of them unfurling and blanketing the Lesser Sources like a globe as before they could even blink or have their weavings erupt, their bodies were encapsulated inside a circular cluster of millions of multicolored Omniverses and Pantheons!
Their Sources felt a sense of trepidation as they exploded out, but not before the millions of miniaturized Omniverses and Pantheons lit up and began to burn as they exploded an instant later!
They burned and cried out as they emulated a tremendous loss of life.
They burned as if they were releasing the lives of countless quintillions.
They burned with rage, and they burned with anger!

Millions of Omniverses and Pantheons burned and shattered as they caused the makeshift Megalos they were in to under Megalocide, with all this complexity and pressure directed to those contained within those Megalos!
BOOOM!

Three explosions thundered out, and they were followed by an eruption of a storm of Matter and Dark Matter as chunks of Omniverses and Pantheons suddenly emerged from the explosion and filled up the surrounding space.

It was a scene of utter beauty and horror as it seemed very real, Outerversal Morphons and those from the Palaces of the Expanse spreading out their weavings to see all space around them now filled with a sense of cataclysm and decimation as a deluge of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons flowed.
A deluge of remnants of Megalos.
A deluge brought about through miniaturized Megalocides!
As for those who were at the epicenter of the explosion of a Megalocide...
|The Lesser Source Entity, Alarkan, has been laid to rest.|
|The Lesser Source Entity, Zomana, has been laid to rest.|
|The Lesser Source Entity, Einhart, has been laid to rest.|
|The Source Pearls and weavings of the collapsed Sources are being collected into your weavings.|
As cataclysmic shattered deluge of Omniverses and Pantheons spread around them.
The few remaining Lesser Sources from Palaces of the Expanse affirmed that around them, the burning Sources of three of their peers...were no more.
They were actually collapsed entirely as at this moment, the weavings of Existence around them fully changed as the position of the hunter and prey...changed entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 3543 A Product of Weavings Across Frequencies! I
paragraphs: It was a momentous occasion of deadly significance.

All around them, a deluge of decimated Omniverses and Pantheons stretched out like a dead sea- each of them utterly filled with dense weavings of Matter and Dark Matter as such a sea caused everything nearby to feel heavy and thick.
These cataclysmic stretches of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons seemed to be wailing, an untold number of weavings of Existence crying within as if they were real.
As if they had truly undergone a Megalocide!
Figures with Less complexity, like the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young, were dazed at such a sight as they could not even start understanding how this was possible.
"What a profound state of existence..."

Noah was introspective as his voice was low, and yet it resonated outwards to all entities here- the Pioneers and below who were not deemed enemies and were still alive, and the remaining Source Complexity entities who stemmed from the Palaces of the Expanse.
They didn't know what his words meant, but he was thinking about entities like the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young.
He had met them just a few days ago when he entered the Megalos Beyond.
A few days.
They were many times stronger than him, and yet in that period of time...they were now mere backdrops.
Just additions to his Fable.
He knew this was an arrogant way of thinking as these beings were alive for cycles- billions of years before him.
But because he held the Severed Weavings of the Protagonist.
Because he held Quintessence.
Because he held Fable.
If he did not truly believe and act as the Protagonist, such a weaving would collapse!
So beings who held their own lives before him. Their own complexities. He could pass them all in a matter of days as thereafter, they could only watch his own.
And apart from them...there were the Source Complexities from the Palaces of the Expanse that remained burning on his Embers.
He spoke once more as his thoughts went to them.
"You cultivated your complexities for eons, only to throw them away like this."
HUUM!

As he spoke, he raised his hand and clenched. The Source Complexities burned by his Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence were lighted brightly within the deluge of the cataclysmic sea of Matter and Dark Matter, their fingers burning with bright flames as many eyes fell on them!
There were 13 such beings burning brightly.
The Golden Titan with a single eye had his skin torn and bleeding gold blood, with his gaze ferocious as he stared towards Noah.
"Even to this moment, you are defiant, O Golden Titan. Let me see...Barbaram of the Golden Sea Titan lineage. I will aid you in finishing your story."
WAA!
The gaze of the Golden Titan became filled with malice.
He held a Lesser Source.
He was not the only one of the Golden Titans lineage, but he was the one here.
He was the one trapped under complex weavings ensuring everything in this region!
Yes.
The reason why all remaining 13 Lesser Source Entities were still here was not because they were still thinking of continuing to battle and obtain the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
They were not leaving because they could not leave!
Since after the deaths of three Lesser Sources simultaneously, unique weavings had settled down that even they could not deny with their Sources.
They did not know what these weavings were, but it was the display of the Quintessential League of Existence.
Those entangled could not leave.
And if the man they came to seek the weavings of would decimate three of them in a single move, what of them?
These were their thoughts.
But they did not sit still.
They were still Lesser Source entities as they would fight to their last breath!

So even in the face of this inexplicable unfolding of weavings...their brightly lit bodies could actually be seen getting closer to each other until twelve Lesser Sources converged around the Golden Titan, Barbaram.
Six on either side.
Because they knew they would either die alone...or try and survive together as every single one communicated with their residual forces in the Expanse!
The Golden Titan, Barbaram, had his singular eye burning with Embers as he growled out in a low tone.
"There are others far exceeding us holding interest in the weavings of Megalonians. Even if our Sources collapse here today, you will join us soon enough."
Barbaram stated a terrifying weavings as towards it...
"I know."
Noah's weavings within Ozymandias simply nodded.
He knew.
The Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather he had met briefly had stated it.
That they would come for him. But he never specified who they were.
Their complexity was bound to be stupendous as he was not fearful of them, so he simply told Barbaram he knew!
And also...
"I will wait for them just like I waited for you."
He made his intent clear as after this, no words needed to be exchanged anymore.
The Lesser Source, Barbaram, bellowed out as he set his incandescent Source aflame.
His own burning to promote rapid power.
Massive small golden mountains arose behind him to create an entire Palace of gold mountains- each one carrying the weight of a percentage of a Megalos as they supported him in his endeavor.
The other Lesser Sources sought to do the same as after measuring the complexity Ozymandias displayed; they determined that escape may still be possible...if all their Sources worked together.
This was based on the current weavings of Ozymandias they felt!
They acted based on this!
Noah looked at all of them, ready to unveil another set of wonders to end things when...
"Oh?"
He blinked and stopped as he turned towards a certain direction.
The expanding Map of the Megalos that now included Ynnere and Beyond showed something that pulled his attention.
It was...something glaring bright red.

It was something that stopped veiling itself the moment that his gaze turned towards it, its crimson eyes flashing with disappointment as if its plan of waiting for him to make a move before it unleashed a deadly strike was ruined!
Ozymandias looked at it as he recalled its features from a certain dream.
He was genuinely surprised at its appearance and crimson radiance that even far exceeded Persephael as he wondered!
Where did this creature distinguished as [The Inheritor of the Megalos] appear from?!

These cataclysmic stretches of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons seemed to be wailing, an untold number of weavings of Existence crying within as if they were real.
As if they had truly undergone a Megalocide!
Figures with Less complexity, like the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young, were dazed at such a sight as they could not even start understanding how this was possible.
"What a profound state of existence..."

Noah was introspective as his voice was low, and yet it resonated outwards to all entities here- the Pioneers and below who were not deemed enemies and were still alive, and the remaining Source Complexity entities who stemmed from the Palaces of the Expanse.
They didn't know what his words meant, but he was thinking about entities like the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young.
He had met them just a few days ago when he entered the Megalos Beyond.
A few days.
They were many times stronger than him, and yet in that period of time...they were now mere backdrops.
Just additions to his Fable.
He knew this was an arrogant way of thinking as these beings were alive for cycles- billions of years before him.
But because he held the Severed Weavings of the Protagonist.
Because he held Quintessence.
Because he held Fable.
If he did not truly believe and act as the Protagonist, such a weaving would collapse!
So beings who held their own lives before him.
Their own complexities.

He spoke once more as his thoughts went to them.
"You cultivated your complexities for eons, only to throw them away like this."
HUUM!

There were 13 such beings burning brightly.

Those entangled could not leave.

These were their thoughts.

They were still Lesser Source entities as they would fight to their last breath!

Six on either side.

chapters.title: Chapter 3544 A Product of Weavings Across Frequencies! II
paragraphs: The Inheritor of the Megalos.

Noah saw such a distinction as the more he looked towards this creature, the more he recognized it as its body came to full view amidst the deluge of cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons.
"I know you."

The voice of Ozymandias was heavy and light at the same time, the one hidden past the dredges of the sea of a Megalocide becoming clear to all...alongside its terrifying aura of trepidation that caused even Lesser Sources to turn somber!
"I know you very well too, O Deceiver."
WAA!
Its voice.
Its voice felt like layers of thousands of voices!
Ancient! Deep!
Apart from its voice, its body radiated a terrifying pressure that pushed away the obsidian sea.

It was an entity floating on four legs, obsidian horns etched with millions of Source Runes of Existence rising on either side of its head as it held two massive serpentine crimson eyes. Wings spanned behind its back and stretched out towards the horizon, layers of millions of illusory pantheons seemingly placed together to form these wings alone.

The aura it emanated...was too unique and different from many others as it contained an unknown sense of suffocation and might, with one of the more daring and ridiculous things being the fact that while standing in the midst of Matter and Dark Matter, both seemed to be swirling around this entity as if it was in tune with both without issues!
Ozymandias looked at this creature as he replied with shining eyes.
"A Deceiver? Me?"
His singularities blinked gloriously. Since it came to this, then let it all be out.
The Entity termed the Inheritor of the Megalos looked towards him with a deadly glare as above it, incalculable quintillions of thin lines stretching out in all directions could barely be seen.
Only a portion of them seemed to stretch out towards these Megalos Beyond as the vast remaining amount seemed to be heading elsewhere entirely!

"You are nothing but a Deceiver that sought to take my name. Across weavings...across frequencies, the Inheritance left behind by the Great Beyonder was being depleted by you. Today, I have found your source as this deception will finally be put to rest! O False Instrument, O Deceiver. You stand before the True Instrument of the Beyonder. The Inheritor of the Megalos. The Inheritor of the Will Stretched Across Frequencies! The time has come to finally lay your deception to rest as your Source shall collapse across all weavings..."
Its deep voice seemed to be filled with unfathomable anger and rage, the Great Mother and other Outerversal Morphons hearing it and looking up in shock.

And yet in response to this, Ozymandias remained unbothered as he merely nodded towards the massive figure of the Inheritor of the Megalos before turning his gaze back to the 13 Lesser Source Entities burning with his Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.
"I shall finish my entanglement with these 13 first, you can then come next."
His reply was nonchalant in comparison to the majesty and dignity that the Inheritor of the Megalos displayed!
The disrespect.
The tyrannical demeanor!
It was astounding as the Inheritor of the Megalos began to tremble with an unfathomable weaving that seemed to change from multiple complexities.
From an Existence Severing entity to a Pioneer, to a Source Complexity. All of it seemed to flash around this creature all at once as it was eerie to observe!
"Do you truly think I will still allow you to move freely and do what you wish?"
Such eerie weaving of Complexity declared.

Its might and heaviness seemed utterly unfathomable as briefly, the Golden Titan Barbaram and other Lesser Sources momentarily breathed a sigh of relief as it seemed like this new entrant would muddy the waters a bit!
And yet...
Around Ozymandias, the weavings of existence began to distort in a way that nobody here had seen before.
And Ozymandias nodded with tyrannical majesty on whether he would still be able to move freely!
"Of this, I am confident of."
The moment he stopped speaking...his body trembled before it gushed out incandescent cerulean radiance.
Cerulean.
Blue!
A glorious, gorgeous blue chosen from the Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations!
It had pulsed with a devilish glint as the moment that possibility attained it; it could not help but think of all the atrocities that could be committed with such a choice.
It was something he started with a long, long time ago.
|A choice has been actualized from the Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations.|
|The Severed Weavings of Infinity have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Infinity has opened.|
The grandeur of the blue brilliance was so intense that even the Sources watching Ozymandias could not confidently say they knew the extent of it.
DUM!
They all felt the beat of a heart.
DUM!
Not just here, but the sound and intent of this heartbeat echoed out from this area and continued on across the nearby Megalos!
DUM!
The Lesser Sources here heard it as they felt a sense of trepidation.
The Inheritor of the Megalos heard it as he became somber, his weavings roaring out as he could not allow this Deciever to take center stage once more!
And yet the beat of that Heart...was too resonant!
DUM!
His roars were drowned out.
In the Megalos Ynnere, the figure of Persephael and McAllister with their Faceless Lifeforms hovering around them...also heard the heavy beat of a heart.
"What the fuck is that?"
Persephael shone with a gem like luster as she turned her head towards the area they had already begun to feel unique weavings from.
There, the heavy beat of a Heart could be heard even from afar!
DUM!
At a distant point in the Megalos Ynnere.
The visage of Old Man arrived at an area that had absolutely nothing, his heart filled with expectations as he thought of many things.
He knew his complexity.
He understood his limitations.
On his way here, he wondered about reaching out to that being who had sent a Pioneer to save him and many others.
He thought of the weavings of Noah Osmont and wondered whether something as fantastical as this...should be brought to him!
But...he was an entity too.
He also held dreams and aspirations, and he also wanted answers.
He felt like he lost something when he made that decision, but he continued regardless as he was about to activate the Core of the Commonwealth.
Before he did...
DUM!
He heard a heavy beat of a Heart.
He turned towards its direction as his gaze turned somber.
And where all gazes gathered.
The origin of the beat of the Heart that was allowed to resound heavily.
A prompt rose up.
|The True Severed Heart of Infinity has been born.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3545 A Heart! I
paragraphs: The True Severed Heart of Infinity!
This was the beat that was spreading out across the Megalos like a bell- as if it was letting its birth be known!
The complexity of this Pathway to the True Source of Infinity was unfathomably grand as when others looked at the brilliant blue light, they could not properly estimate its complexity.
It seemed to be as big or as small as their complexities could understand it- and at times it didn't even emanate any complexity at all.
But it was there.
It was radiant!
|Your True Severed Heart of Infinity is capable of infusing a Severed Infinitum Engine onto certain complex weavings of existence.|

|Your True Severed Heart of Infinity has granted you a Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity. A minute, hour, day, or week may not pass without your complexity undergoing a random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.|
The Infusion of Severed Infinitum Engine.
The gain of the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.
Two things.
They did not seem too crazy, but how were they really in practice?
Why did the cerulean grandeur of Infinity cause such tension for those watching when it was just a Pathway?!
As of this moment, he held three Pathways to a True Source.
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, the Pathway to the True Source of the Megalos, and the Pathway to the True Source of Infinity!

The moment that Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations finished to allow the variation of Infinity to be chosen, the dazzling circular multicolored globe within his Mundi of Power dimmed slightly as it could not be used to activate the Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations for some time.
But this time was not known. For an hour? Half a day? A Week?
It was not known.
But in addition to this, there was now the state of Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.
It was not known.
But in addition to this, there was now the state of Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.
A minute, hour, day, or week may not pass without his complexity undergoing a random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity!
This alone held a lot of unknowns and ridiculousness.
"But let us see the infusion of the Severed Infinitum Engine first, shall we?"
His gaze turned towards the 13 Lesser Sources who were staring as the endless brilliance of blue rising from him that affected the cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons nearby!
The moment his eyes honed in on them, they felt their sources pulse as Barbaram and the other twelve released everything they had.
And from the distance...
"I told you, do you truly think I would still allow you to move freely?!"
The Inheritor of the Megalos roared as a dazzling sword began to form from the surrounding Megalos themselves.
It was a technique capable of being attained in a Crucible of the Beyonder.
It was the Sword of the Megalos!
It occupied an eighth of all the space here as it even pulled in the cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons!
It even pulled in Matter and Dark Matter as it pulsed with shocking complexity.
Yet towards this and the 13 Lesser Sources...Noah only spoke out calmly.
"True Severed Megalocide."
He called out True Severed Megalocide multiple times.

Each time caused the True Severed Megalos of Existence within him to pulse weakly as it released this shocking collapse of an incalculable number of quintillions of complexities, Omniverses, and Pantheons shattering simultaneously!
Three True Severed Megalocides bloomed around the Thirteen Lesser Sources as they roared out brilliantly with their own Sources.
A fourth True Severed Megalocide bloomed on the path of the forming Sword of the Megalos!
Countless millions of Omniverses and Pantheons bloomed in a globe before they shattered, releasing immense wails and loss of life. Countless weavings of burning, rageful complexities!
And as they bloomed, Noah continued to speak out.
"Severed Infinitum Engine."
|A True Severed Megalocide has been granted a Severed Infinitum Engine.|
|A True Severed Megalocide has been granted a Severed Infinitum Engine.|
|A True....|
The prompts rang out four times for all the Megalocides present.

All four released their interminable and heavy complexities before they exploded into waves of cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons that oppressively permeated the surroundings, causing the concentration of Matter and Dark Matter to become even denser!

In the dark obsidian seas, the figures of the Thirteen Lesser Sources looked ragged as the Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence permeated even deeper into their sources, but they were alive.
They roared with magnificence as this gave them a sense of hope, and they were about to erupt out when...
BZZT!
From the same positions where three Megalocides had just bloomed.
An image of a gorgeous cerulean heart flashed.
DUM!
The beat of a Severed Infinitum Engine echoed out!
And...
Three identical Megalocides to what just bloomed not too long ago bloomed again.
As if it was just that easy to cause them to bloom again!

In front of the tip of the massive Sword of the Megalos, its radiant sheen had dimmed somewhat after it was impacted by a Megalocide, but it maintained its solidity as it was about to thunder out again.
But....
DUM!
A beat of a heart.
A Severed Infinitum Engine flashed as a moment later, another True Severed Megalocide bloomed.
BOOM!
These explosions of heavy complexity were utterly maddening as every time they ended, they released a deluge of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons akin to vast expanding seas all around!
And after they finished exploding...
DUM!
A heart would beat.
And the Megalocide would bloom again right after!
After the second round, the 13 Lesser Sources were no longer 13 as four had their weavings overwhelmed and collapsed from the onslaught of three surrounding Megalocides.
The howl of Barbaram echoed out as it was filled with indignation and pain, his single eye observing that somehow, the heavy attack that could injure Sources was forming yet again

All four released their interminable and heavy complexities before they exploded into waves of cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons that oppressively permeated the surroundings, causing the concentration of Matter and Dark Matter to become even denser!

In the dark obsidian seas, the figures of the Thirteen Lesser Sources looked ragged as the Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence permeated even deeper into their sources, but they were alive.
They roared with magnificence as this gave them a sense of hope, and they were about to erupt out when...
BZZT!
From the same positions where three Megalocides had just bloomed.
An image of a gorgeous cerulean heart flashed.
DUM!
The beat of a Severed Infinitum Engine echoed out!
And...
Three identical Megalocides to what just bloomed not too long ago bloomed again.
As if it was just that easy to cause them to bloom again!

In front of the tip of the massive Sword of the Megalos, its radiant sheen had dimmed somewhat after it was impacted by a Megalocide, but it maintained its solidity as it was about to thunder out again.
But....
DUM!
A beat of a heart.
A Severed Infinitum Engine flashed as a moment later, another True Severed Megalocide bloomed.
BOOM!
These explosions of heavy complexity were utterly maddening as every time they ended, they released a deluge of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons akin to vast expanding seas all around!
And after they finished exploding...
DUM!
A heart would beat.
And the Megalocide would bloom again right after!
After the second round, the 13 Lesser Sources were no longer 13 as four had their weavings overwhelmed and collapsed from the onslaught of three surrounding Megalocides.
The howl of Barbaram echoed out as it was filled with indignation and pain, his single eye observing that somehow, the heavy attack that could injure Sources was forming yet again

chapters.title: Chapter 3546 A Heart! II
paragraphs: Even though they could also release their Sources unceasingly, theirs were not as complex and could not match the blooming Megalocides that seemed to never end!
BOOM!
A Megalocide exploded.
And...BOOM!
It continued to explode.
Once. Twice.
Thrice!
And it was not stopping! It would not stop.
The beat of a terrifying Severed Infinitum Engine could be heard each time, but with this granted to the True Severed Megalocides- they would continue to repeat and occur here!
"How many times?!"
A roar of a Lesser Source close to perishing howled out.
"For how long?!"
Another voice filled with indignation echoed out.
But they did not receive an answer, only the beat of a heart followed by another exploding Megalocide!
In front of the Sword of the Megalos, multiple Megalocides had exploded as this sword...now held tears and lost its solidity after multiple rounds of explosions.

The Inheritor of the Megalos looked at such a scene with a meaningful glare as in the surroundings, endless droves of deluge of cataclysmic seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons spread out more and more- the concentration of Matter and Dark Matter reaching interminable levels as if one paid enough attention at this moment...they would observe that there were barely any cracks in this region currently.
But the Inheritor of the Megalos continued to observe the domination of the Deceiver as he could not let it continue anymore!
His eyes burned and flashed with a dazzling obsidian gold Wheel as he roared out.
"ENOUGH!"
HUUUM!
And with him as the center, everything began to freeze in place.
The dense seas of Matter and Dark Matter.
The ragged and beaten Lesser Sources in the distance!
Everything....slowed and came to a grinding halt.
On the body of the Inheritor of the Megalos, millions of Runes began to shine as it looked ferociously towards Ozymandias.
Amidst everything frozen...his body became covered by an incandescent white gold flame. By an illusion of a multicolored globe. By a sea of blue that continued to emanate from him unfettered!
All of these...caused his figure to freely stare towards the Inheritor of the Megalos while remaining unfrozen!
The Inheritor of the Megalos looked towards him with tremendous distaste as its intent echoed out.

"My profound hatred of you does not stem from your existence not what you stand for. It is simply the fact that you sought to be someone you were not without a care for that this did. For this...your weavings must collapse."
Its voice was layered with many voices across frequencies as at this moment...
"Amarantos Nightmare."
HUUUM!
The body of the Inheritor of the Megalos began to shine and radiate interminable brilliance.

Millions of Runes of Existence shone around it as it called out a technique from the Great Beyonder himself- another side of the Amarantos Dream as it took a tremendous amount of a Source to simply activate it!
As this unfolded.
The Megalocides that were initially frozen in place...slowly began to burn hotter and hotter with white gold flames and cerulean waves of radiance until...
BOOM!
They resumed even in that frozen space.
As they did...they covered the frozen weavings of the remaining Lesser Sources here who, at this time, could not properly even defend themselves.
Already wartorn with their Sources gravely injured, the result was a simple one as it even seemed like the Inheritor of the Megalos gave an assist!
|The Lesser Source Entity, Barbaram, has been laid to rest.|
|The Lesser Source Entity, Alzana, has been laid to rest.|
|The Lesser Source Entity, Viktor, has been laid to rest.|
|The Leeser...|
|The Source Pearls and weavings of the collapsed Sources are being collected into your weavings.|
All 13 Lesser Source Entities became decimated as their weavings were pulled towards Noah!
It was only now he fully turned his attention towards the Inheritor of the Megalos as he said he would.
"Now you can have my attention, O Inheritor of the Megalos."
WAA!
The level of disrespect was utterly heavy as the eyes of the Inheritor flashed coldly, the Amarantos Nightmare blooming around it as...
"EEE!"

Obsidian lifeforms bloomed around it and bellowed silent screams as they looked similar to Ozymandias, but their bodies were entirely black and half solid as they seemed to be made up of an unknown number of Source Runes!

They bellowed out as they sought to imitate everything displayed in the current weavings of existence- blue radiance beginning to shine around them as, by the dozens, they pointed their hands towards Ozymandias and burst with complexity!
And instantly.
Around Ozymandias, over a dozen dazzling reconstructions of Megalocides bloomed.
Megalocides!
The weavings of existence he utilized were being recreated by the Amarantos Nightmares!
BOOM!
They exploded simultaneously- all twelve imitating to release bursts of manifestations of genuine Megalocides as...
BZZT!
Instead of the explosions continuing and decimating this place, they shockingly fizzled out an instant later as if the weavings of existence could not carry out such an action.
They could not recreate what Ozymandias put out!
The Inheritor of the Megalos looked towards this with maddening eyes as Ozymandias continued to observe the eruption of True Severed Megalocides, his words booming out.
"Even in your worst nightmares, you cannot imitate my weavings!"
WAA!
"Are you truly severed to be capable of initiating a True Severed Megalocide?! Even if you are true, your weavings remain false, O Inheritor of the Megalos!"

Around the body of the Inheritor of the Megalos, that were surrounded by apparations of Amarantos Nightmares of Ozymandias himself, multiple terrifying bursts of True Severed Megalocides erupted as each one became filled with the Severed Infinitum Engine.
DUM!

The beats of a heart were clear as terrific bursts that could injure and decimate Lesser Sources began to unfold and would repeat again and again, with unknown, far reaching, and far lasting effects beginning to unfold at this moment as...

From all the Megalocides exploding and being repeated again and again due to the Severed Infinitum Engine, the seas of shattered Omniverses and Pantheons spread out madly all around and continued to cover nearby regions of the Megalos.
Both the joining Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond!
At this moment, a deluge of Matter and Dark Matter in the form of a cataclysmic sea began to spill out and stretch out across the Megalos!

chapters.title: Chapter 3547 Infinitum! I
paragraphs: Severed Infinitum Engine.
It showed the ridiculous effect of repeating an action as if it would never stop occurring.
At this moment, multiple Megalocides exploded out in this region where the veil between the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond was torn.
The weavings of Matter and Dark Matter in this region became richer and richer.
The gray cracks of the change...were reduced and thin as the lowered Atmospheric Weavings of Existence returned to extremely rich levels!
As all of this occurred, the only audience was the Outerversal Morphons, who heard an entity called the Inheritor of the Megalos appear and call Ozymandias a Deciever.
An imposter.
And Ozymandias did not deny it!
He even stated the words that even if the Inheritor of the Megalos was true, his weavings would remain false.
What did that mean?

The tentacles of the Great Mother were trembling as she and many others watched the explosions in the distance, their surroundings already touched by waves of the obsidian shattered Omniverses and Pantheons that were so decimated that they seemed to be in a half liquid half solid form.
"All of this...stems from Ozymandias. The...Instrument of the Beyonder..."
The intent of the Great Mother echoed out with a sense of hesitation as her weavings buzzed while she questioned many things!
In her mind, she only had one question repeating again and again.
'O Great Instrument...why did you not deny it?!'
Why did he not deny the words of the one calling himself the Inheritor of the Megalos?! The one that stated he was the True Instrument of the Beyonder?!
Beside her, Little Aspasia appeared as she uttered out without hesitation.

"He matched all the signs, Great Mother. It was stated that under his banner, the Megalos Beyond would either perish or expand beyond measure. What is happening right now, Great Mother? The veil between the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere has been shattered! And this..."
Little Aspasia grabbed the viscous liquid all around them into her hands, letting it freely fall onto her body as she continued!

"A rich and boundless expanding sea of Dark Matter. Of Matter. It has caused the cracks around us to fade away as his actions alone are changing the very landscape of the Megalos Beyond. To me, he remains and will always be the Instrument of the Beyonder!"
WAA!
Her words were resonant as they even traveled across the obsidian seas to be heard by the distant Inheritor of the Megalos.
It heard this as it could not help but roar in maddening anger, the Amarantos Nightmares of Ozymandias around it becoming even more solidified as it sought to establish and replicate its weavings!
It knew that its Source was much more complex than Ozymandias currently.
It knew this being had many oddities as he had to move fast!
So...
The serpentine crimson eyes of the Inheritor of the Megalos closed as it breathed in.
It breathed in the obsidian sea born from Ozymandias himself.
It breathed in the weavings of the Megalos Beyond.
And after this single breath...
"O Megalos."
HUUUM!
"O Beyond."
The surroundings began to shake and tremble.
The Inheritor of the Megalos...called upon the Megalos he was supposed to Inherit from the Great Beyonder!
"I Call Thee, My Inheritance. The blood and flesh of the Megalos. The source of the Pantheons that weep at injustice! Rage! Impose! Mystify! O Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder!"
A lengthy call out that caused the weavings of others to shudder.
It was a call out that was heard by many- including two groups that were finally arriving here.
From the side of the Megalos Ynnere, the stern figures of Persephael and McAllister appeared as they isolated their bodies from the rich obsidian sea spreading out everywhere.
They arrived to hear the declarations of the Inheritor of the Megalos as behind it, it seemed like all of the Megalos Beyond expanding out to the horizon...converged in support.
A massive, unfathomably heavy illusory mountain began to form above it.
A mountain that when Persephael saw, she trembled while uttering.
"No way...that...!"
That mountain.
Those words!
She knew them distinctly as they stemmed from a great Entity that seemed even more unfathomable than a Prime Source Entity!
The Great Beyonder!
Why would these words be uttered here today? By a...
Her eyes honed in on the visage of the Inheritor of the Megalos as she squinted.
Was it really the case? Did that man really leave an Instrument that would come after him all these many years later?!
And the one it faced...
Persephael honed in on Ozymandias as her gaze became cold.
She had seen this creature once before in the Expanse- right before the Change occurred as he faced Pioneers of Existence at that time.
Now, he was facing a Source Complexity entity?
Boundless weavings and questions rose as new entrants arrived on the battlefield.

Many stared in awe towards the massive Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder as it looked like all of Megalos Beyond was converging around the Inheritor of the Megalos, bringing doubt to the existence that was known as Ozymandias heavily at this moment!
After all, who would be capable of calling upon the very mountain of Megalos- the very weavings of the Beyonder, to support them if not the Instrument?
It was a heavy moment as the Inheritor of the Megalos was illuminated with glory.
At such a time...
Before the eyes of Ozymandias, a prompt flashed.
|The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has been randomly ignited by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.|
|Randomly, the selection of a minute has been selected.|
|The passage of a minute may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.|
|The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Outerversal.|
|The Severed Weavings of Outerversal, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surges across Severings and heads towards its Final Severed State!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3548 Infinitum! II
paragraphs: Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity activated!
The time chosen was 1 minute, and the weaving to be elevated was Outerversal.
Randomly, it was said.
And yet...was causality truly so random?
That the moment the Inheritor of the Megalos called upon a terrifying identity and mountain, Noah would begin surging towards the Final Severed State of Outerversal?!

Incandescent cerulean radiance bathed over him thoroughly. The Heart of Infinity beat loudly, and with every single beat, utterly heavy blue waves of light converged around a Mundi of Power that held the unique authority blanketing all of Megalos Beyond.
Outerversal.
A set source that was the main and only source for the majority of all entities stemming from Dark Matter.

It was a weaving and source meant to transcend the bounds of dimensions, time, and space as only Outerversal Morphons could uniquely cast out parts of themselves and fish for other existences to bind.
Only Outerversal Morphons were a complex type of Entity that held similar sources in such large numbers.
Now and then, there were unique Lineages like the Megalonians of the Megalos Mountains who also singularly focused on a single source- theirs being Megalos in this case.
But the Outerversal Morphons were by the most numerous form of life to share a single Source of Outerversal with how innate and compatible it was with the Megalos Beyond!
At this moment, such a source was pumped across its demarcations as with every beat of a heart, it underwent a severing.
The heartbeats were rapid and heavy as it crossed dozens of severings in a short period of time, and ultimately...
BOOM!
Stellar black radiance gushed out of his figure amidst the blue.
|The Severed Weavings of Outerversal have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Outerversal has opened.|
|The True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence has been born.|
Around his body, stellar black brilliance began to gush out while he looked towards the Inheritor of the Megalos, who seemed to have the very backing of the Megalos Beyond at this moment.

An obsidian mountain formed from behind and pointed its tip unto him, his Source receiving the complexity and support of an unfathomable expanse of the Megalos as he seemed to be accepting an inheritance only meant for him!
Ozymandias opposed such a being that was roaring out with fervor as it finally received and showed its Inheritance from the Beyonder.
That it was the one who should have been receiving all the veneration!
And yet as it basked in this moment, above the visage of Ozymandias, a flaming black crown bloomed to fruition as it expressed an utterly heavy Regnum.
In addition to this, an unfathomably massive obsidian throne began to form from black flames, its might heavy as the figure of Ozymandias came to sit himself on this throne!

Its makeup felt unique as it resonated with the surrounding Megalos, countless lines blooming from it and shooting out behind it as all space turned into a dazzling stellar mass that stopped in place.
As if they were honoring these countless threads shooting out of this stellar obsidian throne!

The weavings of Dark Matter nearby seethed as from the countless threads shot out from the throne, dense weavings of Dark Matter- and subsequently the surrounding Megalos Beyond itself...began to flow through these lines like stellar rivers that connected to the one throne that Ozymandias sat in.
A single throne, and countless stellar rivers carrying the support of the Megalos itself bolstering its rule.
Its Regnum!

|Through the True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence, an Inquisition of the Severed Regnum rule can be instituted. This inquisition questions the right of rulership and control over the states of existence nearby and is especially strict on the weavings relating to Dark Matter. Anyone claiming rulership and control over weavings of Dark Matter while standing against you will have to answer the simple question- do they have access to the True Source, or is what they have merely an imitation?|

|Through the True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence, the Limited True Severed Regnum Expansion has been obtained. You are capable of casting your weavings out into any Megalos within your frequency or other frequencies of existence.|
His weavings buzzed with a sense of wonder and exploration.
His whole body carried a unique sensation as if he could go anywhere!

Even the other part of him that had entered the Palaces of the Wheelomachy and delved into the secret domain Bob hid- the pathway he was traversing into another Frequency this whole time...became easier to traverse.
His arrival in the frequency where a part of Bob was hidden would now sooner rather than later!
But here.
With the weavings of Ozymandias.
There were waves of interminable brilliance as he looked towards the Inheritor of the Megalos and his heavy backing before he spoke out.
"Inquisition of the Severed Regnum."
He filed for an Inquisition as the stellar flaming crown and throne had on pulsed and began enlarging behind him.
He looked towards the Inheritor of the Megalos as he declared gloriously while looking at the heavy support of the very Megalos themselves behind him.
"I ask you, does this mountain you inherited have access to the True Source?!"
HUUM!
The serpentine crimson eyes of the Inheritor of the Megalos glowed an incandescent red.
Did the Inheritance from the Beyonder have access to the True Source? What did that even mean?
The Inheritor of the Megalos wanted to scoff, and yet in the next moment...
"Because if you do not even have access to a True Source, how dare you raise the weavings of Dark Matter against me? How dare you seek to oppose my Regnum?!"
WAA!
Regnum.
Regnum!
The moment this question was posed, the massive mountain supporting him and about to impose its heavy pressure on Ozymandias buzzed and trembled.
As if it took this question seriously As if it was forced to take it seriously due to its makeup!
Did it have a Pathway to a True Source? The answer was clear.
Ozymandias knew it. This very mountain knew it. These very Megalos knew it!
So in the next moment, the massive forming Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder had a massive crack form!

The time chosen was 1 minute, and the weaving to be elevated was Outerversal.
Randomly, it was said.
And yet...was causality truly so random?
That the moment the Inheritor of the Megalos called upon a terrifying identity and mountain, Noah would begin surging towards the Final Severed State of Outerversal?!
Incandescent cerulean radiance bathed over him thoroughly.
The Heart of Infinity beat loudly, and with every single beat, utterly heavy blue waves of light converged around a Mundi of Power that held the unique authority blanketing all of Megalos Beyond.
Outerversal.
A set source that was the main and only source for the majority of all entities stemming from Dark Matter.

It was a weaving and source meant to transcend the bounds of dimensions, time, and space as only Outerversal Morphons could uniquely cast out parts of themselves and fish for other existences to bind.
Only Outerversal Morphons were a complex type of Entity that held similar sources in such large numbers.
Now and then, there were unique Lineages like the Megalonians of the Megalos Mountains who also singularly focused on a single source- theirs being Megalos in this case.
But the Outerversal Morphons were by the most numerous form of life to share a single Source of Outerversal with how innate and compatible it was with the Megalos Beyond!
At this moment, such a source was pumped across its demarcations as with every beat of a heart, it underwent a severing.
The heartbeats were rapid and heavy as it crossed dozens of severings in a short period of time, and ultimately...
BOOM!
Stellar black radiance gushed out of his figure amidst the blue.
|The Severed Weavings of Outerversal have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Outerversal has opened.|
|The True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence has been born.|
Around his body, stellar black brilliance began to gush out while he looked towards the Inheritor of the Megalos, who seemed to have the very backing of the Megalos Beyond at this moment.

An obsidian mountain formed from behind and pointed its tip unto him, his Source receiving the complexity and support of an unfathomable expanse of the Megalos as he seemed to be accepting an inheritance only meant for him!
Ozymandias opposed such a being that was roaring out with fervor as it finally received and showed its Inheritance from the Beyonder.
That it was the one who should have been receiving all the veneration!
And yet as it basked in this moment, above the visage of Ozymandias, a flaming black crown bloomed to fruition as it expressed an utterly heavy Regnum.
In addition to this, an unfathomably massive obsidian throne began to form from black flames, its might heavy as the figure of Ozymandias came to sit himself on this throne!

Its makeup felt unique as it resonated with the surrounding Megalos, countless lines blooming from it and shooting out behind it as all space turned into a dazzling stellar mass that stopped in place.
As if they were honoring these countless threads shooting out of this stellar obsidian throne!

The weavings of Dark Matter nearby seethed as from the countless threads shot out from the throne, dense weavings of Dark Matter- and subsequently the surrounding Megalos Beyond itself...began to flow through these lines like stellar rivers that connected to the one throne that Ozymandias sat in.
A single throne, and countless stellar rivers carrying the support of the Megalos itself bolstering its rule.
Its Regnum!

This inquisition questions the right of rulership and control over the states of existence nearby and is especially strict on the weavings relating to Dark Matter.

His whole body carried a unique sensation as if he could go anywhere!

His arrival in the frequency where a part of Bob was hidden would now sooner rather than later!

chapters.title: Chapter 3549 The Need for Greatness! I
paragraphs: A grandiose stellar obsidian gleaming throne that he sat on, and a flaming stellar obsidian crown above him as they both radiated a terrifying Regnum!
A terrifying dignity.

He adorned all of this as naturally, such a Regnum caused countless stellar black threads that turned into gorgeous rivers seemingly extending to the horizon of the Megalos to form- and these rivers held dense waves of Dark Matter, but they also held significant weavings of Matter too!
With such a type of dignity.
With such a Regnum.
Ozymandias looked towards the Inheritor of the Megalos and imposed an Inquisition of the Severed Regnum!
He questioned the very existence of the Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder as its entire makeup was Dark Matter.
And such a weaving came under even greater scrutiny from the Inquisition of the Severed Regnum!
Did it have a True Source? Even a Pathway towards a True Source?

Such a clear-cut question was asked as the Inheritor of the Megalos could not answer, and the massive Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder behind him had a crack stretch out from its peak, and it extended towards its base!
CRACK!
Even more fissures extended out after that as the imposing demeanor of Ozymandias only rose higher.
He looked at the cracks extending out from the Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder as his Regnum rose even higher.
"You can flash this mountain before anybody else you wish to. But if ever you seek to impose it against me, be sure that it can, at the very least, stand against my dignity."

Word that caused the Inheritor of the Megalos to be utterly infuriated echoed out, with his wings that seemed to be supporting the Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder radiating immense brilliance as he roared out.

"This is the very mountain passed down through eons from the Beyonder himself! The one whose legends span across the Megalos and the Expanse! You cannot deny his weavings. You cannot say they are not true!"
WAA!
The inheritance of the Beyonder himself.
His weavings were undeniable!

Alongside these words, the cracks spreading across the Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder sought to stabilize and even try to recover, but the Regnum of the entity aflame in the distance only stared forth coldly in reply.
"I deny that which is not true."
As he spoke, a Severed Infinitum Engine burned and began to heat up in the depths of the burning stellar obsidian throne.
Its imposition became even grander.
More constant!
"If this is the weaving of the Great Beyonder, and it cannot assert that it leads to a True Source, then it means that it is false!"
The serpentine eyes of the Inheritor of the Megalos flickered and heaviness and burned crimson.
But there was one last sentence that Ozymandias uttered out with tyranny.
"It means that the weavings of the Great Beyonder...are false!"
BOOM!
Countless stellar rivers and flaming weavings of a throne and crown burned as, in the next moment, the Megalos Mountain of the Beyonder bloomed with countless cracks and shattered.
Shattered!
The Megalos! Mountain! Of! The! Beyonder!
The Beyonder!

Unimaginable brilliance and weavings erupted out as the eyes of the Inheritor of the Megalos filled with blood, his jaw forcefully opening to release ruptures of crimson black blood as it seemed to have received a grievous injury to its source!
And its Source was not the only one.
The countless Outerversal Morphons here.
Persephael and McAllister in the distance.
Any who understood the brilliance of the Great Beyonder felt like their own weavings were impacted when this being asserted that the weavings of this great being...were false!
And Ozymandias shattered the massive mountain of the Beyonder supported by the Megalos itself.
What did this mean?
What did this mean?!
The Great Mother and others were dazed at the one they believed to be called the Instrument of the Great Beyonder...call the Great Beyonder himself someone with false weavings.
And yet this being did not seem close to being done as he raised his hand at this moment to show a pulsing globe of black brilliance.
It was...a signature of weavings that wrapped around the Inheritor of the Megalos at this very moment.

"Your Source is that of Inhereditare. Born and weaved to specifically inherit the weavings that the Great Beyonder left behind. You power. Your being. Your significance...all of it stems from the source of another. From the inheritance of the weavings of the Great Beyonder. I have the weavings of your Source in my hands here as...I can easily take it and make it bloom within my body. I could become one with the weavings of Inhereditare as well, fully capable of accepting the weavings that the Great Beyonder left behind."
His voice was heavy as many felt a sense of foreboding.
What was he about to say now? How drastic would it be?!

Severed Extractor had, of course, been working in the background as the Source of the Inheritor of the Megalos was entirely compatible, but before it could be changed and made his own, Noah stopped it!
"I was able to do everything that I did before without the weavings of the Great Beyonder. I could choose to take the musings of this Source right now and become his inheritor...but I deny it!"
HUUM!

"You were enraged that I played the part of the Instrument of the Beyonder? Today, I tell you that I could obtain the same Source as yours and Inherit the weavings of the Beyonder, but I deny it. I do not want it. My power is my own. My weavings are my own. A creature like you who relies wholly on the weavings of another...could never amount to anything. I will not be like you. A creature like you...will never have an ounce of greatness in all your eons of life."
As he spoke, he crushed the weaving of a budding Source within his hands!
|The possible weavings of Inhereditare relating to the Great Beyonder have been denied.|
|Your Regnum rises to an unfathomable level!|
BOOM!
His Regnum exploded out with heavy, interminable flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 3550 The Need for Greatness! II
paragraphs: The need for greatness.
Every single being that was born, from the moment they could think...they aspired for greatness.
To do something grand with themselves.
Wealth. Power. Relationships.
Everyone held an innate need for greatness!
The Inheritor of the Megalos had such a need the moment they were born, they knew of a connection to distant and powerful weavings.
They knew they were meant for a great purpose.
They knew tremendous greatness waited for them as the Inheritor of the Megalos dedicated its entire weavings towards this!
Across Frequencies, all of its variations did the same.
To the point that when another Entity started imitating them, all of his weavings across frequencies came together to put a stop to it!
Because only he could be the Inheritor of the Megalos!
The Inheritor of the Great Beyonder!
And yet now, the weavings of the Great Beyonder were shattered.
They were called false.
The source that it held...could be obtained by another as instead of taking it, the other entity denied it!
They did not want it.
And to top it all off...
"A creature like you...will never have an ounce of greatness in all your eons of life."
These words resounded again and again within its Source. Its source that was shaken already.
Its source that questioned itself as its weavings were shattered after being called false!
Its source that was denied by another. Its source was already buzzing with overlapping layers of other weavings across countless frequencies!
When such an impact and questioning of its very source bloomed alongside these layers weavings of other selves across frequencies...
CRACK!
When such an impact and questioning of its very source bloomed alongside these layers weavings of other selves across frequencies...
CRACK!
Something broke.
BOOM!
The pupils on the serpentine eyes of the Inheritor of the Megalos melted away entirely as its eyes became bathed with a pure crimson stellar brilliance.
Its weavings became distorted as the countless layers of fused selves became unstable!
In the eyes of others, its body trembled before it began to twitch, thousands of screaming faces then blooming and showing themselves over its skin as they variations of itself.
Each one seemed to be screaming and questioning as around it, Dark Matter erupted heavily before surging into the Inheritor of the Megalos madly, a terrifying sense of instability blooming from it!

Everyone watched this with utter shock and incredulity as they questioned...had the weavings of the Inheritor of the Megalos actually received such a major shock that they were collapsing and changing at this very moment?!
Ozymandias looked at the scene ahead with bright eyes as his Regnum burned unfathomably brighter.
He had never denied a Source before.
Today, his Quintessence made him deny the weavings of becoming an Inheritor as he did not look back on this decision.

And now, he looked at the Inheritor of the Megalos who began to seethe with instability- partly from his words and actions, as their weavings joined together from many others across the frequencies began to distort!
In the corner of his eyes, the figures of Persephael and...
'McAllister?' He thought of this name with bright eyes as he remembered the weavings of the father of Barbatos.
He had his daughter vacationing with him in the Purgatory Lands as her mission that eventually led to his entry into these lands barren of any authority...was none other than him!
Based on the weavings Barbatos had told him, even her father was merely following orders as if he was here right now...was it due to a level of guilt he felt in doing what he did?

Regardless of the reason why, there were answers to be obtained as to who exactly deemed it so that he should be sent to the Purgatory Lands, and how this would aid in the fruition of the Change that was still spreading out at this moment across Frequencies of Existence!
His eyes flashed brilliantly.
An anomaly with unstable weavings ahead of him whose body was tinged in a red color in his eyes, Persephael, McAllister, and the Faceless Lifeforms behind them all stood around him at this moment.

The many possibilities of how things would play out here were stupendous as his weavings moved- intent on finishing off the Inheritor of the Megalos and eat up the complex and unstable weavings it held!
As he did this.
There was another critical weaving occurring within the depths of the Megalos Ynnere.
In an isolated Truly Severed Domain born from none other than the weavings of the Singed that coursed through the Infiniverse Megalos.
Another part of him in the form of Noah sat on top of a sea of flames of the Singed, their purity and majesty dancing around him as they nurtured the very surrounding weavings to be richer.
At this time, space tore as a channel leading from the Expanse all the way into this domain opened, the figures of Tam and a new entrant covered in the allure of blue making their appearance.
Noah raised his head to look at her as from the weavings of Tam, he knew her to be a lowkey Watcher of the Wheelomachy!
And yet, she was actually a Singed under the guise of all her brilliance, her eyes dancing with blue flames as within their depths, he saw the golden flames of the Singed burning brightly.
It was a powerful Singed that seemed to know a lot more than Tam, her blue flaming eyes bright as she looked around this place with a sense of alarm!
She even bent down to touch the white gold flames of the Singed on the sea of flames below her as she became even more shocked at the purity of what she touched.
This stayed the same even when she raised her head and locked onto Noah, her eyes becoming utterly fixated on him as soon after...she showed confusion.
Genuine confusion!
She walked forward as she arrived in front of him and looked him up and down, even sniffing a few inches away before the confusion on her serene face became even heavier.
She stopped in front of him as she looked towards him and blinked before she asked in a questioning tone.
"...Sir, is that you?"
