chapters.title: Chapter 3551 Mystery! I
paragraphs: Her gaze was an entirely quizzical one as if she was truly confused!
The way he smelled.
The flames all around.
Everything seemed so utterly familiar and yet foreign to her as she could not help but ask him.
She called him Sir!
Noah looked at this unique entity with calm eyes as he replied.
"You may be mistaking me for someone else."
He had already played too many roles as being himself was always the best.
And yet this Source Complexity Singed before him shook her head decisively as she replied.

"Nope. Your flames. Your source. Your feeling...its all the same. Sir, I don't know what game you're playing now, but all Singed are gathering towards Prime Frequency of Flames to get ready for the enemies of the Wheel. We haven't heard from you directly for some time as we have only been following the weavings you left behind."
She vehemently believed it more and more as she studied him, and her mind was entirely made up as Noah could only shake his head with a smile.

"Again, I am not who you think I am. I am Osmont, Noah Osmont. And my home is these Megalos you have arrived in. You came here after seeing the weavings of Bob I spread out to cause the eruption of War across the Wheelomachy?"
He steered the conversation to the reason why she was here, and Mysara blinked as she squinted her eyes a moment later as if she understood.

"Alright Sir, I will play along...yes, I am Mysara, and we have never met at all before. This is my first time standing on top of such pure Flames of the Singed that could only possibly be found in the periphery of the Wheel. And this is the first time standing before the Origin Singed whose flames exceed all other Singed. Though I have to ask...while your complexity is unique as always, it seems quite a bit weaker. Did you lose your weavings? Memories? Is this the flow that the Wheel intends? Is that why we haven't seen much of you recently?"
She bombarded him with one question after another as she wholly believed he was...the Origin Singed!
Beside her, Tam of the Singed was not making things any better as he actually nodded in the affirmative as if it was all true.
But the things she spoke of were heavy ones.

That his complexity seemed considerably weaker than that Entity she knew. That the flames of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence expressed were ones that could be found on the periphery of the Wheel!
She revealed all of this freely.
Noah looked straight at Mysara with all of these questions as he sighed right after, causing her to blink suspiciously before she sighed.

"Fine, keep being as mysterious as always. I will truly play along. So what are we doing here? Three Singed, an Origin Singed included, being gathered in these Megalos...is something happening here that we need to take care of? Something connected to the emerging change and war?"
She was proactive as she asked, and Noah was about to reply when all of a sudden...
BZZT!
His weavings buzzed as something significant occurred with a thread of a weaving he had with someone.
He closed his eyes to focus on it as very quickly, he honed in on none other than Old Man Eudemus- tracing his weavings to a distant place within the Megalos Ynerre as at this moment...
BOOM!
A tremendously heavy explosion of complexity erupted out as it could be felt even from here.

This explosion of complexity was unique as through the entanglement he had with Old Man Eudemus; he was able to feel blazing white gold flames surge out and continue surging out like a tower from the place Old Man Eudemus was!
What was he doing there? And what exactly was that?
His eyes shone sharply as beside him, Tam and Mysara also turned their bodies in the same direction as even they felt the eruption of complexity!
"That...is a deep eruption of complexity. Something related to the Wheel. Sir- Err, Sir Osmont, what do you have hidden there? Is that why all of us are gathered at this place?"
She spoke as if everything was falling into place, Noah rising up while looking at her and shaking his head.
"Let's go see."
It related to the dazzling Flames of the Wheel; they could all feel it. And here, three Singed of the Wheel were gathered as they could go see what Old Man Eudemus had gotten himself embroiled in!
As they were about to leave.
"Oh, Sir, I haven't gotten an Empowerment for quite some time. Could you give my flames a little boost?"
Mysara spoke earnestly as Noah looked at her quizzically, and she smacked her head as her eyes even lit up after right.
"Right...we would not have done any Empowerments if you are someone else. Oh, and you wouldn't know how...hmm, hmm!"
A mischievous smile rose on her face as she thought of the Origin Singed.
He would always bring his hand over them and release a white gold flame that they then ingested, and this flame would go on to empower their weavings for some time!
But that was then.
If he was going to say that he didn't remember anything...
"Sir Osmont, is it okay for me to perform the ritual to gather the flames for Empowerment?"
He nodded at her impassively as they had to move, so he simply nodded.

And in the next moment, the mischievous expression on Mysara became all the more prevalent as after she received permission, she instantly flashed before Noah and smacked her lips onto his- a devouring force erupting from her that tried to gather Noah's flames!
Since they were Truly Severed, they would not have gone anywhere unless Noah wished, but he was curious as to what this Singed was doing.
So he allowed a bundle of flames to surge into her mouth.
And...
BOOM!
The blue flames around her burned half gold, her Source becoming all the more exuberant as flaming blue wings erupted behind her!

chapters.title: Chapter 3552 Mystery! II
paragraphs: Flaming blue weavings erupted behind Mysara as her Source truly burned brighter, her expression looking drunken as she opened her eyes right after and looked towards Noah as if she expected to be reprimanded!
And yet she only saw him look at her with interest as she pulled away from him and cleared her throat with a bit of embarrassment.
"Thank you for the Empowerment, Sir Osmont! Now we can set off..."
It was definitely not the normal methodology for this process that she called Empowerment, but it seemed like his flames could have even grander effects on other Singed!

In the corner of his eyes, he saw Tam looking at him with a fervent gaze as if he would jump out in the next second just like Mysara, but he gave him a look that if he tried this, his weavings might just be done for!
Tam coughed and looked sideways as Noah threw out a bundle of pure True Severed Singed Flames of Existence onto his body, his weavings also swirling up brilliantly as he commanded.
"Let's go!"
They could feel the dreadfully powerful aura only becoming more and more intense over time as they surged toward that direction.
Eudemus.
A name given to him by his parents he no longer remembered.
An identity of a scholar that he took on over the years, eventually molding who he was today.
He became a part of the Commonwealth so long ago that he never differentiated between himself and the Commonwealth- his life eventually intertwined entirely!
And now...
He sought answers.
He sought light to be shed in the expanse of waves of darkness!
So he used the Core of the Commonwealth to arrive at a nondescript area in the Megalos Ynnere, and he unsealed something that always remained covered this whole time.
The Core of the Commonwealth did everything as it was akin to using a sharp point to pop a balloon that was already heavily inflated and about to break.
And once it did break...
BOOM!
Old Man Eudemus saw the space before him opening up like a zipper, twisting and distorting as from it, a pillar of white gold flames surged out!
A pillar of Flames! Heavy in complexity.
Scorching in grandiosity.
They seemed to be releasing a burst after such a long time, and alongside this pillar of flames, tendrils lashed out like snakes as one smashed into Old Man Eudemus!
His whole existence felt a sense of decimation alongside it, his body being pulled in by the tendril of white gold flame as he saw the identity of what truly lay underneath.
He saw...a golden tower rising up brilliantly, this tower actually piercing a multicolored heart that was also turned aflame.

The golden tower caused Old Man Eudemus to feel a sense of veneration as it had an extremely sharp pointed tip, and its base...was cut off smoothly as the heart it pierced was more so towards its base!
It was all surrounded by storms of white gold flames, and millions of terrifying Source Runes floated around this entire area as someone would need a terrifying amount of complexity just to get near.
Old Man Eudemus did not have such a complexity.
His body was drawn by that tendril of flames as he felt excruciating pain, getting ever closer to the smooth gold surface of the sleek golden tower as his body smashed into it!
"GAH!"
He felt his existence scream out as it touched the surface of the golden tower, his skin instantly melting into it as his body became fixed in place!
He breathed out raggedly as a moment later, his eyes pulsed gold as he received threads of information.
Just exactly what he was opened.
This tower he became fixed on as his Existence melted into it...
It was a Spoke!
A Piece of the Spoke of the Wheel!
It had pierced into the very Heart of the Megalos Ynnere and lay dormant this time as what it could do....
Even as his existence melted into it, Old Man Eudemus felt the pristine complexity involved as he felt the abundant weavings of Matter.
And how with this Spoke piercing the Heart of the Megalos, one could be able to command Matter in such a way that the Three Body Problem...could be solved with it!
It held that much power at bay.
But his complexity...was nowhere near enough to command something like this.
The Sword of the Commonwealth was both right and wrong.
With something like this, the Resurgence of the Commonwealth was all but guaranteed. But...there was nobody compatible and complex enough to wield something like this!
There was...
HUUM!
Old Man Eudemus felt his weavings buzz as he felt an aura.
His head that was melting into the smooth surface of the tower like Spoke of the Wheel barely opened its eyes to see...him.
His aura.
His gaze.
In the distance, he saw Noah Osmont!
He did not appear alone as there were two others with him, one man that he knew and a woman he was seeing for the first time.

Their gazes were those of shock as they stared at the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel piercing into the Heart of the Megalos, but Osmont...his body became aflame with the same white gold flames as those in the surroundings as he floated closer to the sleek golden tower that was the Spoke!

He proceeded across without any worries, as if he was simply strolling into the terrifying surroundings of this Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel as he crossed great distances in a short period of time to arrive right where Old Man Eudemus was.

Seeing him caused the eyes of Old Man Eudemus to shake with complex emotions as his existence continued to be irreparably pulled into the burning Spoke, his lips barely opening as he spoke with a sad smile.
"I...found a tool that could solve the Three Body Problem. I found it. But...I cannot do anything with it. My complexity...my complexity!"
In his voice, there were waves of resignation and unwillingness as it was as if he was back to his days as a scholar.
He had a pen in hand, but no way to even move it.
Nothing to write with it!
He shook his head as for something he had sought all his life; he came right before the solution as his weavings would collapse right after!

chapters.title: Chapter 3553 A Heart! A Spoke! I
paragraphs: For any job, there was a proper tool to utilize to complete it.
A nail needed a hammer.
Writing needed pen and paper.
The job could be completed in other ways, but the right tool...always made the job extremely easy.

Old Man Eudemus...melted into the terrifyingly sleek golden Spoke that pierced through a multicolored Heart as he felt like he had come across the tool that could rightly answer the three body problem, but it was so heavy!
So big!
And he had no way to even lift it.
So close, and yet so far.
"The weavings of the Wheel are cruel, Noah Osmont."
Old Man Eudemus was half melted into the golden Spoke as his words croaked out towards the one person right before him.
A person he did not understand even to this day as too many mysteries surrounded him.
And Noah...looked at Old Man Eudemus in turn as he observed his weavings with caution, an illusory eye opening above him and staring at everything as he prepared to make a move!
When he breathed in, the air felt rich in terrifying flames of purity and complexity that almost rivaled his.
Almost.
The Spoke itself seemed heavy and capable of not decimating- but purifying and eating the weavings of any who got close enough.
Half of Old Man Eudemus was already part of this golden Spoke.
And then, there was the Heart it pierced through.
The very Heart of these Megalos!
It looked like a skewered organ, and yet it remained alive and well as an unknown reaction occurred to cause it to enter a state of resonance and symbiosis with the Spoke that crossed through it.

The burning smell of existence took Noah back as he saw Old Man Eudemus nearly melted in, his eyes flashing with a trace of pity as from their entanglement, he saw that weavings of this Old Man were already collapsed irreversibly.
"Hold on as best you can."

He spoke towards the man who had been seeking answers all his life- white gold flames erupting to cover what remained of his body when his flames came in contact with the Spoke; there was a roaring flare up as the seething flames in the surroundings became even wilder!

Noah floated down towards the very bottom of the Spoke as he passed through the pierced heart, noticing how the weavings of this space that seemed enclosed within the folds of the Megalos held similar musings to that place he arrived at when he attained True Severing.
That was how it remained masked and hidden this whole time as it seemed like a junction of space between the Megalos and that heavy domain of darkness where it was hard to even move around in!
He arrived at the base of the Spoke, right before the Heart, as his figure began to rapidly enlarge in size.
At this moment, he was akin to the size of a grain of sand in comparison to the massive Spoke, and his figure ballooned up to slowly exceed the size of a World.

Just until he seemed to have the same relation of size with the Spoke, his eyes filled with determination as his hand became aflame with white gold brilliance, intending to grasp the base of this Spoke that was raging out incandescent flames!
As he did this, the figure of Mysara appeared beside him while surrounded by vibrant blue gold flames, shouting amidst the swirling storms of complexity around them.
"Sir, I have never seen one this big! Is this why you were in these Megalos? Its complexity seems free and untamed as it might even hurt the current you with that level of Complexity! Shall I help?"

Her words barely echoed out amidst the roaring flames, but Noah only shook his head towards her as his hand, blazing with flames, landed and grasped the very base of the Spoke just below the pierced Heart!
BZZT!
All nearby weavings trembled.

White gold flames rose all around like massive curtains of brilliance, the figure of Tam in the distance scrambling away as any common Pioneers or Existence Severing entities would have gotten decimated here!
Tam, with his white gold flames of the Singed, seemed to be ignored for the most part.
While Old Man Eudemus...was already nearly gone.

Mysara watched the Origin Singed grasp the massive Spoke before them as her heart could not help but palpate with waves of shock and surprise. Why would such a massive part of the Wheel be here? She and many Singed knew of the Piece of a Phantom Trace or even Core Tracings of the Wheel that were stretched out across frequencies, but she had never seen something like this!
And to seek to control such a thing, even her weavings did not seem to be enough.
And yet...

The unique, albeit slightly weak, weavings of this version of the Origin Singed grabbed the spoke without so much as any hesitation, and columns of flames rose heavily as in the surroundings; the temperature alone even made Mysara feel stifled.
And she...was a powerful Greater Source Complexity!
She looked at the enlarged figure of the Origin Singed as she wondered.
How did it feel to be him at this moment?
HUUM!
Nearby weavings trembled.

Noah's hand that sought to grasp the Spoke felt like it was being scalded by an object that could not be grasped, and yet his True Severed Singed Flame of Existence denied such a thought as it spread to madly wrap around the whole Spoke!
It was pure.
It was truly severed. And it was already heading towards a Pathway to a True Source as how dare it be denied by an object that held the flames of the Wheel?!
"How dare you?!"
HUUM!
His voice boomed out like waves of thunder, his hand pulsing with purity and coming to grasp the Spoke completely as the very weavings nearby shuddered.
A booming cry echoed out after that before in the next moment, chains of flames erupted from the base of the Spoke and began coiling around Noah's hand like a serpent!

She and many Singed knew of the Piece of a Phantom Trace or even Core Tracings of the Wheel that were stretched out across frequencies, but she had never seen something like this!
And to seek to control such a thing, even her weavings did not seem to be enough.
And yet...

The unique, albeit slightly weak, weavings of this version of the Origin Singed grabbed the spoke without so much as any hesitation, and columns of flames rose heavily as in the surroundings; the temperature alone even made Mysara feel stifled.
And she...was a powerful Greater Source Complexity!
She looked at the enlarged figure of the Origin Singed as she wondered.
How did it feel to be him at this moment?
HUUM!
Nearby weavings trembled.

Noah's hand that sought to grasp the Spoke felt like it was being scalded by an object that could not be grasped, and yet his True Severed Singed Flame of Existence denied such a thought as it spread to madly wrap around the whole Spoke!
It was pure.
It was truly severed.
And it was already heading towards a Pathway to a True Source as how dare it be denied by an object that held the flames of the Wheel?!
"How dare you?!"
HUUM!
His voice boomed out like waves of thunder, his hand pulsing with purity and coming to grasp the Spoke completely as the very weavings nearby shuddered.
A booming cry echoed out after that before in the next moment, chains of flames erupted from the base of the Spoke and began coiling around Noah's hand like a serpent!

chapters.title: Chapter 3554 A Heart! A Spoke! II
paragraphs: Chains of flames raged and roared out as they snaked over Noah's hand, entrenching themselves deeper in his skin as if they sought to control him.
And yet in the face of all of this, Noah's gaze remained defiant as he grasped the Spoke even tighter and tighter, and white gold flames were branded into it in turn.
It seemed to be a battle of purity as at this moment, the flames that were truly severed won such an argument!

The chains of the flames slowly turned into a tattoo over his hand as in the next moment, he was able to grasp the tower like golden Spoke tightly, and for the first time ever...it actually moved it from its current position.
Mysara and Tam looked at the scene with shining eyes of wonder as in the next moment, Noah felt a seething feedback of tremendous complexity as prompts rose over his eyes
|You have grasped and bound a unique object.|
|You have grasped a Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence that has fused a Megalos Heart at its base.|
|The possibility of its weavings are unknown.|
It was a unique sensation as unlike most things that Noah had, this terrifying Spoke of the Wheel was unclear in exactly what it did.
But at the same time, he slowly felt like he knew as there was a level of feedback between him and the thing that he currently grasped.
It was unique in a sense that, unlike if this object was alone and by itself, it had been fused to a Megalos Heart as this added even more intricate layers of capabilities.

As his flames surged into it and its flames surged into him, Noah felt an instinctual sensation of the possibilities of what it could do as in his enlarged visage, he grasped this Spoke with two hands and bellowed out before he turned its tip downwards.
And he...pressed down!
OOH!

It was an instinctual move, but it came to him among the many things that this Spoke could possibly do as it thundered down and came in contact with a single gray fracture that was among the countless gray fractured lines spreading out across the Megalos.

Even with the constant eruption of his Megalocides and the deluge of shattered Pantheons and Omniverses that spread out all around- all that had happened were these gray fractured lines dimming in their appearance as the lower Atmospheric Weavings of Existence returned to normal levels.
But they never disappeared.

At this moment, as Noah grasped a shocking new tool with unknown possibilities...its tip came in contact with a single Gray fractured line of the Change as in the next moment, this gray fracture became scorched with golden flames and proceeded to writhe in agony before it turned into ash.
This occurred to a single gray fracture that was extending for light years all around like a web!

About right after, the Spoke that was pressed down with astonishing force released bursts of white gold waves of radiance that instantly covered the countless Gray lines extending out across the Megalos Ynnere as every single one of them turned a flame and cried out before they became scorched!
And were entirely erased out of existence right after.
It began in a small place and gradually extended out across the Megalos Ynnere.
The very advent of what came with the Change!
The Change that other beings kickstarted for their own purposes as they weakened the effect over the flow of the Wheel and lowered the very weavings of existence entirely.

At this moment, their presence was being purged and scorched across the Megalos at a shockingly rapid pace- these scorching waves of brilliance not only remaining in this Megalos as they also went to where a veil was torn and spread out in a blinding wave of flaming brilliance into the Megalos Beyond itself!
Another profound change was coming as at this moment, nobody knew just who would be the one who held the pen that wrote down exactly what these new changes would entail.
There were only a few witnesses who saw the man responsible for all of this.
One of them was a reconstructed weaving brought forth by the man himself.

The other...was a nearly collapsed weaving of an Old Man whose shred of will was barely visible, his nigh melted eyes watching the brilliance unfolding as at this moment, too much of him had collapsed to still be his old self.
And the other was a Singed who held an extremely high status in addition to complex weavings that others could not even imagine.
Mysara!

At this moment, she had one body here that she believed had located the weavings of the Origin Singed- an entity she had seen many times before, but had left them for the last eons. Observing his brilliance once again made her extremely exuberant for the future.
Only for a short moment though.
Because while this sequence of weavings bloomed in these Megalos, her other body, which had just arrived within a Prime Frequency of Existence... was coming across an extremely somber atmosphere.
Away from this frequency.
Within the Prime Frequency of Flames.

Everything in the surroundings seemed to be burning with different colored flames as if any existences who did not have weavings geared towards the fire may just find themselves extinguished before their memories and records became a part of their surroundings.

Within such a small domain of space where the very makeup of it seemed to be flames, there were dozens of figures whose bodies radiated incandescent flames while they surrounded a single burning wisp of a white gold flame that was the size of a World.
It emanated pristine power and beauty as at this moment, these entities- these Singed, held a somber atmosphere with every new arrival that returned from other Frequencies.
Because nearest to the burning Wisp of the flame of the Wheel, there was one of their more powerful complexities.
An entity who had taken the reins when the Origin Singed left them as they proceeded to follow the doctrine and surf on the flow of the Wheel of Existence itself!
But at this moment, half of his body was collapsed, his expression serene as every single entity here could see his weavings were on the path of irreversible decimation!
And he was someone that no Lesser Source, or even a Greater Source could look at without having to bow their heads.
He was someone at the stage of Prime Source Complexity!
What exactly had happened?
What could possibly have set the weaving of a Prime Source Complexity to an irreversible path of collapse?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3555 They did not leave us! I
paragraphs: The very weavings of existence here were unique.
And every moment, it felt like one was breathing in fantastical flames of existence with every breath.

There were many flames of varying colors, and each one expressed a different emotion. Some flames would dance happily while others burst with excitement, and some flames looked dwindled and dried as they bent down seeming sad.

At this moment, near the world-sized Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence, the many seas of flames held a somber atmosphere as every single one seemed to be bound down by something truly too heavy.
Nearest to them was the figure of a Prime Source Complexity.

A man whose body was tall in stature, and his back was a wide one that many could depend on. He was an entity whose eyes were as fierce as they were gentle, with his head burning with silver-gold flames.
What he did for the Singed could never be placed in a single record and explained in its entirety.
And yet, as more and more Singed returned into the Prime Frequency of Flames, they came to find his visage that was half collapsed as at this moment, only half of his flaming body stood before them!
His single eye looked at all of those arriving as it now he held serenity and calmness as if to tell them- even in the state that he was in, that everything would be okay.
That even in this state, it should all still be what the flow of the Wheel intended.
He smiled at all of those that had gathered here as he nodded his half head and began to speak out.
"There are still a few others that have not arrived, but this is more than enough for me to spread what I have come to learn of the Weavings of the Wheel."
His voice still held a shocking power, but Mysara and many others felt a level of shock as within this voice, they felt such a profound wave of weakness!
Their minds still buzzed as they wondered how all of this could be possible. They had known everything, and they had planned everything.
This whole time, they knew that a terrifying Change was coming as tribulations were a part of the Flow of the Wheel.

So they got ready for it. They spread their forces out across Frequencies and entrenched them in through various powerful forces that remained inside of frequencies, and even those that moved across frequencies of existence!

They even learned about their enemy and did their best to prepare for them, even letting them make the first move as after they knew what their enemy held, they could very easily crush them after that.
These were their weavings, and this was what they knew.
And they came to finally carry out such weavings as instead- they were faced with the collapsing weavings of one of their more powerful pillars!
As if he could see all of their gazes, this entity smiled and shook his head.
"There is no need for sadness when it comes to the Flow of the Wheel. Things are, and will always be, how they should be.

There will always be surprises along the way as this time around, there is just this minor surprise. And yet, even though the flow of the wheel will always be as it should, there are those who can manage to alter this flow in ways that may not be necessarily good for all of existence.
There are those seeking to alter the flow to their own benefit, as the result would be mass casualty events across frequencies.

To prevent such possibilities and altercations of the Flow of the Wheel, there were those among us who grew powerful enough and sensed the unfathomable forces who we could not even imagine doing something like this. They sensed them, and so they went to search for them.

And at this very moment, they have been fighting for us. They have been fighting for the Weavings of the Wheel in a place where we cannot see- in a place where we cannot understand with the little complexity that we all have!
The figures whose names shone bright in the eons past.
The Origin Singed that has left many cycles ago.

I know that none of you have any doubts, but even for those who stumbled every now and then, I assure you that the Origin Singed did not leave us. He and many others protect the weavings of the Wheel from an unfathomable threat, seeking not to destroy because they cannot destroy- but they seek to alter and change.

This...is the only path and viability for them to take on. And for these past cycles, the Origin Singed and many others have successfully protected us from these forces. They have done more than what we could ever ask of them.

But it has been far too many years. In that period of time, many things can occur as I have learned and believe that at this moment, among the many countless threats that they protect us from...one has managed to slip through the cracks of their defensives without their knowledge.

Or maybe they do know that something utterly terrible managed to get past them, but they cannot leave as if they move away for even a single second; everything they have been protecting for all of these eons may come down crumbling.
So they hope that amongst the countless waves of complexity left behind by their own weavings, that it may be enough to handle just one of the threats that managed to pass through them."
His words were lengthy.
He had spoken this whole time as he paused every now and then to look into the eyes of every single Singed.
And he continued.
"Across the frequencies, the one known as the Great Beyonder left behind Weavings to try and muster up another version of himself after he was gone.
The Stellar Weaver of Nihilos left behind countless threads of weavings to try and raise up more soldiers to fight for the cause.
The Origin Singed left us a force of ultimate power working right below the weavings of the Wheel of existence itself.
There are many.
Too many of them who placed their hopes that they would not be the only ones bearing this unfathomable weight on their shoulders should anything happen. And now...something has happened."

chapters.title: Chapter 3556 They did not leave us! II
paragraphs: Something had happened.
And now, it was time for them to step up as well!

These words were calm and serene, but they also induced a sense of power and hopelessness at the same time as among those listening, there was also a massive spider whose body burned with brilliant white gold flames.
A Singed of a unique variety from Megalos Nihilos.
It watched and listened to all of this calmly as within it, there was another Will that had nearly and completely assimilated with the depth and complexity of this creature!
The weavings of the Great Usurper were in a field of multiple Source Complexity entities as he listened calmly to a Prime Source Entity whose weavings collapsed at a rapid rate.
He knew the name of this being from the body of the existence that had freely allowed him to assimilate with it.
Ezekiel!
A force of unfathomable power that the Singed looked at as the main component of their force and the weavings of the Wheel of Existence itself after the disappearance of the Origin Singed.
And yet, as the weavings of this entity collapsed, he continued to gaze at all of them and expose terrifying secrets.

"I am in this current state because I came across what I believe is the threat that passed through the cracks of those who defend us. It is this threat that was able to do this to me, as it is the one who is currently backing the undercurrents and the movements of the Faceless Lifeforms that surge all around the frequencies of Existence.
It is an unexpected variable in the flow of the wheel as if we are not careful, it can irreversibly alter the flow to something that we cannot even imagine."
Ezekiel raised his hand and looked at the fading flame on it as he continued with a heavy smile.

"The price of my existence was made in exchange for us finding out about this enemy, as now we know what we face, and we know the complexity that we have to take down. This much has not changed. Just like before, we stated that we would watch and observe as the enemy made their moves as we learned of the extent of their power, and thereafter, we would move decisively to erase it.

Such a thought still stands as at this moment. I leave it upon you all to move extremely decisively as some weavings may already be coming close to being lost. But just know that not everything will be lost so long as you all continue fighting!"
HUUM!
His flames began to burn heavily as if they were revitalizing. His Prime Source caused a terrifying pressure as the nearby flames reeled.
"Fight for existence.
Fight for the flow.
Fight for the flame that burns within all of us.
Because so long as you all keep fighting, there will be hope!
Along the way, an uncountable number of deaths may occur. The collapse of an unknown number of weavings is all but guaranteed.
But please, do not let that flicker of flame within you die.

Follow the weavings of the Wheel as you see fit, as you believe the Wheel is telling you to follow. Events will happen around you that seem inexplicable, and that seem like they do not make sense. But so long as you see the flow of the Wheel itself within them, go along with these events as at the endpoint, we will erase that which has encroached upon us and ensure that the flow of the Wheel is not altered to an irreversible state!"
WAA!
At this point in time, as this being continued to talk, those who were listening came to the realization that after the surge of his source, his voice was becoming increasingly weak!
His last words were barely but a whisper.

And each Singed who heard them held their own complex emotions as in one corner, the weavings of Mysara vibrated with tumultuous waves of light as she recalled everything that had happened since she entered a certain Megalos and met the weavings of the one she believed to be the Origin Singed.
It did not make sense. But she never doubted.
But as the words of Ezekiel just stated, they would see many unfathomable things that contain the flow of the Wheel as they should not question it.
That they should only look into it and follow as, in the end, they would just come across exactly what they needed in order to combat that which seeks to decimate the flow of the Wheel itself!
The Origin Singed should be out in a place protecting them from unknown enemies that they could not even imagine.
And yet she believed she had found a thread of him that he left behind as it was scattered and without its old memories.
And this thread believed itself to be entirely someone else!
This was her belief, and this was her weaving. At this moment, it only solidified and became more pristine!

She asked herself why this thread of the remnant of the Origin Singed happened to introduce itself to her and nobody else as she came to the decision that even this was what the flow of the Wheel intended. So at this moment, she did not raise her voice to speak up to the crowd of others that she was currently in contact with a thread of weaving of the Origin Singed.

If and when the flow of the Wheel intended to reveal him to others, then it would occur. After all, how did that unknown enemy know of Ezekiel, and what would happen if they came to know of a thread of remnant weavings of the Origin Singed?

So until whatever time or place the Wheel intended to reveal things, she would study and follow the Origin Singed as they faced an unknown enemy of terrifying proportions who was capable of even slipping past the main weavings of the Origin Singed and many others that they had only heard of in the cycles past.
Ezekiel looked at the many Singed gathered here as he continued with a weak voice.

"The unknown force that has slipped through the cracks is a patient one and a terrifying one, as I was not able to see much of its weavings during our altercation. The fact that I stand before you here now and have not entirely perished just lets you know the flow of the Wheel is very much intact and that this enemy is likely grievously injured.

But since he has made this move against me, he must know where his greatest opposition lies. In the near future, you all can expect heavy losses to come. Do not take these losses as if they are the end, as I assure you...they are just the beginning."
WAA!
"Stand strong, and let the flame guide you. And may you never be truly extinguished."

With such words, the magnificent half visage of Ezekiel, a Prime Source Complexity, fizzled out into bursts of flames that were then pulled into the world sized wisp of a Flame that now that lay behind him!
The weavings of a Prime Source Entity had all but collapsed!

His Prime Source caused a terrifying pressure as the nearby flames reeled.
"Fight for existence.
Fight for the flow.
Fight for the flame that burns within all of us.
Because so long as you all keep fighting, there will be hope!
Along the way, an uncountable number of deaths may occur.
The collapse of an unknown number of weavings is all but guaranteed.
But please, do not let that flicker of flame within you die.
Follow the weavings of the Wheel as you see fit, as you believe the Wheel is telling you to follow.
Events will happen around you that seem inexplicable, and that seem like they do not make sense.

But so long as you see the flow of the Wheel itself within them, go along with these events as at the endpoint, we will erase that which has encroached upon us and ensure that the flow of the Wheel is not altered to an irreversible state!"
WAA!
At this point in time, as this being continued to talk, those who were listening came to the realization that after the surge of his source, his voice was becoming increasingly weak!
His last words were barely but a whisper.

And each Singed who heard them held their own complex emotions as in one corner, the weavings of Mysara vibrated with tumultuous waves of light as she recalled everything that had happened since she entered a certain Megalos and met the weavings of the one she believed to be the Origin Singed.
It did not make sense.
But she never doubted.
But as the words of Ezekiel just stated, they would see many unfathomable things that contain the flow of the Wheel as they should not question it.
That they should only look into it and follow as, in the end, they would just come across exactly what they needed in order to combat that which seeks to decimate the flow of the Wheel itself!
The Origin Singed should be out in a place protecting them from unknown enemies that they could not even imagine.
And yet she believed she had found a thread of him that he left behind as it was scattered and without its old memories.
And this thread believed itself to be entirely someone else!
This was her belief, and this was her weaving.
At this moment, it only solidified and became more pristine!

She asked herself why this thread of the remnant of the Origin Singed happened to introduce itself to her and nobody else as she came to the decision that even this was what the flow of the Wheel intended.
So at this moment, she did not raise her voice to speak up to the crowd of others that she was currently in contact with a thread of weaving of the Origin Singed.
If and when the flow of the Wheel intended to reveal him to others, then it would occur.
After all, how did that unknown enemy know of Ezekiel, and what would happen if they came to know of a thread of remnant weavings of the Origin Singed?

So until whatever time or place the Wheel intended to reveal things, she would study and follow the Origin Singed as they faced an unknown enemy of terrifying proportions who was capable of even slipping past the main weavings of the Origin Singed and many others that they had only heard of in the cycles past.
Ezekiel looked at the many Singed gathered here as he continued with a weak voice.
"The unknown force that has slipped through the cracks is a patient one and a terrifying one, as I was not able to see much of its weavings during our altercation.
The fact that I stand before you here now and have not entirely perished just lets you know the flow of the Wheel is very much intact and that this enemy is likely grievously injured.
But since he has made this move against me, he must know where his greatest opposition lies.
In the near future, you all can expect heavy losses to come.
Do not take these losses as if they are the end, as I assure you...they are just the beginning."
WAA!
"Stand strong, and let the flame guide you.
And may you never be truly extinguished."

With such words, the magnificent half visage of Ezekiel, a Prime Source Complexity, fizzled out into bursts of flames that were then pulled into the world sized wisp of a Flame that now that lay behind him!
The weavings of a Prime Source Entity had all but collapsed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3557 Loss! I
paragraphs: There was a moment of profound sorrow as the brilliant multicolored flames nearby all flickered and became that much dimmer after the collapse of a Prime Source Singed.

Mysara looked at the scene with silent contemplation as she thought of the way that they now had to fight against enemies they had considered to be at a certain level, but now had a terrifying backer that even they could not understand.
If the Prime Source Ezekiel was attacked and collapsed because of it, how would the rest of them fight against such a being?

She only just had this thought, and in the next moment, a commotion arose in a distant part of the entrance of this domain as a Singed with the form of a Golden Dragon bathed with halcyon crystalline scales appeared with a roar!
Its body looked battered with crimson gold blood, its wings torn and clipped as its aura was unfathomably weak.
It appeared as it howled out in a pained roar!

"The weavings of the Prime Frequency of Life have collapsed! Countless Dark Towers have risen as every shred of weaving, Megalos, and Expanse are covered by interminable darkness! The flow of the Wheel is entirely obscured as nothing can be seen there, and nothing can be done!"
This entity roared out as his body held a terrific source of a Greater Source Complexity.

And yet, in the midst of his roars, his weavings rapidly collapsed as his scales lost to their golden luster, and the moment that his words finished, everything about him collapsed and dispersed into golden flames that then serenely flowed into the world-sized Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel in the distance!
One shocking event after another.
A Prime Frequency had fallen into the hands of their enemies as what did this mean?!
The many Singed here looked at each other before in the next moment, a woman with flaming white hair and dazzling golden flames seething around her rose up.
It was another Prime Source Complexity of the Singed. Another one of their pillars that held their support and power across the Frequencies!
It was Emelline of the First Flame.

"We know now our mission, and we have the backing of the Wheel of Existence itself. We know of our enemies and the threat that lies ahead as Ezekiel uttered- do not falter nor stumble! Since we know everything that we need, we can now move without reservation and ensure that these enemies do not have their way. We have been told to expect a level of loss as so far, we have watched Ezekiel return to the flames and Bayan follow along with him.

That is just it- their return to the flame where they once were. Before any of us makes our return, let us be sure that we made heavy contributions to prevent the altering and corruption of the flow of the Wheel!"
HUUM!

Her voice was resonant as it boomed out and caused the seething flames all around to surge with brilliance and wonder, the vibrance revitalized as the Singed looked at each other before they began to move.
"Scour the Prime Frequency of Life- figure out how they altered the flow of the Wheel there!"
Orders began to fly out.
Different tasks were assigned!
The weavings of the Wheel seethed
In a truly distant weaving of existence.
In the Prime Frequency of Life.

A Faceless Lifeform grabbed the vertical white bar on its head and peeled it apart as if it were a zipper on a suit, his head obsidian in nature being exposed outside as he took a deep breath of contentment and confidence.
He did not burn up, and nor was he attacked by terrifying flames of unknown origins.
He freely existed without worry of the flames of the Wheel!
All around him, tenebrous black brilliance covered everything in layers, multiple Dark Towers releasing black strings of weavings all around.
At this moment.
SAA!
A Black Cat appeared, her stellar vertical eyes looking at the face of this man unveiled from the black suit of the Faceless Lifeforms as they watered and became emotional!
"Giuseppe..."
She called out his name as he turned around to see her.
His obsidian skin shone with a stellar luster as he smiled while turning to her.

"I wanted to surprise you with this one thing. You always said I was not a romantic...so here it is. How do you like the new me, Azzurra? I lied to you that you would not be able to see me again for eons, for that, I am sorry."
He gave a dazzling smile as the Black Cat transformed into a gorgeous black haired woman with a curvaceous visage.
She had tears in her eyes as she went forward and held the face of Giuseppe, the brilliance in his eyes seeming just as radiance she remembered!
He smiled even more brilliantly as he embraced her.

"I told you before. To effect any change, a necessary violence is required. And now, we have taken our first step! I gift this Prime Frequency of Life as my gift to you- free from the flow of the Wheel, unfettered by any bindings! Here, your Source can flourish indefinitely. Your source can burn brilliantly. Here, we will enact weavings others cannot even imagine..."
His voice became grandiose as he turned and waved his hands to the stellar tenebrous expanse filled with black strings of existence that exuded a regal aura of majesty.
Near the Dark Towers, obsidian portals unfurled en masse as from them, throngs of Faceless Lifeforms ushered out.
By the thousands.
The vast majority were Pioneers, but there were also brilliant Sources coming through as well!
Giuseppe looked towards all of them while holding Azzurra, his eyes luminous as he thought of the future to come.
Beside him, Azzurra voiced out with a sense of awe.
"What now?"
"Now, my dear Azzurra, we truly begin our assault. The Prime Frequency of Life was just the first. Many more will follow. Before we know it, all of these weavings will fall under our banner..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3558 Loss! II
paragraphs: The loss of the Prime Frequency of Life!
Very few knew about it, and even fewer would understand it even if they were told about it.
Some may even ask- what even was a Prime Frequency?

Too little even knew of what had occurred as in a certain Frequency, Noah Osmont grasped a fantastical golden Spoke connected to a heart as he stared at a Megalos that was radiating a terrifying sense of exuberance!
The gray fractured lines...were all swept away as in his hand, the Piece of the Spoke of the Wheel pulsed with radiance.
He could feel it.
It cried for more and more!
What it could do was still a profound mystery as what he did just now...seemed minor!
"Haha...what glory. With this tool, I may just be able to witness the solution of the Three Body Problem before my weavings entirely collapse."
On the surface of the sleek Spoke, the head of Old Man Eudemus remained as it was flaming gold, his face exuding a sense of vitality that was alive and yet not alive.
Noah looked towards Old Man Eudemus with a sense of pity as he sighed.
In search of answers at every possible cost, the result was sometimes a heavy one!
He could feel the weavings of Old Man Eudemus barely remain under his efforts.
As he looked at this...
"O Origin Singed..."
The voice of Mysara held musings of somberness and hesitation as they rang out behind him.
He turned to her as he saw under her calmness, there was a sense of turbidity as he asked.
"What is it?"
A simple question. And yet her answer was one that opened far too many doors as instead of speaking, Mysara waved her hands to release a vibrant burst of weavings that contained a record.
A memory!
Noah accepted it freely into his hands as he saw the record laid within and began perusing through it rapidly.
It was a record of a few minutes.
It showed events unfolding with a domain filled with Flames of the Wheel, with a burning Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel burning brightly in the background!
The record was a few minutes long, but he perused through it in the span of a second.
He saw many things
He saw Ezekiel, a Prime Source Singed!

He heard the shocking threads of information that the entities who had left this whole time- entities he believed to have chosen to isolate themselves from any and all Entanglements as they elevated their Sources.
And yet one person said otherwise.
Whether this was true or not still remained to be known, but what he said was undoubtedly shocking!
That something had slipped past the terrifyingly powerful entities they had only ever heard of in the past eons, and this was the one behind the Faceless Lifeforms.
But more than this.
Right after a Prime Source Singed perished, a Greater Source Singed also fell as they passed on the message.
The Prime Frequency of Life had its weavings of the Wheel unfathomably altered!
One bad news after another.
Noah looked at all of this as his gaze became grim, feeling the golden Spoke he held in his hands as well as his complexity!
The Singed. Megalos. Infinity. Outerversal.
He had just begun to open up Pathways to the True Sources that were only for him, as even with his rapid pace, it seemed that he still had to be even faster!
So he grasped the golden Spoke as he thought about all the weavings he was entangled in, his eyes burning with a fearsome light!
"Let this Frequency be secured once and for all!"
He moved instinctively.

His weavings radiated a terrifying light of brilliance as with the massive Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel in his right hand, he pointed it forward as its tip buzzed with brilliance, tearing the space ahead apart!
|The weaving of Megalos Purification and Empowerment has been recorded and clarified under the banner of the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel.|
|The Weaving of Megalos Traversal are being utilized for the first time.|
Prompts rose over his eyes and passed just as quickly.
Megalos Traversal.
Anywhere within the Megalos and Expanse inside a Frequency could be traversed in but an instant!
He received this knowledge instinctively as, in the next moment, the tip of the Spoke tore open a massive golden flaming rift that Noah stepped into.
Behind him, Mysara and Tam did not tarry as they stepped through as well.
WAP!
Existence distorted.
When they appeared again, they were no longer within what was known in the past as the Megalos Ynnere- with the massive world sized visage of Noah arrived in what was known as the Megalos Beyond!
At this very moment, the gray tears in space were burning and being turned to ash from the effect of the very same Spoke he held- its effects stretching out across all Megalos at this moment!
And yet he still arrived in the Megalos Beyond.
In the region where at this moment, Ozymandias sat on an obsidian flaming throne conjured by the Pathway to the True Source of Outerversal.
Where the Inheritor of the Megalos vibrated instantly as countless possibilities of himself fought for stability within a single Source- within a single anchor!
At the same time, Persephael and McAllister stared towards the appearance of Noah in shock, this being the exact target they were looking for!
Behind them, Faceless Lifeforms began to feel a sense of trepidation at the golden Spoke that looked like a massive javelin.
Noah appeared far too quickly as Mysara and Tam appeared behind him right after, with his gaze being utterly heavy at this moment as he raised the Spoke and swung down.
"Purify that which wishes to alter the flow of existence."
HUUM!
Purification.
A simple capability of the Spoke he held!
At this moment, it shot out and warped across space as this whole time, Noah had it pointed to the Inheritor of the Megalos. And yet...
Half of the Spoke disappeared as existence tore, and a golden rift bloomed right behind Persephael at a speed that even she, as a Greater Source Complexity, could not capture!
The immeasurably sharp point of the Spoke of the Wheel was right above her head as it shone with an undeniable light of extinction!

chapters.title: Chapter 3559 The Fall of a Greater Source!
paragraphs: He had uttered.
He spoke and stated the words that let the Spoke Purify that which sought to alter the weavings of Existence!
And the Spoke that caused a sensation of terror on every single entity here actually warped across space and had its tip descend on the head of none other than Persephael.
Persephael!
Her gaze changed in real time as her whole visage began to manifest a crystalline glass-like appearance, Lapidekinesis blooming out as the grandiose Source that it was!
But...
CRACK!
The tip of the Spoke already touched her body as the sound of shattering glass could be heard.
The eyes of Persephael froze.
Before Noah's eyes.
|The weavings of Persephael have been studied and understood.|
|The weavings of Persephael are being Purified. |
|The Source born from scattered weavings of existence does not represent something born of the true self and is thus viable for collapse and disintegration.|
HUUM!

A dominating and wondrous hum boomed out in the surroundings, the back of the head of Persephael seeming like a point where all weavings of existence nearby were clustered as from it, the incandescence of an unfathomable flame bloomed and entered her crystalline body.

Her expression remained frozen in utter shock and horror, her Source at this moment being filled with liquid gold flames to the point that she seemed like a multicolored crystalline husk that was filled with golden flaming liquid.

McAllister and the Faceless Lifeforms nearby observed this scene that occurred far too fast as they roared, and yet Noah dominatingly twisted the Spoke he held in his hands as cracks spread across the body of Persephael, her crystalline visage beginning to crack before her Source...
Oh, her pristine Source!
Such a Source elevated in complexity from Lesser to Greater burned with a light of purification as everything that it stood for was burned away!
In the eyes of Persephael, the crystalline glow of Lapidekinesis entirely faded as her pupils became humane.
Tears that were evaporated slid down her eyes in this instant as she felt an utterly tremendous pain that she wanted to deny.
And yet...it was undeniable.
Her skin became pink and fair.
And thereafter...
BOOM!
She exploded into an amalgamation of liquid gold rivers of flames that seethed out towards the nearby Faceless Lifeforms!
And where she stood, a truly Purified Source Pearl of a Greater Source Complexity floated as it looked amplified, elevated, and even further empowered.
In the next instant, it shot out into Noah's hand and disappeared as, at this time, the first Greater Source Complexity fell under his hands.
A Watcher of the Wheelomachy fell under his hand!
But even with all of this...
"OOOH!"

He bellowed out as the weavings of the Pathway to the True Source of Infinity burned within him, blue brilliance surging from him and entering the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel he held as he grasped it with both hands and pressed down!

The rivers of flames that had shot out of the visage of Persephael had surged to coil around the Faceless Lifeforms here that were approximately 25 in number- each one Lesser as when terrifying black flames and towers tried to manifest from their bodies, the flames of the Spoke burned them away.
And thereafter, Noah's single action of pressing the javelin like Spoke down allowed streamed of his weavings to flow through all of these flaming rivers before in the next moment.
Within the coiled rivers around 25 Lesser Source Faceless Lifeforms.
A singularity bloomed.
|Multiple True Severed Megalocides have been expressed through the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel.|
|True Severed Singed Megalocides bloom for the sake of purity.|

White gold circular Megalocides bloomed to cover every single Faceless Lifeform, their bodies becoming entirely bathed in the light of emboldened and utterly aflame Megalocides that subsequently exploded with a terrifying degree of power!

It was akin to countless millions of golden Pantheons and Omniverses combusting and crushing around these Faceless Lifeforms, the veil they wore being utterly ripped apart and incinerated by the terrifying weavings of the Spoke paired with Noah's Pathway of the Megalos! In but a moment, the weavings of the Faceless Lifeforms were incinerated as they left behind 25 dazzling Source Pearls radiating an air of profound purity, all of it surging towards Noah's and disappearing in a burst of flames as all of this...took less than a second since his arrival here!
A Greater Source fell, and 25 Lesser Source Complexities followed right after.
DUM!
The Heart on the Spoke pulsed at such a time with fervent brilliance as if it had drunk the blood of these Sources, and Noah flung the javelin like Spoke across the Megalos Beyond.
All those watching with a sense of horror and stupefaction observed this while wondering- what now?
The single visage of the McAllister who was not targetted watched on with a terrifying gaze as in the next moment...
WAP!
Noah's figure appeared in front of him and stared at McAllister coldly!
"Father-in-law."
He spoke words that caused McAllister to tremble in shock and fury as in Noah's hand, he clenched his fist while a Megalocide bloomed within it.
A Megalocide- in the palm of his right hand!
He then held the shoulder of McAllister as he looked at him straight in the eyes and asked.
"Who was it that gave the order for the mission to ensure my entry into Hell Terra Firma?"
He asked such a question while his fist shot out- smashing into the stomach of McAllister as his eyes nearly bulged out of their socket while receiving the impact of a Megalocide inside a fist!
Father-in-law, he was called.
His Lesser Source buzzed with an unfathomable sense of disbelief and fury, but before he could even process these weavings...
"Do not take too long, Father-in-law. There is but a single reason why you are still alive. But I can very well keep you alive while still crushing your source. So I ask again- who?"
Who?!
This single word boomed within the weavings of a regretful father!

sentences.text: He had uttered.
He spoke and stated the words that let the Spoke Purify that which sought to alter the weavings of Existence!
And the Spoke that caused a sensation of terror on every single entity here actually warped across space and had its tip descend on the head of none other than Persephael.
Persephael!
Her gaze changed in real time as her whole visage began to manifest a crystalline glass-like appearance, Lapidekinesis blooming out as the grandiose Source that it was!
But...
CRACK!
The tip of the Spoke already touched her body as the sound of shattering glass could be heard.
The eyes of Persephael froze.
Before Noah's eyes.
|The weavings of Persephael have been studied and understood.|
|The weavings of Persephael are being Purified. |
|The Source born from scattered weavings of existence does not represent something born of the true self and is thus viable for collapse and disintegration.|
HUUM!

A dominating and wondrous hum boomed out in the surroundings, the back of the head of Persephael seeming like a point where all weavings of existence nearby were clustered as from it, the incandescence of an unfathomable flame bloomed and entered her crystalline body.

Her expression remained frozen in utter shock and horror, her Source at this moment being filled with liquid gold flames to the point that she seemed like a multicolored crystalline husk that was filled with golden flaming liquid.

McAllister and the Faceless Lifeforms nearby observed this scene that occurred far too fast as they roared, and yet Noah dominatingly twisted the Spoke he held in his hands as cracks spread across the body of Persephael, her crystalline visage beginning to crack before her Source...
Oh, her pristine Source!
Such a Source elevated in complexity from Lesser to Greater burned with a light of purification as everything that it stood for was burned away!
In the eyes of Persephael, the crystalline glow of Lapidekinesis entirely faded as her pupils became humane.
Tears that were evaporated slid down her eyes in this instant as she felt an utterly tremendous pain that she wanted to deny.
And yet...it was undeniable.
Her skin became pink and fair.
And thereafter...
BOOM!
She exploded into an amalgamation of liquid gold rivers of flames that seethed out towards the nearby Faceless Lifeforms!
And where she stood, a truly Purified Source Pearl of a Greater Source Complexity floated as it looked amplified, elevated, and even further empowered.
In the next instant, it shot out into Noah's hand and disappeared as, at this time, the first Greater Source Complexity fell under his hands.
A Watcher of the Wheelomachy fell under his hand!
But even with all of this...
"OOOH!"

He bellowed out as the weavings of the Pathway to the True Source of Infinity burned within him, blue brilliance surging from him and entering the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel he held as he grasped it with both hands and pressed down!

The rivers of flames that had shot out of the visage of Persephael had surged to coil around the Faceless Lifeforms here that were approximately 25 in number- each one Lesser as when terrifying black flames and towers tried to manifest from their bodies, the flames of the Spoke burned them away.
And thereafter, Noah's single action of pressing the javelin like Spoke down allowed streamed of his weavings to flow through all of these flaming rivers before in the next moment.
Within the coiled rivers around 25 Lesser Source Faceless Lifeforms.
A singularity bloomed.
|Multiple True Severed Megalocides have been expressed through the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel.|
|True Severed Singed Megalocides bloom for the sake of purity.|

White gold circular Megalocides bloomed to cover every single Faceless Lifeform, their bodies becoming entirely bathed in the light of emboldened and utterly aflame Megalocides that subsequently exploded with a terrifying degree of power!

It was akin to countless millions of golden Pantheons and Omniverses combusting and crushing around these Faceless Lifeforms, the veil they wore being utterly ripped apart and incinerated by the terrifying weavings of the Spoke paired with Noah's Pathway of the Megalos!

In but a moment, the weavings of the Faceless Lifeforms were incinerated as they left behind 25 dazzling Source Pearls radiating an air of profound purity, all of it surging towards Noah's and disappearing in a burst of flames as all of this...took less than a second since his arrival here!
A Greater Source fell, and 25 Lesser Source Complexities followed right after.
DUM!
The Heart on the Spoke pulsed at such a time with fervent brilliance as if it had drunk the blood of these Sources, and Noah flung the javelin like Spoke across the Megalos Beyond.
All those watching with a sense of horror and stupefaction observed this while wondering- what now?
The single visage of the McAllister who was not targetted watched on with a terrifying gaze as in the next moment...
WAP!
Noah's figure appeared in front of him and stared at McAllister coldly!
"Father-in-law."
He spoke words that caused McAllister to tremble in shock and fury as in Noah's hand, he clenched his fist while a Megalocide bloomed within it.
A Megalocide- in the palm of his right hand!
He then held the shoulder of McAllister as he looked at him straight in the eyes and asked.
"Who was it that gave the order for the mission to ensure my entry into Hell Terra Firma?"
He asked such a question while his fist shot out- smashing into the stomach of McAllister as his eyes nearly bulged out of their socket while receiving the impact of a Megalocide inside a fist!
Father-in-law, he was called.
His Lesser Source buzzed with an unfathomable sense of disbelief and fury, but before he could even process these weavings...
"Do not take too long, Father-in-law.
There is but a single reason why you are still alive.
But I can very well keep you alive while still crushing your source.
So I ask again- who?"
Who?!
This single word boomed within the weavings of a regretful father!

chapters.title: Chapter 3560 Closure! I
paragraphs: McAllister.

A Lesser Source Entity from the Logos of the Wheel who gave a simple mission to his daughter not too long ago, but this mission led to Noah being trapped in Hell Terra Firma before he broke out, leading to the initiation of the Change that had gray cracks spread out across Megalos and Frequencies!
Gray cracks lowered Atmospheric Weavings of Existence and reduced the power that many could use against the Faceless Lifeforms that rose right after.
Noah asked such a being- who was behind all of this?!
McAllister had an unfocused gaze as his eyes turned crimson from his source being shaken so heavily, his breath wheezing out as he spoke with difficulty.
"Barbatos...is she safe? Is she okay?"
His daughter.
The one he treated far too unfairly!
Noah grasped his shoulder tighter as the Megalocide burning within his fist swung out again, smashing into McAllister as he replied coldly.
"She is living her best life right now. On a little vacation, good food, good company, nothing to worry about. Do you want to see her?"

His words thundered in his ears as McAllister felt the fragility of his source in front of this being, and after what he had just said, he could only sigh internally as he spoke out while crimson gold blood freely flowed.
"Azzurra...a powerful Entity that may have already exceeded Greater Source, or maybe not. She at times takes the form of a Black Cat."
He broke his many oaths to the Logos of the Wheel as he released weavings of information, his eyes beginning to bleed as something within his weavings was triggered!
A safeguard to ensure that weavings of information were not released freely.
Noah's hand burned with flames and entered McAllister's body as he scorched the newly arriving weavings and continued.
"Give me more of her weavings. How she looks, conversations you've had."
He spoke commandingly as while unfocused, McAllister generated a bundle of multicolored brilliance that Noah grasped- musings of the Black Cat entering his mind as he nodded!

He released the shoulder of McAllister and used his left hand to make a tear in space that led straight into the Infiniverse Megalos- right above the Frequency Gateway as in the next moment, he kicked McAllister's body into the portal as he tumbled like a brilliant light towards the Frequency Gateway and straight into the path that would take him into Hell Terra Firma!
Where his authority would be all but gone.
Where his daughter could look at him in the eyes for everything that was done.

While Noah was doing this, he had flung the massive javelin-looking Spoke towards a certain direction- this naturally being towards Ozymandias as in the surroundings, the Outerversal Morphons watched what was happening with utter stupefaction.
Like...what the hell was even going on?!
Who was this terrifying new entrant that had just killed multiple Lesser Sources and even a Greater Source?!
In the middle of all these questions, they were terrified to see the massive Spoke that had decimated even the weavings of a Greater Source go towards the Ozymandias.
But...why was the handle pointed towards him?
In the midst of stupefaction and incredulity, Ozymandias raised his hand as it enlarged and erupted with white gold flames- latent tattoos blooming on his hand as he grasped the Spoke naturally!

It was a scene that caused the jaws to drop as Mysara and Tam who were watching all of this were dumbfounded, having barely recovered from watching Persephael be decimated as now, the grand Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel that the Origin Singed held...was transferred to another entity shrouded in Dark Matter as this entity erupted with the same white gold flames to wield it!
Ozymandias.
Ozymandias held the radiant Spoke as on it; the face of Old Man Eudemus was initially shocked before he uttered out.
"I see...I see! You already had both Matter and Dark Matter!"

His words were those of a crazed scholar who just seemed to now be learning many things, while Mysara's eyes opened wide in surprise as the pure eruption of white gold flames around Ozymandias who raised the Spoke and pointed it towards the unstable visage of the Inheritor of the Megalos!
"Purify that which is impure."
HUUUM!
The Spoke in his hand vibrated as if fervent with desire; its tip pointed towards the Inheritor of the Megalos.
The Inheritor of the Great Beyonder.
Countless faces were trying to come out of their skin as if they sought to break apart and form their own identity.
The Inheritor, against the one it called the False Instrument of the Beyonder...could actually not keep its weavings that were amalgamated across Frequencies together as its fate was sealed.
The Spoke began to burn with terrifying white gold flames- beginning to spin in the hand of Ozymandias as a terrifying scorching temperature spread out!
In the middle of all of this, the voice of Ozymandias rang out once more.
"And you called me False..."
WAA!
A single statement.
But it was one that nearly woke the Inheritor out of its instability as it howled!
And right before the spinning Spoke made a move...something else bloomed within both Ozymandias and Noah's bodies.
|The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has been randomly ignited by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.|
Within him, His Heart that contained many overlapping Hearts pulsed and released threads of glory.
|Randomly, the selection of seconds has been selected.|

|The passage of seconds may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of the Protagonist.|
|The Severed Weavings of the Protagonist, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surge across Severings and heads towards its Final Severed State!|
As he stood and pointed a terrifying javelin that spun with terrifying flames.
As he faced an entity that called him false!
Randomly, his weavings of the Protagonist surged up as if to declare.
There was only a single Protagonist!

chapters.title: Chapter 3561 Closure! II
paragraphs: The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity was triggered at such a critical juncture as it stated that not even seconds would pass before he became stronger!
And so, a unique part of his began its severings towards the critical 81st spot before Ruination even processed and multiplied the multiple Purified Source Pearls that were just obtained.
Before any resources among those he had gained were utilized, the Pathway to the True Source of Infinity continued to exceed all wonders!
HUUUM!

From his hands, the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel flew out as it rotated with stellar white gold flames, drawing in the weavings of Matter and Dark Matter nearby as its tip was pointed towards a single enemy.
DUM!
In the surroundings.
DUM!
A symphony began to play.
A Symphony that was welcoming none other than the protagonist as it felt heavy, and the beat was thick!
DUM!
Mysara began looking around to find the source of this new beat, but it felt like it was pressing down and spreading across the Megalos as she could not pinpoint it.
It only coincided with the visage of Ozymandias looking towards the Inheritor of the Megalos that he had denied the weavings of coldly, his voice echoing it as the Spoke arrived before this entity.
"Greatness was not written for you...not in this Frequency, or any others. False or true mean nothing before countless rounds of Severings!"
BZZT!
The spinning tip of the Spoke smashed into the Inheritor of the Megalos as it buzzed with a cry of fervor.
A cry of someone that was given everything the day it was born, with their future already planned!
They were meant to inherit the Megalos. They were meant to carry the torch of the Great Beyonder!
They were...
"The Inheritor..." An overlap of countless voices boomed out as the Inheritor of the Megalos regained a semblance of control.
Its Source- layered by many others' wills, raged with cognizance as behind it, the Megalos themselves began to twist.
As if it was trying to dredge up control for the last time!
"I am...the Inheritor!"
AWOO!
It roared out a howl to muster up its ecstatic force, and yet Ozymandias only glared at it coldly as, in an instant, the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel stopped spinning.
"What you are...is dead."
The stopped Spoke released every ounce of pressure and force into a single point, a blinding white gold line shooting out from the head of the Inheritor of the Megalos and all the way through it.
After that, its body began to fill with liquid gold flames- its obsidian luster beginning to shine with a scintillating radiance as if it were a statue!
Its eyes were layers of streams of consciousness as it looked towards Ozymandias.
It showed immense unwillingness.
Immense resignation!
Immense sadness.
"It was...all set up for me."
Its voice, filled with a sense of desolation, echoed out.
At this moment, Ozymandias was silent while watching the end of this creature.
Its fate...was something he hated the most.
So he gave it its last moment.
He gave it a moment of silence.
"It was destined for me...I was just...following the set path."
Yes.
The worst thing he could imagine.
A predetermined destiny.
A path he had to follow!
And all he did was seek to follow it as this being...never looked for his own path.

Noah and Ozymandias looked at its eyes as it became filled with liquid gold flames, cracks beginning to spread throughout it as in the next moment, an illusory radiance flashed that showed hundreds of four-legged beasts flash within the Inheritor of the Megalos.
Each carried their own complexity and emotions, but were all ultimately the same as every single one became purified under glorious flames.

With a sense of tremendous sadness, the massive body of the Inheritor of the Megalos melted under the grandeur of countless liquid flames, its weavings not made a show of as these flames dispersed silently.
They rose and spread around the Megalos Beyond like ash being scattered across it, what came from it being returned as even Ozymandias closed his eyes!

Where the Inheritor of the Megalos used to be, 9 dazzling Source Pearls floated amidst vibrant golden flames, and at the very center- an utterly ecstatic Source Complexity Rune of Existence that read...BEYONDER could be seen!

It was obsidian red in nature, and countless archaic lines covered it as Ozymandias opened his singularities and waved his hands- everything flowing towards him as the Source Pearls disappeared, and the Rune of the BEYONDER landed in his hand.
The Beyonder.
There was a delicate entanglement with this being as he did not have any conflict with them.
But he also knew that Runes were powerful, with their owners being able to sense them and their utilization even from afar.
Even the Rune of Amarantos only became his after it was truly Severed!
As for this Rune of the BEYONDER, it held the set path this being had set down for their instrument.

He had taken the distinction and proclaimed it a few times before, but as he looked at the Source Rune carrying a terrifying significance before him, white gold flames surged around him, and the Spoke turned around while pointing its sharp end onto this Rune of Existence.
"From this day on, I shall no longer be the instrument of any weaving."
HUUM!
The white gold flames latched onto the dazzling Rune of Existence as above, the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel appeared and exerted its terrifying pressure downwards!
A light of profound purification burned as in the distance, many Outerversal Morphons watched on breathlessly.
The bodies of the Great Mother and Little Aspasia trembled as they heard the words of Ozymandias.

They saw him burn the terrifying Rune of the BEYONDER, extreme heat gathering around it as it slowly lost its obsidian red state, being turned white gold as any identity and weaving it held before was being erased!
Gradually, the meaning of the Rune began to change as another weaving took its place.
A weaving that was being born in a terrifying Severed State in real time!
