chapters.title: Chapter 3562 Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist! I
paragraphs: Gradually, the form of the Rune of the BEYONDER lost its structure as it was used as a base for something else entirely.
Little by little, the musings of...the Protagonist began to bloom from the base of the BEYONDER!
At the same time, his weavings buzzed as incandescent golden radiance shot above him like a brilliant pillar- and it remained shining akin to a spotlight.
|The Severed Weavings of the Protagonist have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of the Protagonist has opened.|
|The True Severed Protagonist of Existence has been born.|
DUM!
The golden pillar became even more incandescent.
The symphony in the surroundings reaches a crescendo as, at this moment, hymns of voices ring out like a chorus!
HO! HO! HO!
Golden brilliance shot up like a tide to illuminate the figures of two beings, Mysara and many others observing this with stupefaction.
Mysara received her confirmation at this moment as she realized somehow, the Origin Singed had a body based on Matter and a Body based on Dark Matter.
All eyes honed in on the body based on Dark Matter as they saw the rune that used to be BEYONDER had been entirely altered as it lost its precious identity and now read...PROTAGONIST!
"The Protagonist?" The Great Mother uttered the word that felt foreign as everything she knew felt like it was crumbling down.
But she then remembered Ozymandias.
What had occured in the Expanse.
How she, in the clutches of a Pioneer was saved by him and he protected her that whole time!
How when she mentioned Faceless Lifeforms decimating Pantheons of the Megalos Beyond, he came!
There were many things that she did not understand.
But...she knew the character of the Instrume-, nay, Ozymandias, more than anything.
So at this moment, the weavings of the Great Mother rose up with fervor as she screamed out at the top of her tentacles!
"Ozymandias...the Protagonist!"
HUUM!
Ozymandias, the Protagonist.
She called this out as around her, the Observer of Old and Young, the Great Wheel, and many others looked at each other as their weavings trembled.
The Inheritor of the Megalos was just destroyed as the only one with the connection to the Beyonder stripped himself of the title of an Instrument.
What could they do but fall in line?
"Ozymandias...the Protagonist!"
Little Aspasia, radiant with stellar black brilliance, shouted out alongside the Great Mother as others could only fold and call out while a vibrant, heavy Regnum unfolded ahead.

A black flaming crown and throne burned as a brand new Rune of the Protagonist was taken into the chest of Ozymandias, the symphony and hymns beginning their descent as in the next moment, the Piece of the Spoke of the Wheel flowed towards Noah's visage as he appeared next to Mysara. "Clear these Megalos of all Faceless Lifeforms. After the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere are free of any influence, Megalos Nihilos shall be cleansed as well, the Expanse following thereafter! This Frequency...will not be falling to anything!"
WAA!

His eyes pulsed with majesty as Mysara and Tam nodded, blue-gold flames erupting from the former as she received weavings from Noah that told her exactly where any remnants of Faceless Lifeforms were.
After all...he had the Map of the Megalos Beyond at this moment too as currently, everything was laid bare!

In the Megalos Ynnere, the Sages under the lead of the Maharishi and Yoo Jin were released to cleanse it of the remaining weak Faceless Lifeforms, as in these Megalos...none of their influence would remain.
No gray cracks of the change. No Faceless Lifeforms. No Dark Towers. Simply...the brilliance and Tyranny of a single being continuing to spread out.
As such a wonder unfolded, his own weavings rang out hymns of the arrival of something grand as halcyon brilliance culminated to a burst of heavy weavings!
|You are stepping into the Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist.|

|True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence has been unlocked. Your weavings of Existence are able to augment their current parameters and limitations to surpass any opposition that you face. No wall is unscalable under the tyranny of the True Severed Adaptive Power. The gap between you and your enemy may seem utterly inconceivable. Impossible to scale. And yet somehow, one way or another, whether it be during the battle or the days that follow- this impossible gap in power will be closed until at the end, you stand victorious.|

|The Pathways to the True Source of the Protagonist and Infinity have come together to enact the True Severed Condition Infinitum. Your weavings are those that will increase over time without limit. This includes the aspect of Strength Infinitum, Speed Infinitum, Intelligence Infinitum, Complexity Infinitum, Stamina Infinitum, and more aspects of your weavings.|
|The True Severed Final Form of the Protagonist has been unlocked.|
|The Power of Friendship has been unlocked.|
|The Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist awaits for the weavings of Plot and Cheats to open their own paths for even grander musings of existence.|
Noah's weavings were surging with utter wildness.
The Protagonist came in and absolutely shattered the entrance as it began slowly and then accelerated, and just when one thought it was over...
|You are your own Opposition in meeting the needs of the Protagonist.|

|True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence has been triggered, your own weavings seeking to overcome to meet the desires of the Protagonist. To adapt, the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has been triggered.|
|Not so randomly, the selection of an instant has been selected.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a not-so-random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has purposefully declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Plot and Cheats.|

|The Severed Weavings of Plot and Cheats, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity that was initiated by True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence, surge across Severings and heads towards their Final Severed State!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3563 Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist! II
paragraphs: The True Severed Protagonist had just come to fruition, and yet it was already making grandiose moves!
It initiated many things, and the end result was for Cheats and Plot to continue their severing as they surged toward their Final Severed State.
As this occurred.
Noah held the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel with the Heart of the Megalos Ynnere at its base as he continued to communicate with it.
Its uses had shown themselves to be extremely potent against the Sources of entities- especially so against the Faceless Lifeforms!
It could Purify to a terrifying extent as its other major uses were traversal.
He could enter the Megalos Beyond and the Megalos Ynnere freely.
There was the the Megalos Nihilos.
The place filled with Anti-Matter!
The one state of matter he had not gotten into.

It seemed like a long time ago, but it had only been a matter of days when he theorized adding a source of Anti-Matter into the depths of his existence, but it did not work as he found that his weavings would become too unstable.
But that was then.
And this was now.
His complexity had gotten tremendously greater, and he even held the Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist!
A Pathway that held True Severed Condition Infinitum and True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence!
With the Adaptive Power alone, he was confident in grasping the musings of Anti-Matter.
And now, there was also the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel!
Noah held it tightly as he breathed flames into it while speaking out.
"The veil between Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter...let it all be broken here."
HUUM!

His weavings danced dangerously and with wild abandon as behind him, Ozymandias had shattered the Megalos Beyond with a punch to shatter the veil that Noah had already filled with the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
He was able to do this because he had a connection that very clearly observed this veil.
There was no such connection between him and Anti-Matter.
But he did have the Spoke!

And it would traverse through the veil freely as, at this moment; he pulled the access the Spoke had through this veil- putting his Severed Flames into it as its tip pointed into a blank space in the Megalos Beyond and began releasing seas of white gold flames that seemingly disappeared into nothingness!
But, they were entering another veil entirely.
At this moment, Noah foresaw a grandiose scene.
In this area he stood on where the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond already met.
The veil to the Megalos Nihilos would also be torn at the same place as all three would meet in one place!
Just like all three had to be incorporated into the Tzar Versepiercer.
Just like all three had to be incorporated within him!
His eyes burned with ambition as while they did so...
|The Severed Weavings of Plot and Cheats have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Plot has opened.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Cheats has opened.|
Tremendously heavy concepts born from the weavings of the Protagonist attained a Pathway that led to an undeniable True Source.
DUM!
His Heart of Infinity beat heavily in anticipation.
As if two slumbering behemoths were waking up to stand side by side with a few others!
And just when one of them woke up...
|The Pathway to the True Source has finally attained weavings that can allow it to enact its grander picture.|

|The Pathway to the True Source of Plot calls upon the Pathways to the True Sources of the Singed, Megalos, Infinity, Outerversal, Protagonist, and Cheats to enact something it has always dreamed of!|
Within him, interminable weavings exploded as multiple Pathways to True Sources came together and supported a single one!
Many weavings fell under the banner of Plot for it to go utterly crazy.
And...
|The Weavings of Limited Fictional Transcendence have begun to bloom within the depths of your complexity.|

|A brainchild of Plots and Cheats as they seek a more distinct and greater path that exceeds others around you, seeking to view the countless weavings of existence as layers upon layers of fables- stories and fictions of which you are a part.|
|When the weavings of existence can be viewed through this lens, it becomes possible to alter such weavings tremendously with very little effort.|
|By living between the boundary of what is fiction and what is real, you can exert an unfathomable amount of change against complex weavings that would otherwise not be conducive to any change.|
|For example.|
Noah's body pulsed as his weavings were going utterly nuts!
The advent of Plot and Cheats came with a brainchild of utter madness on their end as with the complexity of the Protagonist and others, they sought to do something grand!
|The Line between fiction and reality has been distorted.|
|There is no veil that separates Anti-Matter from Matter and Dark Matter- such a thing having crumbled long ago.|
BOOM!
Where Noah had the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel pointed as he was filled an endlessly vast veil with the flames of the Singed.
The weavings of space shattered and crumpled entirely as it felt like a glass mirror was broken!
Embers of flames seethed as if the skies and land were cracked, leading to another place entirely!
White gray space bloomed on the other side.
Weavings of Nihilos began to seethe and spill out like a tide- an incandescent white brilliance beginning to spill out of the shattered space and delve into the current domain.
While this occurred, the space where Megalos Beyond and Ynnere had their veil torn also seethed with Matter and Dark Matter.
It meant that at this time.
All three states of Matter converged in one place and began to interact as the moment this occurred; existence began to buzz!
The moment the white sea of Anti-Matter tumbled in.
It was like pouring fire onto an already complex and stable mixture, a terrifying force of complexity beginning to build up as if everything would soon explode!
But at such a time, Noah felt like he was grasping a grandiose weaving as he called out himself.
"Limited Fictional Transcendence..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3564 Osmontian! I
paragraphs: Limited Fictional Transcendence.
He called out such a unique mixture of words and continued.
"States of matter...do not reject each other when my weavings are involved."
HUUM!
The line between fiction and reality was distorted and bent once more.
From Noah's body, a boundless force of multiple Pathways that others could not even imagine spilled out and pressed down onto the crackling mixture of matter that was seething with instability.
And instantly, it began to settle down.
The deluge of shattered Pantheons and Omniverses was akin to a thick sea that mixed with a heavy white sea of Nihilos.
No sparks.
No rejection.
Under the intervention of the Protagonist, what was real and fiction was bent over and utterly shredded. As he stated with his involvement, these states of Matter did not reject each other!
It was a unique sensation of power that felt more like he was brute forcing his weavings to change things to how he would like them.
As if he was a unique existence living in a dimension that he could consider half real and half false.
Half real, and half fiction.
And if he could easily distort what was fiction and what was real...
He clutched his chest as he arrived here, feeling immense pain as stellar gold tears began to flow from his eyes.
Pain!
As he felt this tremendous pain, his Pathways were silent as they knew why!
They were him.
They knew that instinctively, this whole time, Noah always looked for something exactly like this.
As the Protagonist, to transcend the weavings of what others knew, but he had never taken a step too far as this was still the weavings of existence he was born in!
And he was not alone.
He had family. He had friends.
He had a mother.
He had a son!
And yet at this moment, when his own weavings instituted Limited Fictional Transcendence, he was designating the very complexity of weavings around him as if they were fiction.
As if they were stories unfolding on a paper, and he was reaching a stage where he began to go above them- transcending what was known to be real as he deemed it fiction!
What did this mean for his Family?

When the day came that Limited Fictional Transcendence became Absolute Fictional Transcendence, would he apathetically look at his own son as if he were merely a one dimensional character in a landscape he could freely distort?
As if when he looked at the Infiniverse Megalos and those within it, they were akin to figures moving in a painting that he could easily flip and distort?
Would he consider himself the only one who was not fictitious while everything else could be bent and twisted as it existed in a lesser dimension than him?!
He thought of all of this as his heart ached.
He knew that when he arrived at such a place, no matter how much he tried, he would be unbearably alone.
Unfathomably alone as with all that power, he would not even be capable of looking at others as his peers!
Would he still consider his mother to be his mother?
"Ah..." Tears fell from the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
Tears fell from the 9th Infernal Ruler.
Tears fell from the True Emperor of Quintessence!
As he began attaining a stage he both hoped for and feared, his tears fell as he thought of the future! Pain coursed through him as in the next moment.
|Quintessence emerges and cradles its veil around the fold of your weavings.|
|Quintessence pulls upon all currently enacted Pathways to True Sources and begins Severing its own Weavings.|
Quintessence moved.
Rapidly.
Heavily.
Brilliantly.
|The Severed Weavings of Quintessence have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Quintessence has opened.|
|Transcendence of Complexity should not mean leaving and denigrating even that which molded you to be lesser.|
|The Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence looks at your Lineage, Bloodlines, and distinctions as it brings them all together under one banner.|
|The Power of Friendship has been triggered.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence, the True Severed Origin Lineage of Osmont is coming to fruition!|
|A Lineage that leaves no one behind.|
|A Lineage of Osmont that, when it transcends, pulls all those under its banner forward.|
|All Bloodlines and distinctions are grouped under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian!|
Utter incandescence bloomed as a colorless brilliance erupted.
Not a Lineage of the Singed.
Not that of a Megalonian, nor Outerversal Morphon, nor anything else!
His own identity that would remain unblemished for ages to come.
A lineage based purely on him as it was he was the True Severed Origin Osmontian, as those he was entangled with would follow his Lineage! His weavings. His Transcendence.
BZZT!
Noah's visage was blanketed by dazzling white waves of Anti-Matter, as well as the stellar dark seas of Matter and Dark Matter.
He stood at the very center while the musings of the Megalos buzzed all around him.
On the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel, the face of a white gold Eudemus looked at all of this with utter adoration and stupefaction.
He saw Matter.
He saw Dark Matter.
He saw Anti-Matter!
And it was all...coexisting so easily as if there was never a problem!
A problem that others could not solve no matter what.
At the end of the day, the answer was to simply seek complexity until one arrived at a point where they could just...tell the problem that it did not exist.
Old Man Eudemus had no words as his remnant will only stare!
A colorless brilliance of utter wonder spread out, everything being forced to attain a profound level of calm as the pain within the...True Severed Origin Osmontian slowly faded.
He saw things unbearably clearly.

He felt his Atlas of Existence that at this moment began to change, getting ready to accept another Source. He felt his connection to the Infiniverse Megalos and those within it whom his heart felt pained for.
And he disappeared right after!

"Ah..." Tears fell from the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
Tears fell from the 9th Infernal Ruler.
Tears fell from the True Emperor of Quintessence!
As he began attaining a stage he both hoped for and feared, his tears fell as he thought of the future!
Pain coursed through him as in the next moment.
|Quintessence emerges and cradles its veil around the fold of your weavings.|
|Quintessence pulls upon all currently enacted Pathways to True Sources and begins Severing its own Weavings.|
Quintessence moved.
Rapidly.
Heavily.
Brilliantly.
|The Severed Weavings of Quintessence have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Quintessence has opened.|
|Transcendence of Complexity should not mean leaving and denigrating even that which molded you to be lesser.|
|The Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence looks at your Lineage, Bloodlines, and distinctions as it brings them all together under one banner.|
|The Power of Friendship has been triggered.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence, the True Severed Origin Lineage of Osmont is coming to fruition!|
|A Lineage that leaves no one behind.|
|A Lineage of Osmont that, when it transcends, pulls all those under its banner forward.|
|All Bloodlines and distinctions are grouped under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian!|
Utter incandescence bloomed as a colorless brilliance erupted.
Not a Lineage of the Singed.
Not that of a Megalonian, nor Outerversal Morphon, nor anything else!
His own identity that would remain unblemished for ages to come.
A lineage based purely on him as it was he was the True Severed Origin Osmontian, as those he was entangled with would follow his Lineage!
His weavings.
His Transcendence.
BZZT!
Noah's visage was blanketed by dazzling white waves of Anti-Matter, as well as the stellar dark seas of Matter and Dark Matter.
He stood at the very center while the musings of the Megalos buzzed all around him.
On the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel, the face of a white gold Eudemus looked at all of this with utter adoration and stupefaction.
He saw Matter.
He saw Dark Matter.
He saw Anti-Matter!
And it was all...coexisting so easily as if there was never a problem!
A problem that others could not solve no matter what.
At the end of the day, the answer was to simply seek complexity until one arrived at a point where they could just...tell the problem that it did not exist.
Old Man Eudemus had no words as his remnant will only stare!
A colorless brilliance of utter wonder spread out, everything being forced to attain a profound level of calm as the pain within the...True Severed Origin Osmontian slowly faded.
He saw things unbearably clearly.
He felt his Atlas of Existence that at this moment began to change, getting ready to accept another Source.
He felt his connection to the Infiniverse Megalos and those within it whom his heart felt pained for.
And he disappeared right after!

chapters.title: Chapter 3565 Osmontian! II
paragraphs: Noah's body disappeared from the point where all three states of matter were mixing as where he went was unknown. This was just one of his bodies as he currently had multiple parts of himself stretched out in different places.
In the Infiniverse Megalos, he had his Main Body that appeared outside of a Pantheonic Haven of Dreams.
Its radiance was so close as inside of it were all of his people, with Noah needing just 9 steps to have arrived into this domain!
9 steps.

His body was brightly shining with a colorless gold transcendental allure as the aurora of gold wings stretched out behind him, unique runic tattoos swirling on his skin as his visage looked utterly daunting!
His complexity seemed full and filled with a much more clearer identity, and how could it not be so when at this moment, he finally, truly, and completely enacted his own Lineage?
Not that of others he obtained through some entanglement.
But a Lineage based on all of his Qualities. All his distinctions. All currently obtained bloodlines!
The True Severed Origin Osmontian Lineags!
This bubbled inside of him to form a singular domineering wonder as at this moment, he took the first of the nine steps.
And...
|Under the guidance of Quintessence, the selection of a second has been selected.|

|The passage of a second may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a guided, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of the glorious Bloodline of the True Severed Origin Osmontian!|
|The Severed Weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surges across Severings and heads towards its Final Severed State!|
After he took the first step, his very blood bubbled with white gold flames as his heart- his unfathomably radiant heart released seas of complexity to sever it again and again.
All parts of him were to be severed.
Every single part, as his Lineage was not an exception.
With every severing, he felt his blood get thicker. With every severing, he felt his weavings become more incandescent!
He took another step.
|The Severed Weavings of the Lineage of the True Severed Origin Osmontian have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of the True Severed Origin Osmontian has opened.|
A Pathway leading to himself.
A true source of who he was!
Osmontian.

What did it mean to be Osmontian? He took multiple steps as he was ever closer to the Pantheonic Haven of Dreams before him, coming to stop right outside of it before in the next moment, he took the final step.
WAA!
Space distorted as he reappeared within, his visage floating above an expanse of stellar gold clouds swirling with tendrils of sand.

Cloudy mountain dunes could be seen in the distance as where he appeared, the figures of his family, friends, and acquaintances were all standing atop the golden clouds mixing in with each other, many not knowing why this gathering was called.
At the forefront, Henry sat down on an elevated portion of the sandy cloud as his face was filled with complex emotions.
He felt stifled, useless, lucky, and graced with everything all at once as he thought about his father.
His father who seemed to be carrying every single thing on his shoulders!
He only just thought of him when in the next moment, his head raised up to see exactly this man appear above them.
Conversations died down as many eyes rose up.
Henry looked up and saw his father as ever so briefly; he saw a cold, callous light within his eyes as if he was a distant, ancient being whose eyes were simply observing the scenery.
As if his vision saw the golden sandy clouds and those standing on it as one and the same- just a scenery!
As if observing grass or trees- or groups of animals tending to their basal needs.
It was a light of transcendental wonder that viewed everything far below it, and Henry's heart shuddered when he saw such a light in his father's eyes!
But...it disappeared just as quickly as it appeared, with Henry even wondering if he was only seeing a mirage as his father's eyes now carried the same regal tyranny they always held.
He looked towards them with a light of brilliance before his eyes came to lock onto Henry, and his voice rang out.
"We have gone through many things together as even at this moment, existence continues to be endlessly complex, with new wonders and challenges rising constantly."
His voice was heavy and magnetic.
Barbatos, Adelaide, Athena, and many others became somber at his words as he raised his hands while continuing.

"Our roots, where we stem from, and who we are will always be the most paramount in all of these musings of complexity of existence. Who I am. Who you are. And from this day on, I am the True Severed Origin Osmontian, and those of you who have stood by me...are Osmontians as well."
WAA!
As he spoke.
He began to unlock and release the boons that he kept at bay.
The thick, heavy, and unfathomably complex weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian flowed from him as he looked at his Son.
"My Son, do you know what makes one an Osmontian?"
What made him who he was?
The values that led him to where he was were many, but there were core driving forces that made many things happen.
Henry received this question while feeling something beginning to burn within the depths of his body, but he did not find it possible to answer!
So his father continued while the wings behind him released waves of heavy radiance.
"At its base, to be an Osmontian is to have an insatiable, endless need for complexity. For advancement. And everything around you...falls in line to help you achieve this."

chapters.title: Chapter 3566 Osmontian! III
paragraphs: What did it mean to be an Osmontian?
The True Severed Origin Osmontian stated that it was to have an insatiable, endless need for complexity!
His eyes swirled with incandescent cerulean radiance that remained on his son as he continued.

"To be Osmontian is to have such a need for Complexity...while also relishing in all the wonders complexity has to offer. To both seek and enjoy complexity, one needs to have a necessary edge over complexity as every Osmontian...has capabilities that others only dream of."
Gradually, his voice began to fill with authority.
And the next words he spoke were those filled with authority, with prompts appearing in front of the eyes of all those here.
|Weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian are awakening within the depths of your complexity.|
|At birth, an Osmontian naturally attains the State of Existence demarcated as the Eye of Existence.|
The voice filled with an inviolable authority echoed out as the moment it did so.
Above Henry, incandescent white gold radiance bloomed as an illusory eye of tremendous regality bloomed and came to fruition.
His figure was elevated in the air gloriously as a vibrant complexity erupted from him, and he was not the only one!

Above Adelaide. Above Athena. Above Barbatos. Above Dr. Hall. The Progenitor of Steel. The Bard of Quintessence. Erikson. Every single entity experienced an eruption of complexity as their dazzling Eye of Existence bloomed!

|Every Osmontian has unlimited potential, as well as a nonexistent ceiling for growth. They are innately born with Invictus Osmontian Wings to allow them to study and distort Causality, and their hearts burn with a Limited Heart of Infinity.|
BOOM!
Glorious auroras of Wings erupted from every single entity here, alongside the eruption of booming heartbeats as if ancient drums were waking up!
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Heavy, complex drums that were akin to a wake up call that even made the surrounding Pantheonic Haven seethe!

Weavings of interminable strength coursed through every single entity here as Noah looked at all of them while continuing. |The path walked by every Osmontian in a True Path. One requiring cycles of Severings that dictate a tremendous amount of resources. But through the True Severed Origin Osmontian, a taste of a Pathway to a True Source will be granted to every single Osmontian for them to utilize the power and understand just what is required for their own severings.|

|Enacted under the banner of the Pathways to the True Sources of the Protagonist, Quintessence, Infinity, Plot, and Cheats, the Osmontian Constellation Pathway System is now available, allowing every single Osmontian to select and be capable of expressing the Complexity of a single Pathway under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian. The cost of all these weavings shall be covered by the Heart of Infinity under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian.|
HUUUM!
The moment such a declaration echoed out.

The Pathway of Quintessence radiated a profound colorless radiance as after the enactment of the True Severed Origin Osmontian Lineage, the brilliance of Cheats, Plot, Infinity, and the Protagonist were used to enact...the Osmontian Constellation Pathway System.
Above the cloudy sand dunes, dazzling roads bloomed as they were heartshakingly vast and complex, with their end currently unknown!
There was a path bathed in flames, radiating white-gold waves of heat and resplendence as countless ancient runes of existence made it up.
It was the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed!
There was a path radiating multiple colors, showing trillions of Megalos stacked together to form the Pathway to the True Source of the Megalos!
There was a golden path radiating pristine and untold glory- glory of being the center of one's fable as within it, there were countless possibilities.
It was the Pathway to the True Source of the Protagonist.
There was a path lined with stellar obsidian majesty, its Regnum and dignity being far too high as it was the Pathway to the True Source of Outerversal!
Multiple roads bloomed.
Multiple Pathways for those of the Osmontian Lineage!
With their Eyes of Existence just now opening, Henry and all other newly born Osmontians looked at these paths with wonder as they felt a gravitational pull to them.
Noah looked at all of this with ease blooming in his heart as this was his solution.
So that one day, he may never look at his own son and feel like he was looking at a lesser dimensional creature as if a human looked at an ant.
So that those of the Infiniverse Megalos would never be looked at and observed as if they were mere figures inside of a painting- never capable of doing anything else but exist!
He would elevate them towards where he was.
He would pull them towards his own standing as it would never be him looking down on his people- but all of them...looking down at the myriad wonders of existence.
With white gold wings blaring behind him, Henry was the first to rise up as his eyes looked around at the many paths.
Gradually, they came to lock onto two as his weavings of Destiny pulled him towards these, and ultimately...
The wings behind him naturally flapped as he appeared in front of the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed.
HUUM!

White gold flames bathed his figure the moment he stepped foot on this path- the road of flames lighting up brilliantly as in the ensuing seconds, the aura of Henry Osmont exceeded any possible Ordinance, tumbled over Existence Severing, ripped across the musings of a Pioneer, and began radiating a terrifying glow of complexity and power that others would only ever associate with a Source!
Him- who had not even come close to Severing his own Existence!

At this moment, he radiated a level of complexity that would convince others that he had a Source, when truly...all he held was the authority to express the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian.
And the Origin Osmontian looked at all of this as he continued to speak.

|In the wonders of weavings of Complexity, there are countless variations of existence following their own stable weavings as at this moment, forces seek to destabilize these weavings across Frequencies of Existence. Choose a Pathway. Obtain its power. And then...express such a power as the first feat of Osmontians...will be to witness and experience weavings across the frequencies of the Wheel of Existence.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3567 Osmontian! IV
paragraphs: The first feat of Osmontians was to witness and experience weavings across the frequencies of the Wheel of Existence!

The True Severed Origin Osmontian uttered such words as his son stepped off the path while burning with white gold flames, others taking his lead and following as they began to choose their own paths.
Each time they selected a path, Noah felt his Heart of Infinity glow brightly as it paid the terrific cost that allowed every single entity to erupt with Complexity equivalent to a Source.
Just his Pathway alone...could rival Source Complexity!
And now, all of his people would be capable of expressing it as he planned to send them across frequencies- Clones of their bodies anyway.
They could aid in collapsing the weavings of the Faceless Lifeforms and at least act as a deterrent so that the many Frequencies out there did not fall under the banner of the Faceless Lifeforms!

One by one, his people took on profound paths of brilliance as among them, the Bard of Quintessence howled before gorgeous waves of incandescence exploded around him, a set of drums blooming by his side as beside his howl, a glorious beat began to echo out across the Pantheonic Haven of Dreams. Around the same time. Away from the Infiniverse Megalos.
In a region of white radiance gorgeously wrapping around absolutely everything.

Noah was within such a region of dense white brilliance as he raised his hand to feel everything around him- the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel in his hands as he watched all gray fractured lines being scorched and disappearing across the Megalos Nihilos!
As of this moment, All three Megalos were free of the effects of the Change as they could never allow any other weavings of existence to settle here apart from their own.
All that was left was the erasure of the remaining Faceless Lifeforms, the clearance of the Expanse, and this Frequency would be free!
But alongside all of this...
"O Anti-Matter..."
Noah spoke grandly to the weavings of another state of matter around him.
He had seen many entities with Anti-Matter flowing through them, even studying them closely or obtaining their Source Pearls!
And yet, at the time, none of it was compatible for him until now.

At this time, after putting together all those weavings of study, and the terrifying capabilities of the Aspects of the Pathways he had just opened up...he could easily take on and emulate any of the paths he had seen on others as another Source of his!
But after declaring that he would be nobody's instrument, and even declaring his own Lineage...he felt the need to design his own Anti-Matter Source of Complexity from what he knew of others.
And so...
HUUM!
The white gold Spoke in his hands span with a sense of awe and glory, beginning to take in all weavings of Anti-Matter nearby into its small point.
After that, Noah turned the Spoke towards his own body as it miniaturized in size- to the extent that it looked like a Pen whose tip was filled with a convergence of Anti-Matter!
Noah then took such a pen as he began to write onto his Atlas of Existence.
On yet another Mundi of Power as he designed...his own System of Anti-Matter!
Musings of multiple paths surrounded him as after this, he would hold all states of Matter in his weavings!
And a witness to this...
Was the fevered visage of Old Man Eudemus who was inscribed on the side of the Pen- on the Spoke of the Wheel, and he watched in real-time as a grandiose weaving of Anti-Matter bloomed.
And as it began.
Noah asked himself.
Who seemed to have the most unique weavings of Anti-Matter that he had come across?

His eyes flashed brilliantly as he thought of another body of his that was at this moment arriving inside another Frequency entirely- a Frequency isolated from many that this being used to hide a part of himself if anything were to happen!
Bob.
Bob!
Noah thought of this being as his thoughts moved, connecting with the entanglement between him and Mysara as he sent his thoughts towards her.
Mysara was currently standing over a Pantheon that already had a Dark Tower enacted, and yet it was crumbling while dozens of Faceless Lifeforms were cut up and burning from incandescent blue flames.
At such a time, Mysara almost stumbled out of the skies as she heard Noah's voice as if he were beside her.
|What do you know regarding the weavings of Bob?|
The bald entity.
The one that the local forces of the Wheelomachy took care of first before they began to make a move!
Mysara was acting as a Watcher of the Wheelomachy within this same frequency as she would know a great deal more.
Her voice was clear yet quizzical as to why this was being asked right now, but she replied regardless.

"He is a unique being with a powerful Source that was approaching that of a Prime Source Complexity. He is a little on the wild side with his actions unpredictable and sometimes intervening in things that he should not intervene in. He, along with the Omnifather, were among the few who reached out to coordinate and work with the Singed, but the Late Prime Source Ezekiel, who has just perished, denied their collaboration or entry among the forces of the Singed, saying that some weavings are simply not destined for certain flows of the wheel. It's always the more eccentric entities that can, at times, be placed at bay due to their nature. But my assessment of him would be that of...a lost Complexity constantly searching for something he was never able to find. And it is why he intervened in cases where he shouldn't as he tried to change the fates of others to be different than what they were set out to be."
An assessment of Bob was given as through the entanglement, Noah nodded.
Because at this time, his weavings that had been crossing the folds of the flow of the wheel finally arrived inside a unique frequency!

sentences.text: The first feat of Osmontians was to witness and experience weavings across the frequencies of the Wheel of Existence!

The True Severed Origin Osmontian uttered such words as his son stepped off the path while burning with white gold flames, others taking his lead and following as they began to choose their own paths.
Each time they selected a path, Noah felt his Heart of Infinity glow brightly as it paid the terrific cost that allowed every single entity to erupt with Complexity equivalent to a Source.
Just his Pathway alone...could rival Source Complexity!
And now, all of his people would be capable of expressing it as he planned to send them across frequencies- Clones of their bodies anyway.
They could aid in collapsing the weavings of the Faceless Lifeforms and at least act as a deterrent so that the many Frequencies out there did not fall under the banner of the Faceless Lifeforms!

One by one, his people took on profound paths of brilliance as among them, the Bard of Quintessence howled before gorgeous waves of incandescence exploded around him, a set of drums blooming by his side as beside his howl, a glorious beat began to echo out across the Pantheonic Haven of Dreams.
Around the same time.
Away from the Infiniverse Megalos.
In a region of white radiance gorgeously wrapping around absolutely everything.

Noah was within such a region of dense white brilliance as he raised his hand to feel everything around him- the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel in his hands as he watched all gray fractured lines being scorched and disappearing across the Megalos Nihilos!
As of this moment, All three Megalos were free of the effects of the Change as they could never allow any other weavings of existence to settle here apart from their own.
All that was left was the erasure of the remaining Faceless Lifeforms, the clearance of the Expanse, and this Frequency would be free!
But alongside all of this...
"O Anti-Matter..."
Noah spoke grandly to the weavings of another state of matter around him.
He had seen many entities with Anti-Matter flowing through them, even studying them closely or obtaining their Source Pearls!
And yet, at the time, none of it was compatible for him until now.

At this time, after putting together all those weavings of study, and the terrifying capabilities of the Aspects of the Pathways he had just opened up...he could easily take on and emulate any of the paths he had seen on others as another Source of his!
But after declaring that he would be nobody's instrument, and even declaring his own Lineage...he felt the need to design his own Anti-Matter Source of Complexity from what he knew of others.
And so...
HUUM!
The white gold Spoke in his hands span with a sense of awe and glory, beginning to take in all weavings of Anti-Matter nearby into its small point.
After that, Noah turned the Spoke towards his own body as it miniaturized in size- to the extent that it looked like a Pen whose tip was filled with a convergence of Anti-Matter!
Noah then took such a pen as he began to write onto his Atlas of Existence.
On yet another Mundi of Power as he designed...his own System of Anti-Matter!
Musings of multiple paths surrounded him as after this, he would hold all states of Matter in his weavings!
And a witness to this...
Was the fevered visage of Old Man Eudemus who was inscribed on the side of the Pen- on the Spoke of the Wheel, and he watched in real-time as a grandiose weaving of Anti-Matter bloomed.
And as it began.
Noah asked himself.
Who seemed to have the most unique weavings of Anti-Matter that he had come across?

His eyes flashed brilliantly as he thought of another body of his that was at this moment arriving inside another Frequency entirely- a Frequency isolated from many that this being used to hide a part of himself if anything were to happen!
Bob.
Bob!
Noah thought of this being as his thoughts moved, connecting with the entanglement between him and Mysara as he sent his thoughts towards her.
Mysara was currently standing over a Pantheon that already had a Dark Tower enacted, and yet it was crumbling while dozens of Faceless Lifeforms were cut up and burning from incandescent blue flames.
At such a time, Mysara almost stumbled out of the skies as she heard Noah's voice as if he were beside her.
|What do you know regarding the weavings of Bob?|
The bald entity.
The one that the local forces of the Wheelomachy took care of first before they began to make a move!
Mysara was acting as a Watcher of the Wheelomachy within this same frequency as she would know a great deal more.
Her voice was clear yet quizzical as to why this was being asked right now, but she replied regardless.
"He is a unique being with a powerful Source that was approaching that of a Prime Source Complexity.
He is a little on the wild side with his actions unpredictable and sometimes intervening in things that he should not intervene in.

He, along with the Omnifather, were among the few who reached out to coordinate and work with the Singed, but the Late Prime Source Ezekiel, who has just perished, denied their collaboration or entry among the forces of the Singed, saying that some weavings are simply not destined for certain flows of the wheel.
It's always the more eccentric entities that can, at times, be placed at bay due to their nature.
But my assessment of him would be that of...a lost Complexity constantly searching for something he was never able to find.
And it is why he intervened in cases where he shouldn't as he tried to change the fates of others to be different than what they were set out to be."
An assessment of Bob was given as through the entanglement, Noah nodded.
Because at this time, his weavings that had been crossing the folds of the flow of the wheel finally arrived inside a unique frequency!

chapters.title: Chapter 3568 What could have been I
paragraphs: Each frequency held its own unique weaving of existence.
The first frequency apart from his own that Noah arrived in was a unique one as his arrival point...was in the Expanse.
And yet here, one could see shattered strings of existence that had lost all color.
Shattered.
Quite literally cut in half as if they had received a horrific impact that decimated all of them throughout the expanse at once!
Everything was filled with a sensation of death and that of the end, with Noah seeing storms of Anti-Matter, Matter, and Dark Matter raging in separate directions.
As if they had no musings or purpose- with them having constantly been crashing against each other for eons.
In the distance, Noah saw massive shattered Blancverses, and as he began to fly across these cataclysmic weavings of a frequency, he even saw fractured Megalos Mountains!
By all means, this looked to be a frequency devoid of any life and weavings.
Very likely, even the Megalos Beyond, Ynnere, and Nihilos of this Frequency were decimated with absolutely no life within them!
It was a unique selection of a place to hide one's weavings as truly, there may be no others to ever disrupt one here.

Noah looked around as he thought about the countless lives lost in such a frequency, and his eyes turned towards a certain location as he turned into a streak of light that shot out past the decimation.

In a short period of time, he arrived before typhoons of Matter and Anti-Matter as at the very center of these terrifying storms, what looked like an embryo floated silently while withstanding all the storms- even pulling them into its body every passing second!
Inside this embryo, the weavings of Bob could be felt as if he was in a state of deep sleep that he would never wake from unless...a complexity prompted him out of it.

Noah looked at the embryo calmly before his finger struck out, releasing a heavy pressure that popped it as what lay within was about to be swept up into a storm of Matter and Anti-Matter when suddenly, everything calmed.
From the embryo, a small humanoid body with limbs that looked like tentacles slowly buzzed as its complexity began to awaken.
The skin was silver white, with the head being utterly bald and free of hair as, at this time, its eyes fluttered open!
Its voice was dry as if it had not spoken in forever, a white robe covering its body as it looked around with an expression of annoyance.
"Who woke me u...ah!"
As if droves of memories smashed down like waves, his singularities for eyes squinted while he frowned, eventually coming to refocus as they raised to see Noah.
Gradually, the singularities gained clarity as they were both happy and frustrated at the same time.
"You were successful in getting here, but things still look rather drastic, young friend."
One of the few that Bob had become entangled with across frequencies.

As of now, this entanglement seemed to be the one that saved him as Noah neared Bob, who seemed unbearably weak- with this body of his only emanating waves of the complexity of a Constellation and not a Source!
"What is this?"
He spoke while referring to Bob's body.

"Mmm, I had to cut off a part of myself to put here and make sure it was entirely free of influence from my main self. As if we were different weavings entirely. And I then hid it into my worst failure...this Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis!"
A Dead Prime Frequency!
Bob looked around him with immense pain coursing through his eyes!

"For other people, failure only leads to a mistake of money or failed relationships. For people like us...failure means entire Frequencies are decimated as you get to be at fault for Megalocides! How unfair is this?!"
His musings were chaotic as he spoke, his singularities pulsing as he continued.

"But here, weavings are cut off. So I hid a part of myself here in case anything were to occur, and those fuckers mad things occur. The ambush in the Logos of the Wheel...they knew they could not defeat me, so they sent my body to none other than Hell Terra Firma! A place I knew my weavings would always lead me to as there was something there that could be utilized to right many wrongs, but I never went into it because entry would also mean I was stuck there. Even if I find that which many Sources spoke in hushed whispers about, I would never even be able to leave."
He spoke with a sense of regret as Noah raised his brows.
"What lies within Hell Terra Firma that many Sources speak of?"
Bob blinked at such a question while shaking his head.

"A Rumor. A Dream. That in a place where authority does not work, there lies a Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence. It was placed there solely because it was the safest place for such a critical part of the Wheel to be since nobody could use it, nor could it be taken out as no authority could be used. But this Primal Flame of the Wheel could theoretically be used to revitalize Dead Frequencies. Bring back quintillions upon quintillions of what was lost. I say it is a dream as how could one, without any authority, find such a thing within the Purgatory Lands or even bring it out when there is not an ounce of authority to be utilized?"

Noah could not help but smile at such an assertion as his weavings began to study Bob- with Severed Extractor actually having trouble grasping the source of this being as it seemed to be part Matter and part Anti-Matter!
But it would only be a matter of time as he replied calmly.

"If it is Hell Terra Firma, then that makes things relatively easier. Where did your main body land within? If you can describe the surrounding environment, I may be able to find you quickly enough. And then...this Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence can also be searched for if it exists!"
A flame that could revitalize entire Frequencies.
Would the Prime Frequency of Life that had just fallen into the hands of the Faceless Lifeforms be capable of being returned to what it once was?
As Noah thought of this, Bob shook his head incredulously as if the two of them seemed to be on entirely different planes of understanding.
Why was he talking about Hell Terra Firma as if it were his own backyard?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3569 What Could Have Been II
paragraphs: Inside of the terrifying Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis.
What Bob referred to as his worst failure!
Only two beings stood before each other as the one who had just been released from an embryo looked towards Noah and shook his head with calmness.

"I won't ask too much as I know each one of us is entitled to their own complexity and secrets. Since you are here, it means you were able to escape the Purgatory Lands and with the confidence that you speak of in being able to find me..."
Bob closed his eyes before he began to speak of the memories that had been coming back into his body since he woke up.

"The fact that we are in a Dead Frequency of Existence aids me in isolating my own weavings from my other self. Otherwise, I would have also been pulled into the Purgatory Lands with my main body, even though, at this moment, we still share the same thoughts. My main body...is located in an area where throngs of entities relating to Anti-Matter reside in. There are 3 mountainous ravines that rise towards the grey skies on one side and..."
Gradually and accurately, Bob began to describe his current location as Noah sent all of his thoughts to the other him in Hell Terra Firma.

At the same time, he continued to silently study the weavings of Bob's Pathways that he called Khaos when he left behind his Will in Hell Terra Firma! "We have some time to kill as I can't really leave this Dead Prime Frequency yet. I am curious about you, but I know you must be even more curious about me. Ask away."
The bald round head of Bob smiled as Noah stared at the shattered Strings of Existence as he voiced out calmly.

"You have any more accurate knowledge regarding the ones who established their sources eons ago who have now left? Some theorize that they did not leave us and are, in fact, protecting us from a place that we cannot see..."
"Hah, that load of bull?" Bob's tentacled limbs shook as his singularities showed distaste.
One of his limbs wrapped around a shattered string as he spoke with a sense of anger and annoyance.

"After a certain point, Complexity can hit a ceiling. Where no matter what one does, they don't seem capable of exceeding the flow of the Wheel. The fairy tales and rumors like those...the ones who believed them the most were the Singed. When I communicated with them for any proof of this, and even asked for collaboration, they told me our weavings held different paths and that we were not compatible. They would rather believe that at the peak of Complexity, existences would not selfishly choose to sever all Entanglements and seek even higher elevations for themselves. That somehow, they are out there instead selflessly protecting all weavings of existence against unknown threats. That...is not something that I can believe in."
WAA!

"I know the nature of beings. Khaos tells me about the nature of beings. They are selfish. Entitled. Self-serving. No entity would spend eons fighting for others when they can barely fight for themselves. Until I see it for myself, all I know is that those who were brightest among us all made the same decision- to truly sever and leave everything behind. True Severing...that is actually the most curious thing as I believe the severing of existence...needs to be more than what all of us go through."
"Oh?"
Bob began to speak of true severing!
He may not have known what he was truly mentioning as this was what Noah had done- but this entity seemed cognizant to think of this!
As their discussion continued in the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis.
In a far, truly distant weaving.
Within Hell Terra Firma.
BZZT!

Cracks of light echoed throughout a massive Airborne Aircraft Carrier that looked like a huge ship- multiple engines burning tons of fuel per second humming on the bottom of the Carrier as it stayed afloat.
Within it, many Autonomous Androids moved about busily as at the very center, Noah's figure sat on a throne centered around a room filled with multiple screens that showed rows of data.
On his lap, the visage of Barbatos sat as he hummed while keeping her eyes on one screen that showed a scene inside a Settlement.
Noah looked down at her and asked.
"You're not going to meet your father?"
McAllister.
He had sent him into Hell Terra Firma as he was left inside a Settlement without being given any privileges!
He now walked around the Settlement aimlessly while being monitored by Noah's Autonomous Androids.
Barbatos harrumphed on his lap as she replied.
"Hmph, let him enjoy the sensation of helplessness some more. I'll see him later."
Her cute figure restrained her anger, and Noah couldn't help but smile. An instant later, the voice of the Infiniverse rang out across the ship.

"75% of all Satellites have been deployed and are scanning rapidly for any matching topography as described by Bob. They are also scanning for any sources of Heat above or below ground that may be the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence- with three possible matches so far underground as Excavation Teams have been sent to every location to unearth and observe what the sources of Heat may be."
The level of productivity that could be achieved when there was a singular source of power controlling hundreds of thousands was terrifying.

Androids moved with precision while the Satellites that Noah had deployed and only increased in number worked in overdrive to achieve their aims, with their path set to unearth the secrecy of Hell Terra Firma!
To have the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence hidden here, it seemed like it was never meant to be unearthed!
After all, without any usage of authority allowed here, and no way to get out of Hell Terra Firma, this flame would remain veiled forever.
Or, it should have been that way.
But then, there was an Osmontian.
There was the True Severed Origin Osmontian!

chapters.title: Chapter 3570 What Could Have Been III
paragraphs: Within Hell Terra Firma, countless oddities and wonders moved all over.
Near ravines of huge gray mountains where Fungi were sprouting all around.
Clusters of lineages fungal, bacterial, and viral lived in these swathes of regions as some were too small to even be seen by the naked eye.

Under the shade of a Basidiomycota, the silver white bald skin of Bob was looking out into the field of emptiness ahead of him, his eyes calmly simmering with a mixture of emotions that seemed difficult to understand.
Within, there seemed to be untold seas of rage. And at the same time, vibrant waves of compassion. There was tiredness and vibrant endurance, life and exceedingly cold allure of death!
Countless weavings seemed to be swirling within as at the end of it all, Bob sighed.
"Is it all worth it?"
At some point, one had to ask this of themselves.
If what they were doing was worth all the trouble!
As Bob wondered such a thing, the area he was under suddenly had a massive shadow appear above it that obscured everything.
In this land of gray and more gray, what the hell could it be now?
Bob had a look of annoyance permeating everything in his eyes as looked from under the fungi he was under the shade of and saw...
A Satellite.
A vibrant Satellite that actually had multiple lenses that flashed and honed in the moment his figure popped out!
He blinked at such a thing as he looked at it incredulously while it made its descent.
"What the hell is this now?"
Within the Purgatory Lands.
Within Hell Terra Firma, there was actually such a thing?!
He got up while the Satellite made its descent, dust and wind kicking around as it landed in a short period of time while its sleek metallic exterior had a section that opened and released a walkway.
Bob looked at this walkway incredulously while walking towards it, remembering the memories of its other self in the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis as he could not believe it.
He knew there were many special entities like him across these vast frequencies.
But this...this was something else entirely!
He had only given Osmont the topographical markers he could see all around, even describing the life forms around him as he did not expect anything to happen this fast!

But after he entered the massive vessel, he was met with Androids lined up all around as on one of the many big screens, the face of Noah could be seen- a dazzling woman wrapping her arms around his neck as she looked towards Bob with squinting eyes.
On the screen, Noah nodded towards Bob while the Satellite that had picked him up began to rise again.

"Welcome back to civilization. I've already got a few places marked that may hold this so-called Prime Flame of the Wheel. One has already turned out to be a volcanic mountain, and another shows more promise. We will see."
He spoke calmly about such a terrifying possibility as near Bob, Androids carrying platters of meats, drinks, and fruits appeared as Bob held them while shaking his head with genuine surprise.

"Out of all those I became entangled with...I did not think you would be someone with such a unique complexity! In a land where none of us can use even an ounce of authority, I do not even dare ask how you are so freely violating such an undeniable weaving!"

He grabbed red gold apples as his mouth opened like a zipper, throwing everything in while nodding as the Satellite he was on shot into the skies, leaving behind entities burning with silent weavings of Anti-Matter in the distance!
They looked grayer than most, with their weaving seeming dull and lifeless as if they could crumble any second.
On a massive Airborne Aircraft Carrier, Noah watched as they neared an Excavation Site that was emanating terrifying waves of heat.
Already, hundreds of white gold Androids had fallen under the blistering heat, with equipment melting and being replaced in real time as this place held much more promise than the other two!
Currently, it looked like a massive crater was being opened up as the more it was unearthed, the more waves of heat erupted out.
Barbatos looked at this from afar while also keeping her eyes on the screen that showed Bob devouring food crazily.
"Sir Bob...I've heard of the weavings of this Watcher of the Wheelomachy. He is feared across frequencies...how did you get wrapped up with him?"

Her face was full of curiosity as she asked, Noah lifting her off his lap and putting her down as he walked towards the opening doors of the Aircraft Carrier to see the unfolding wonder ahead with his own eyes.
"When I initially arrived in the Expanse."
He remembered the past weavings and how he had obtained a Blancverse and the Hearthraes from Bob, and how everything had led to the current state!

Barbatos nodded her head at this as she then looked down below where after an Armored Carrier shot down beams of Plasma from its turrets in the center of the Crater, dust and sand gushed out as thereafter....the tip of a dazzling silver white flame roared out from underneath!
A heavy, pristine flame.
Noah's eyes shone at such a wonder while Barbatos had careful eyes while looking at it, her voice echoing out.
"For such a thing to be hidden way below Hell Terra Firma...what if it was never meant to be unearthed?"
She said this moreso to herself as Noah smiled while replying.
"Maybe, maybe not. But we will take it for ourselves and determine from there."

As his Complexity increased, along with the opening of Pathways to multiple True Sources, he was grasping a great deal of authority even in Hell Terra Firma as he could almost utilize his full power here!
But even with such power and complexity, the flame ahead felt utterly scorching even from afar.
BZZT!

His eyes became sharp as his body became covered by a brilliant light and divided in two, one becoming aflame with the light of the Singed as it dove from the Carrier and went towards the Crater to try and understand and absorb that terrifying Flame ahead!

chapters.title: Chapter 3571 What Could Have Been IV
paragraphs: As he did this.
HUUM!

The hum of a Satellite arriving could be heard as on the right, a bridge formed between the Satellite and Carrier before connecting- a glass enclosure forming around this bridge as soon after, the figure of Bob holding trays of food in his hands appeared while escorted by Androids, his eyes bright as they looked towards the silver white flame that was just being unearthed!
He entered the Carrier Noah and Barbatos were in, still devouring the food in his hands as he shook his head.

"You are quite possibly the best possible entanglement I could have come across- how the hell did you find something that others only considered a legend after just hearing about it? You're making the Elder Generation here feel a little useless..."
His face held a beaming smile as he looked towards the silver white flame that seemed to have its weavings just now unfolding, even greater concentrations of it lying down beneath!
Noah also let out a slight smile as he turned to welcome Bob, the visage of this unique existence falling in the eyes of his body in Hell Terra Firma as Noah blinked while squinting his eyes.
He saw something.
Bob came beside him calmly while looking out from the Carrier, feeling the heat of the flame ahead as he shook his head with complex weavings!
As if he found something he had been looking for and dreaming of for eons.
Near the throne where Noah used to be, Barbatos was also looking at the flame in the distance when she blinked in confusion as she suddenly felt the floor they were all on begin to sink down!
Up ahead, only Noah and Bob remained floating.
Noah kept his eyes on Bob as he spoke out calmly.
"It must have been hard to go through Hell Terra Firma without an ounce of authority."
He spoke casually.
And Bob, enchanted by the flame in the distance, nodded casually.
"Mmm. For some existences, Hell Terra Firma is even more cruel. Plants do not have a good time here, with their mortality rate being unfathomably high..."
Noah nodded at these words as he sighed right after, looking ahead towards the silver white flame as he spoke.
"Without authority, you should not be able to float right now beside me."

Bob's singularities blinked as he chewed on another apple while looking down, only now noticing the floor underneath them had been lowered far down- their two figures being the only ones floating in the air!
Barbatos looked above her at their figures in confusion and shock as right after, multiple metallic ceilings closed off above her as she could no longer see anything.
Right after, Androids appeared around her- three of them disassembling to form a pod that another placed her in while the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos rang out in her ears!
|We believe that there could be immense possible danger to your life here as we have to relocate.|

The moment such words were uttered, the floor below Barbatos once more opened as the pod she was in sank down right away, leaving the Aircraft Carrier as wings spread out from it while it shot out into the distance!
As far away from here as possible!
Back in the Aircraft Carrier, Noah was looking ahead as Bob chewed on more fruits while nodding in a reply.
"You are right, I should not be able to float without the usage of authority...this is an oversight on my part. Man."
HUUM!
The surroundings became heavy.
The air became thicker.
Complex weavings slowly settled in and clashed!
Noah remained looking ahead at the silver white flame while Bob continued to eat, also turning his head to the flame right after as Noah's voice rang out at this time.

"I have been studying the weavings of your path and source on that body of yours in the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis, and I couldn't easily analyze and grasp the Khaos you told me about before. It told me your complexity must be really high. But then, I looked at your body here, within Hell Terra Firma. The void of authorities here...seems to have loosened up whatever veil was covering your weavings as my analysis became a little bit more clear."
"Yeah?" Bob blinked and nodded at his words as he continued to eat the fruits on the silver plate he held!
"Yeah. I received the same result I had seen once before not too long ago. When I was looking at...Faceless Lifeforms."
BOOM!
The air became turbid with power!
The metal of the Aircraft Carrier creaked and buzzed as it began to vibrate!
The moment Noah's eyes had landed on him, Severed Extractor was able to get a better idea as right away, the prompt of Incompatible Weavings of Existence flashed!
Silence reigned in the surroundings even as the atmosphere became scorching with turbidity.
Noah looked at the distant silver white flames that seemed to be roaring at this time, thinking about countless things before he asked lightly.
"The Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis. You mentioned that it was your biggest failure. How so?"
He seemed to be asking casually as if there were no issues whatsoever.
And Bob also replied casually as if they were simply having a normal conversation!

"That frequency...was the place I initially arrived in. The impact was heavy, and I could not control my complexity too well. It resulted in the instantaneous decimation of all the Megalos and the Expanse within it. It was my biggest failure to date, but I may have to change it now after you."
His singularities were bright.
His bald head shone with dazzling incandescence!
He continued eating more of the fruits remaining on the platter, his chewing sounds echoing out as he continued!

"The Weavings of the Wheel of Existence are too solid. Too pristine. Even if you mask your weavings, it is still impossible to evade everything. To go against the flow of the wheel...is almost an impossibility as you will find random coincidental things piling up until you are exposed. You will find forces rising up against you, nothing going your way, and everything that could go wrong, truly does go wrong. And how could it not when you are mixed within the Flow of the Wheel itself? So my solution...was to go along with the flow."
WAA!
He spoke calmly.
He spoke succinctly!
And he continued.

"I had to block off all parts of myself and become someone else entirely. And see, here comes the most critical part of it all- it is not enough to just become someone else and play a part, you have to genuinely believe it. For the flow of the Wheel of Existence to consider you part of its weavings, you truly and undeniably have to believe it too. Otherwise, complexities would always be able to feel that something is off about your weavings. So I was Bob. I truly and completely am, Bob. I forgot everything else, but part of my weavings still steered me towards my purpose as I was able to step into the Wheelomachy. They also tried to go for the Singed, but somehow, evading the flow seems to be so supremely difficult that they sensed something they couldn't put their finger on, so they simply denied me."
His expression was placid.
All the fruits on the platter were done as thereafter, he began to eat the silver plate itself.
The crunching sound of metal rang out as Bob continued.

"It seems I was desperate as my weavings tried everything. They waded across frequencies and sought to be entangled with unique lifeforms surrounded by a heavy flow of the Wheel. A Gem Master that was somehow always suspicious. A Usurper that tries to devour my weavings. Saviors masked as Calamities. Anything...and then, I became entangled with you."
WAA!
"You."
BOOM!
The Aircraft Carrier they were in had disintegrated.
All around, Armored Carriers and Satellites pointed their weapons in this direction.
Their air was filled with shocking turbidity as Bob finished eating a silver plate while looking at the distant silver white flame!
"You really got the ball rolling after all these years."
Excited for what is to come!

chapters.title: Chapter 3572 Bob! I
paragraphs: Bob clearly uttered that after all these years, Noah was the one who really got things rolling!
The thick air of turbidity in the surroundings became even denser as Noah and Bob continued staring at the distant silver white flame.

"Noah Osmont. What an oddity you were. Back then, my weavings remained fully in line with the flow of the Wheel as I was just entangling myself with another potential entity that was surrounded by a heavy flow. Dealing with those carrying the heavy influence of the flow of the Wheel is extremely difficult- and it was moreso with you than anyone else I became entangled with."
WAA!

"My routine was that even while being in line with the Wheel, I at least monitored those I was entangled with. I wanted to put pieces of myself into the Hearthraes I gave you. Into the Blancverse. And yet the moment I had that thought, my core weavings told me I would instantly have this newly forming entanglement severed as I would be ever further from my goal. How ridiculous was that? I held a powerful Source while you should have been a chickling who only just arrived in the Expanse, so how could you possibly have found out anything? And yet, my senses never lie, so I had to stop."
The Hearthraes! The Blancverse!
Noah's eyes became heavy at this as he thought about what could have been.

"On your end, would it have been intuition? Danger sense? Ankyras of Omniverses who are surrounded by a small flow have this sense. Ankyras of Frequencies surrounded by larger flows of the Wheel have it even keener. Yours...goodness, it was a frustrating one as my weavings had to dance delicately to not set anything off. But I danced. And boy, did you pay off. Sent to the Purgatory Lands not too long after we met- even I was shocked. It seemed too obscenely fast that I questioned just what a tremendous flow of the Wheel swirled around you. And then to meet your other self taking revenge on your behalf as the Change was initiated...man oh man."
Bob had finished chewing on the metal tray as he had nothing else to eat.
His gaze remained on the distant silver white flame as he shook his head.
The flame was roaring and raging as it was fully unearthed down below, more of its structure visible as waves of its heat radiated outwards for miles.

"It was fantastic. And the whole time, even I had no idea. After all, I had to truly and fully be Bob. My weavings had to remain in line. Even as everything was finally moving towards my goal, I still did not know. My weavings were to protect the Wheel. I was a Watcher. A Watcher descended from the First Watcher too! I did my duty. I went against the newly appearing forces as Persephael and the Little Great Sage betrayed Bob, the most influential Watcher. Those poor things had no idea they were helping me all along, even I had no idea. That is, until they sent me to Hell Terra Firma. Where I needed to be all along. Here, in these lands..."
Bob spread out his tentacle like limbs as he breathed in the air of Hell Terra Firma.

"Within this place, I finally began to remember. Oh, and speaking of poor Persephael and the little Great Sage, I cannot sense the shreds of my weavings I placed in poor Persephael. Did you or another part of the flow of the Wheel do her in this quickly? What a poor thing..."

His eyes showed genuine sadness as he spoke of this, but he shook his head right after as at this time, Noah spoke out calmly. "So you were a mastermind behind many things even though you did not know. And your goal?"
WAA!
At such a question, Bob shook his head once more, a look of self-deprecation appearing on him!

"I am no mastermind, I am far too simple...I know that. I mean, can you think of a mastermind who lets it slip by floating when he shouldn't have any authority? No. I...am just a simple creature. But in my simplicity, there is a shred of complexity. And even if I were to tell you right now what I wanted to achieve, you would not understand. We are...different people, you and I. Sometimes, we could be looking at the same thing and yet observe two entirely different viewpoints. You would not understand."
He wouldn't understand.
Noah heard such words as he replied coldly.
"Try me."
BZZT!
Turbidity blazed as a bald round head shook!

"Nah. Well, my immediate goal is clear. What all the bending to the flow of the wheel eventually led me to." Bob stated this as he nudged his head towards the raging silver white flame. The Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence that was hidden in Hell Terra Firma for who knew how long!

"But you are something else. You've had me yapping my mouth this whole time and did not even let me know that you had another body of yours trying to eat up all that flame. That's not something a good friend does."
WU!

The dull air of Hell Terra Firma crackled as in the surroundings, countless Armored Carriers and Satellites converged, seeking to leverage any gaps in the usage of authority as they were pointed towards a single target!

Noah's weavings burned with unbelievable radiance at this moment as his other body was withstanding scorching heat to take the silver-white flame into his Pathway to the True Source of the Singed- the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
He shook his head with a thread of disappointment as he let go of what could have been.
"That is not something a good friend does indeed, but I don't think we can be considered friends."
He spoke words that made the singularities of Bob grow a little bit dimmer.
A smile bloomed from one end of the round face to another as a terrifying sense of unease spread.
"You are the only one I have been this truthful with since I arrived here. You are the closest in these weavings that I have...to a friend."
WU!
"Now."
WU!
"Are you ready, friend?"
WU!
