My weavings were to protect the Wheel.
I was a Watcher.
A Watcher descended from the First Watcher too!
I did my duty.
I went against the newly appearing forces as Persephael and the Little Great Sage betrayed Bob, the most influential Watcher.
Those poor things had no idea they were helping me all along, even I had no idea.
That is, until they sent me to Hell Terra Firma.
Where I needed to be all along.
Here, in these lands..."
Bob spread out his tentacle like limbs as he breathed in the air of Hell Terra Firma.
"Within this place, I finally began to remember.
Oh, and speaking of poor Persephael and the little Great Sage, I cannot sense the shreds of my weavings I placed in poor Persephael.
Did you or another part of the flow of the Wheel do her in this quickly?
What a poor thing..."
His eyes showed genuine sadness as he spoke of this, but he shook his head right after as at this time, Noah spoke out calmly.
"So you were a mastermind behind many things even though you did not know.
And your goal?"
WAA!
At such a question, Bob shook his head once more, a look of self-deprecation appearing on him!
"I am no mastermind, I am far too simple...I know that.
I mean, can you think of a mastermind who lets it slip by floating when he shouldn't have any authority?
No.
I...am just a simple creature.
But in my simplicity, there is a shred of complexity.
And even if I were to tell you right now what I wanted to achieve, you would not understand.
We are...different people, you and I.
Sometimes, we could be looking at the same thing and yet observe two entirely different viewpoints.
You would not understand."
He wouldn't understand.
Noah heard such words as he replied coldly.
"Try me."
BZZT!
Turbidity blazed as a bald round head shook!
"Nah.
Well, my immediate goal is clear.
What all the bending to the flow of the wheel eventually led me to." Bob stated this as he nudged his head towards the raging silver white flame.
The Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence that was hidden in Hell Terra Firma for who knew how long!
"But you are something else.
You've had me yapping my mouth this whole time and did not even let me know that you had another body of yours trying to eat up all that flame.
That's not something a good friend does."
WU!

The dull air of Hell Terra Firma crackled as in the surroundings, countless Armored Carriers and Satellites converged, seeking to leverage any gaps in the usage of authority as they were pointed towards a single target!

Noah's weavings burned with unbelievable radiance at this moment as his other body was withstanding scorching heat to take the silver-white flame into his Pathway to the True Source of the Singed- the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
He shook his head with a thread of disappointment as he let go of what could have been.
"That is not something a good friend does indeed, but I don't think we can be considered friends."
He spoke words that made the singularities of Bob grow a little bit dimmer.
A smile bloomed from one end of the round face to another as a terrifying sense of unease spread.
"You are the only one I have been this truthful with since I arrived here.
You are the closest in these weavings that I have...to a friend."
WU!
"Now."
WU!
"Are you ready, friend?"
WU!

chapters.title: Chapter 3573 Bob! II
paragraphs: The very air burned!
The body of Bob fluctuated with different colors as his skin seemed to be sifting through countless weavings!
"Are you ready, friend?"
He asked.
This whole time as they talked, they stared at the silver white Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence in the distance.
At this time, the two turned to stare at each other, and Noah's eyes pulsed with tyranny as he replied.
"Yeah, I'm ready. Let's go!"
HUUUM!
The turbid air instantly exploded.
Countless turrets and waves of blinding beams of light carrying nuclear waves of power shot out and focused on a single being.
Alongside this, in between them, as Bob's singularities stared at Noah, the serene appearance of 9 Tzar Versepiercers bloomed between them!

Bob's eyes were barely able to capture the infinity symbols of the eyes and the devilish smile of the faces before the Versepiercers exploded, nine terrifying ancient wooden Wheels blooming all around here as Bob was in the direct center of it all.
And yet.
The visage of Bob moved exceedingly fast as his left tentacled limb struck out like a hammer.
A simple motion.
And yet this simple motion seemed to be filled with an unfathomable sense of complexity as it smashed above, and the newly blooming archaic wooden wheels that were about to explode...
CRACK!
Splintered and had cracks coursing through them all instantly before a terrifying force flung them away, their remnant force exploding to blazing flames in the distance!

Bob's body then vibrated like a missile as he shot out towards the Prime Flame of the Wheel, and right in front of him- the dazzling allure of multiple Megalocides bloomed as each one had the support of an Infinitum Engine!
They were wonders of terrifying power as they were bound to repeat again and again, with the already turbid surroundings becoming filled with the musings of Matter and Dark Matter.

Bob's body then vibrated like a missile as he shot out towards the Prime Flame of the Wheel, and right in front of him- the dazzling allure of multiple Megalocides bloomed as each one had the support of an Infinitum Engine!
They were wonders of terrifying power as they were bound to repeat again and again, with the already turbid surroundings becoming filled with the musings of Matter and Dark Matter.
And yet, in the next moment, the circular head of Bob opened up like a zipper- his mouth enlarging gloriously as he proceeded to swallow all of existence ahead of him!
Not the terrifying shattering Megalocides, but all the weavings of existence around him as in the next moment, every area covered by the Megalocides was erased.
His mouth closed just as quickly as it had opened as he continued forging ahead.
All of this happened without the passage of any time.
Not even an instant had passed as all of this occurred!
From behind, Noah's weavings churned as the many Pathways he had opened lit up with indeterminate glory.
True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence burned as this was the most perfect possible adversary- with an unknown level of power coursing through them!
Under True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence, no wall was unscalable for him!
At this moment, the gap between him and Bob was unknown as shockingly, he had lost connection with the Megalocides powered by the Heart of Infinity that Bob had swallowed.
He truly could not sense their eruption anymore as if they had disappeared into weavings where nothing could be expressed!
It was a terrifying enemy.

As True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence stated, such a vast gulf of power may seem unscalable, but whether it be during this battle or the days that follow- his weavings guaranteed that he would overcome this being!
So he bellowed out as at the same time, Limited Fictional Transcendence seethed with glory. "You are BACK where you were before!"
HUUM!
His voice boomed out commandingly as Bob's body instantly began to move in reverse.
He was being sent back to where he was before he picked him up on the Satellite to bring him here!
And yet just as a shocking warping of existence occured, the face of Bob pulsed many times over as he tapped onto his two eyes.
The two singularities.
And in the next moment, they bloomed with shocking splendor as they instantly manifested...a fantastical white and black construct all around.
It was...a wheel.
White and Black.
And yet, it held cracks all around it as it looked old. It looked decimated. It looked dead!
In its center, black flames shone silently.
Bob unleashed such a thing as in the next moment, everything froze.
His body that was moving backwards broke free of the effects of Limited Fictional Transcendence, his figure moving forward even faster while Noah...was frozen in this ancient white and black wheel!
Him.
Frozen?!
|OOOH!|
Colorless radiance bathed him with tremendous tyranny as white gold flames began to burn, the cerulean radiance of Infinity spilling out of him en masse as his figure became of movement once more!
But at this time, Bob had reached the Prime Flame of the Wheel. The Prime Flame of Existence!
He came in contact with it as his body began to draw it in rapidly, his visage radiating a dazzling luster.

On the other side, Noah's body, which was surrounded by the flames of the Singed, had already been absorbing the silver white flame ever since it was unearthed, and now another entity began doing the same thing!

His other body broke free of restraints as around him, dozens of Megalocides began to bloom, his body billowing with radiance as his weavings spread, but remained constricted by the terrifying dead Wheel of Existence!
As Bob absorbed the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, he turned to look at Noah's other body on the other side as he smiled.
"Hey, look at us. Who would've thought that we would be here today, doing this together?"
WAA!

As he spoke, a terrifying power spread from his body and tried to even cut off Noah's body that had absorbed a significant amount of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, but Noah seemed to have formed a shocking symbiosis at this moment as he was unshakable from the silver white flame!
Bob looked at this scene and sighed as his smile continued to be ever radiant.
"Only good friends do things like this together, am I right? Who else would you rather be devouring a critical part that makes the Wheel turn?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3574 Worth! I
paragraphs: Who else would one rather be devouring a critical part that made the Wheel turn?!
Bob asked such a question as Noah looked at this being coldly, his Complexity surging due to True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence as just in the last instant...
[Randomly, the selection of an instant has been selected.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a random, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Entropy|
|The Severed Weavings of Entropy, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surge across Severings and heads towards its Final Severed State!|
This prompt flashed before his eyes in the past instant.
But not just this!
|The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Loot.|
|...randomly declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Runes.|
|...burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of Apocalypse.|
Due to the gulf of power between him and Bob, just in the last instant, he was taking the weavings of Entropy, Loot, Runes, and Apocalypse to their Pathways naturally!
Four new paths...in just an instant!

And Bob was almost able to knock out even his other body set aflame with the musings of the Singed that was absorbing and transferring as much of the raging Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence towards a distant Infiniverse Megalos, but the intensity of Flames that Noah emanated seemed to have undergone a resonance with the raging silver white flame here as at this moment, he was borrowing its power to hold the unfathomable complexity of Bob that actively sought to throw him off.
The reason for this resonance...
|The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed is being traversed in real time.|
In his weavings.
He saw a core part of himself standing at the start of a path.
A road. The path was built purely on white gold flames as at this moment, he began to take small, heavy steps on this Pathway.
The Pathway...to the True Source of the Singed!
After attaining the 81st Severing and obtaining the many Pathways to True Sources, this was the first time that Noah was making progress in walking on any pathway!

It would no doubt require droves of Resources to build up the Pathway and head to the True Source, and yet at this moment...True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence seethed to make this possible purely due to the adversary he faced.
Due to this, his Flames resonated with the Prime Flames.

|On the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, a point of brilliance shines in the distance to aid you in your advancement. This point of brilliance is not what lies at the end of the Pathway, but simply something on the way there.|
HUUM!
On the road he walked on.
Everything was aflame and clear behind him, but ahead...was an endless darkness where nothing could be seen.

Every step he took was a heavy one as sometimes, there would be a dark foothold there that, after he stepped on it, would light up and allow more of the path to form. But sometimes, there would be no foothold.
And if he did not want to fall, a terrifying amount of authority had to be utilized and burnt to lay the next brick of this pathway!
But at such a time, in the distant waves of darkness...a silver white lantern bloomed.
A silver white flame.
The Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
It was not what lay at the end of the Pathway, but simply something on the way there!

But at this moment, it lit up the Pathway to the True Source as Noah was able to see the steps ahead of him now as he walked towards them much faster, his complexity continuing to rise heavily as he did so!
This was the only reason why Bob was not able to shake him off the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence.
Bob.
This entity that caused Noah to feel a level of coldness and rage, and yet he was thankful for his existence as it meant his own complexity would surge up even more.

But his appearance was also a heavy one as he may just be the one that the Prime Source Ezekiel of the Singed was fighting against- the one they warned as the terrible entity who slipped through the cracks!
Someone injured.
Someone not at the prime of their power! One of his bodies was stuck in Hell Terra Firma while another one of his bodies...was with Noah in the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis!
Their weavings were turning the air in that region to be filled with turbidity and wonder as well, with Noah gazing at the calm visage of Bob here as he asked.
"The Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis. Your greatest failure. Do you want to tell me more about that?"
They were at an impasse.

Neither side could win against the fight of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence as Noah knew this was something that would have heavy consequences, but if he could not change anything right now, he could at least learn more about this being!
And as it stood, there was one thing this being loved to do. And that was...

"Ah, why did you have to go and mention my greatest failure again? That...was something that I did not intend to do. On the day that I arrived in the weavings of these flows of existence, I was enraged. I was expectant. I was filled with emotion. The last of my power was fading as being the simple creature that I am; I sought to anchor myself against weavings that were already rejected me. I fought against the flow of the wheel with pure brute force. And the result of it all...was the simultaneous decimation of all the Megalos, Expanse, and everything in between of a whole Frequency."

chapters.title: Chapter 3575 Worth! II
paragraphs: The simultaneous decimation of all the Megalos, Expanse, and everything else inside an entire Frequency!
Simply from a single being fighting back!
Such a thing caused Noah's eyes to turn colder as Bob, who had just finished saying this, had a torn look in his eyes as he shook his head.

"My heart grieved for a whole eon when the weavings of all those I killed returned to me. I feel them all, you know- everyone that I have collapsed the weavings of. Their hopes, their dreams, their loves. Countless dreams and hopes fell on my heart that day as it weighed heavy on me. I didn't have to do what I did. I do not senselessly kill as what need is there for such a thing? Life is so precious, don't you think, Friend? I saw you were hiding an overabundance of life in that Megalos Treasure you were carrying with you."
HUUM!
Noah's eyes lost all shreds of emotion when Bob began talking of the Infiniverse Megalos.

"Oh, a touchy subject on that one, is it. Don't worry. I adore life. I love life as I do not seek to destroy it. I've just been curious about that Megalos Treasure of yours as I've tried to link it to something I know out of the countless weavings of existence, and nothing comes to mind. Someone as old as me has seen many things, but how could I have possibly not seen something like that? I was waiting for you to someone invite me into that home so I could see for myself."

As he said such words, his body buzzed as if it had reached a critical point of its devouring of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, terrifying mouths opening up all over its body in the next moment!
On his tentacled limbs.
On his stomach and chest.
Massive jaws opened before in the next moment, they began releasing a horrific auctioning force that pulled on the silver white flames heavily!
Noah looked at all this coldly as he spoke out.
"I do not take lightly when others mention something like that."
Any interest shown to the Infiniverse Megalos was not good interest.
Nobody should even know of its existence!
But Bob only shook his bald head and smiled lightly.
"As I said, I adore life. No matter what else you may think of me."
He was clear.
And so Noah asked succinctly.
"And how much life will be lost with whatever you are about to do?"
His question caused Bob to blink before he shook his head as if accused of something preposterous!

"No loss of life at all. I am not someone like that. No...I will not repeat what occurred with the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis. Life with still be there, at most...it will just change into a new form of life."
WAA!
A Change.
A new form of life!
But even with these words, Bob seemed to detest them as he shook his head.
"Even that is only an unfortunate consequence as when I think about what has to happen, I sometimes ask myself...is it all worth it?"
His singularities focused on Noah as he seemed to be asking earnestly.
"Do you ever find yourself questioning? Wondering if what you were doing was worth all the trouble? I ask myself this again and again, and do you know the answer I come to every time?"
The air became heavier.
The silver white flame that was roaring and raging this whole time had dwindled to a terrifying extent.
Noah's eyes were pristinely cold as he gazed towards Bob with absolute malice.
He knew the answer this being was about to say as clear as day.

And Bob seemed to know it too as finally, the smile he always had on his face faded away as a terrifyingly heavy and serious expression replaced it- one of interminable determination that would never be stopped no matter what!
With such a heavy expression Bob continued while the last embers of the silver white flames between them faded.
"Every time, without fail...I always have the same answer. It is more than worth it. It has to be more than worth it!"
HUUM!
With a surge of brilliance, a silver white flame entirely faded.
Only two beings remained in a gray land, one having two bodies surrounding the other front and back as the air was so complex that even Lesser Sources would find it hard to walk into!
Bob nodded towards Noah as the jaws all over his body faded, his expression becoming serene as he nodded.
"Till we meet again, Osmont."
WUU!
With a blast of white and black, a heavy burst of complexity cracked down as in the next moment, Bob's figure disappeared from Hell Terra Firma.
Where others could not leave. Where Noah was the only exception!
Bob left as when Noah looked around, all he saw were decimated Satellite and Vessels as his expression remained cold.
A loss.
He felt and knew it as today...was a major loss!
A loss of opportunity. A loss of might. A loss against a being that was much, much more powerful.
A loss that would have severe consequences as Noah had obtained a bit over half of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, and Bob had attained the lesser half!
But he had obtained it.
Now the question was...what would he do with it? With something that kept the Wheel turning?
When Noah thought of everything that he had discussed with Bob, he became increasingly serious as Bob's words revealed the truth of what he planned to do.
He detested the loss of life. But in his warped mindset, Change of life was entirely okay.
He did not plan to destroy the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence.

He planned to...distort and change it into something unfathomably worse as what did a man who always had to evade and go with the flow of the Wheel do now that he had a tool that may be able to dictate the very flow of the Wheel as he saw fit?!

sentences.text: The simultaneous decimation of all the Megalos, Expanse, and everything else inside an entire Frequency!
Simply from a single being fighting back!
Such a thing caused Noah's eyes to turn colder as Bob, who had just finished saying this, had a torn look in his eyes as he shook his head.
"My heart grieved for a whole eon when the weavings of all those I killed returned to me.
I feel them all, you know- everyone that I have collapsed the weavings of.
Their hopes, their dreams, their loves.
Countless dreams and hopes fell on my heart that day as it weighed heavy on me.
I didn't have to do what I did.
I do not senselessly kill as what need is there for such a thing?
Life is so precious, don't you think, Friend?
I saw you were hiding an overabundance of life in that Megalos Treasure you were carrying with you."
HUUM!
Noah's eyes lost all shreds of emotion when Bob began talking of the Infiniverse Megalos.
"Oh, a touchy subject on that one, is it.
Don't worry.
I adore life.
I love life as I do not seek to destroy it.
I've just been curious about that Megalos Treasure of yours as I've tried to link it to something I know out of the countless weavings of existence, and nothing comes to mind.
Someone as old as me has seen many things, but how could I have possibly not seen something like that?
I was waiting for you to someone invite me into that home so I could see for myself."

As he said such words, his body buzzed as if it had reached a critical point of its devouring of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, terrifying mouths opening up all over its body in the next moment!
On his tentacled limbs.
On his stomach and chest.
Massive jaws opened before in the next moment, they began releasing a horrific auctioning force that pulled on the silver white flames heavily!
Noah looked at all this coldly as he spoke out.
"I do not take lightly when others mention something like that."
Any interest shown to the Infiniverse Megalos was not good interest.
Nobody should even know of its existence!
But Bob only shook his bald head and smiled lightly.
"As I said, I adore life.
No matter what else you may think of me."
He was clear.
And so Noah asked succinctly.
"And how much life will be lost with whatever you are about to do?"
His question caused Bob to blink before he shook his head as if accused of something preposterous!
"No loss of life at all.
I am not someone like that.
No...I will not repeat what occurred with the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis.
Life with still be there, at most...it will just change into a new form of life."
WAA!
A Change.
A new form of life!
But even with these words, Bob seemed to detest them as he shook his head.
"Even that is only an unfortunate consequence as when I think about what has to happen, I sometimes ask myself...is it all worth it?"
His singularities focused on Noah as he seemed to be asking earnestly.
"Do you ever find yourself questioning?
Wondering if what you were doing was worth all the trouble?
I ask myself this again and again, and do you know the answer I come to every time?"
The air became heavier.
The silver white flame that was roaring and raging this whole time had dwindled to a terrifying extent.
Noah's eyes were pristinely cold as he gazed towards Bob with absolute malice.
He knew the answer this being was about to say as clear as day.

And Bob seemed to know it too as finally, the smile he always had on his face faded away as a terrifyingly heavy and serious expression replaced it- one of interminable determination that would never be stopped no matter what!
With such a heavy expression Bob continued while the last embers of the silver white flames between them faded.
"Every time, without fail...I always have the same answer.
It is more than worth it.
It has to be more than worth it!"
HUUM!
With a surge of brilliance, a silver white flame entirely faded.
Only two beings remained in a gray land, one having two bodies surrounding the other front and back as the air was so complex that even Lesser Sources would find it hard to walk into!
Bob nodded towards Noah as the jaws all over his body faded, his expression becoming serene as he nodded.
"Till we meet again, Osmont."
WUU!
With a blast of white and black, a heavy burst of complexity cracked down as in the next moment, Bob's figure disappeared from Hell Terra Firma.
Where others could not leave.
Where Noah was the only exception!
Bob left as when Noah looked around, all he saw were decimated Satellite and Vessels as his expression remained cold.
A loss.
He felt and knew it as today...was a major loss!
A loss of opportunity.
A loss of might.
A loss against a being that was much, much more powerful.
A loss that would have severe consequences as Noah had obtained a bit over half of the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence, and Bob had attained the lesser half!
But he had obtained it.
Now the question was...what would he do with it?
With something that kept the Wheel turning?
When Noah thought of everything that he had discussed with Bob, he became increasingly serious as Bob's words revealed the truth of what he planned to do.
He detested the loss of life.
But in his warped mindset, Change of life was entirely okay.
He did not plan to destroy the Prime Flame of the Wheel of Existence.

He planned to...distort and change it into something unfathomably worse as what did a man who always had to evade and go with the flow of the Wheel do now that he had a tool that may be able to dictate the very flow of the Wheel as he saw fit?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3576 Ordo Ab Chao! I
paragraphs: The Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence.
At this time.
Within the Infiniverse Megalos.
HUUUM!

A buzzing even heavier and more radiant than the Osmontians finishing their selection of Pathways was raging as at the core domain where a multicolored throne connected to countless strings, there used to be a white gold Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel.
But at this moment, this wisp burned brightly inside of a raging silver white flame that released constant shockwaves across the Infiniverse Megalos- elevating its complexity at a ridiculous pace!
The figure of the Infiniverse Megalos and Ruination stood before it alongside Noah's main body as they analyzed the weavings of this wonder that Noah snatched over half of.

|The silver white flames have been confirmed to be an even higher complexity of Flames relating to the Wheel of Existence. What was obtained was not a Wisp, but 55% of the Primal Flame of the Wheel that was veiled within Hell Terra Firma.|
The flames were confirmed as Noah looked at them coldly while asking.
"Usage?"
Genuine flames relating to the Wheel.
Not a Wisp or a part, but massive clusters of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence!

|Master has already innately begun their basal usage while in Hell Terra Firma- the Quintessential elevation of Complexity. That was at a more instinctual level. Now that the Flame is here, it has become anchored into me as this accelerated process of Elevation can now be done actively. At the same time, all of the Infiniverse Megalos themselves are benefiting tremendously as...|
HUUM!

A radiant glow erupted as from the countless strings flowing from the multicolored throne, thousands of horizontal strings shimmering silver, white, and gold bloomed around the throne and shot out into the surroundings!
They extended out to be observed past the dazzling Vein of the Infiniverse Megalos and also through its many Pantheonic Havens.
They caused the concentration of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence to become utterly wild as everything became covered by a hazy silver-gold glow!
Around the Pantheonic Havens, incandescent white and gold mountains began to form as they gushed out waves of complexity, alongside the emergence of Infiniverse Primaltrees!
Primaltrees that seethed with brilliance as they already began to bear round silver gold fruits possessing tremendous amounts of pure complexity.
Gradually.
Surely.
Radiant silver gold Strings of Existence that seemed far more solid, firmer, and radiant than those within the Expanse bloomed and wrapped around the Infiniverse Megalos!
All weavings of Existence began becoming enriched by an unfathomable level.

|Strings of Existence filled with millions of Source Runes promoting complexity of Existence are unfolding within the Infiniverse Megalos, Master. All of this remains simply the basal usage of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence as I have begun analyzing how its utilization scales upwards even more. Or how a creature like Bob could potentially use it. It will take some time.|
The voice of the Infiniverse Megalos rang out in Noah's mind as he nodded with understanding while tapping his chest.
"Start the active utilization of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence on elevating the Pathways to the True Sources. Also, ensuring the successful design of the Anti-Matter Source."
On his Atlas of Existence.
In the Seventh Mundi of Power!
Brilliant white incandescence was being written as another body of his was halfway through the design of an Anti-Matter Source that was being etched with a Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence!
A Spoke that...

"Master, I can feel that Spoke calling out to my weavings..." A Spoke that someone was already laying claim to as after she had swallowed multiple Pieces relating to the Wheel, Ruination had a determined gaze as she also looked at the Spoke!
And Noah nodded towards her.
"You shall have it."
WAA!
The future was laying itself out. But the mood was not the happiest as there was still one major thing in the back of their weavings.
As they studied the utterly heavy and massive Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence, there was someone else who seemed to already know a great deal about it and exactly what to do with it!
So just what was he about to do?

Due to such a question hanging over them as they anticipated random changes at any moment, the surging weavings of complexity brought forth by the Primal Flame of the Wheel could not fully be enjoyed as Noah weighed the many gains and losses!
But on his Atlas.

Rivers of Anti-Matter had begun to swirl in carefully and without any weavings of collapse as silent silver white flames stemming from the newly attained Primal Flame of the Wheel looked over their convergence and construction!
After observing Bob, the construct of this new Source Noah was building slowly began to change as he utilized what he studied about this being.
The nihility he portrayed. The chaotic way he moved!
He called his musings those of Khaos.
And they were grand ones as at this moment, Noah took from them and other Sources of Anti-Matter he had understood
In the Mundi of Power.

Clusters of positrons, baryons, and neutrinos all seemed to be swirling and mixing together as weavings that would normally mean annihilation if they met before...did no such thing as the weavings of Limited Fictional Transcendence act like an undeniable barrier.

The distinction of the new Source gradually became clear as at the same time, in another corner of the Infiniverse Megalos, another body of the Infiniverse Megalos and Noah floated together amidst a field of rows and rows of Tzar Versepiercers that needed to be altered!

The Infiniverse Megalos Body grabbed a Tzar Versepiercers that looked like a golden statue of Noah with infinity symbols for his eyes, her hands steadily putting in rivers of Anti-Matter into it as she spoke.

|Matter and Dark Matter were volatile enough, but their reaction was stabilized and became controllable alongside their explosion. But when Anti-Matter interacts with others, it seems to always be in an explosive state as every passing instant, it just explodes, and explodes, and explodes...|

chapters.title: Chapter 3577 Ordo Ab Chao! II
paragraphs: Anti-Matter seemed to always be in a state of chaos and implosion whether one wanted to or not!
When it interacted with others, it was like this was its natural state- to naturally explode!

|The collision of quarks, leptons, baryons, neutrinos, psioneutrinos...is akin to constant explosions of particles and antiparticles that eventually lead to annihilation. Anti-Matter simply makes this annihilation constant. The net result of all of this collision is energy- extremely destructive energy that will even make a Greater Source alarmed. I think...I could use this constant state of explosions and annihilation to allow their destructive force to accumulate inside a Tzar Versepiercer, but still contained. It would mean that every Tzar Versepiercer is constantly exploding, with this energy being contained as it builds up again and again...and again!|
The voice of the Infiniverse Megalos carried a tremor as one could almost feel a sense of excitement in it!
Tzar Versepiercers...that only continued to get more destructive the more time that passed since they were made!
"The only question is how to contain their constant explosions without ruining the integrity of the shell..."
Noah spoke calmly as he looked at the Tzar Versepiercer that the Infiniverse Megalos was playing around with.

The Infiniverse Megalos Body nodded with bright eyes as its weavings buzzed, and in the next moment, her hands stretched up and pulled down as she plucked one of the newly forming Infiniverse Strings of Existence and began wrapping the Tzar Versepiercer with it!
It looked like a statue bound tightly by a silver gold rope, a sense of stability brought to it but...it still was not enough.
After this, the eyes of a frowning Infiniverse Megalos Body lit up as a silver white flame appeared in her hands that then covered the whole Tzar Versepiercer!
It entirely stopped vibrating and became stable.
With this, the eyes of the Infiniverse Megalos Body became bright as she smiled!

|A sliver of the aura of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence. It carries a quality of indestructibility as an aura alone is inexpensive, and will return back to the Primal Flame of the Wheel after I consciously release it. This should theoretically allow the continued explosive interactions within the Tzar Versepiercers without releasing the force within, keeping it accumulated constantly!|
A smooth breakthrough was made by the Infiniverse Megalos as Noah looked at the statue bound by silver gold ropes and covered by the allure of silver white flames.
He felt the weavings of Anti-Matter within them.
The constant state of disorder they were in.
What Bob had stated when he talked about chaos, whether it was true or not.
He stated that his weavings of Khaos were a more ancient form of the disorder where as long as chaos and disorder increased, he became more powerful!
There was always chaos.
Over time, things naturally fell into a chaotic state!
And so...
The distinction of the source of Anti-Matter would be a simple one!
"Ordo Ab Chao..."
HUUM!
In the Megalos Nihilos, Noah's body there that was inscribing his chest with a pen exploded with radiance as seas of Anti-Matter surged into him!
The Source of Ordo Ab Chao!
Words that Noah uttered innately as yes, there was always increasing disorder.
But it was never just this.
There was also order. Periods where chaos subsided and prolonged peace came.
It was a cycle!
Chaos.
Order!
They tugged at each other back and forth as Noah's Source of Ordo Ab Chao...meant Order From Chaos!
|The True Severed Weavings of Ordo Ab Chao are being designed.|
It was now formed rapidly after its distinction as at its conception, it would be severed.
And as it pulsed with white and black radiance...
|Intentionally, the selection of an instant has been selected.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing the intentional significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has intentionally declared the burst of elevation to stem from the forming weavings of Ordo Ab Chao.|
|The Severed Weavings of Ordo Ab Chao, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surge across Severings and heads towards their Final Severed State!|
In Megalos Nihilos, seas of white brilliance surged into Noah to complete the new Source that began undergoing Severings right away.
White and Black.
Pristine.
Gorgeous!
Unfathomably bright!
Within an instant, it was Severed many times over as to date- it was the fastest Severing yet!
It did not take long before his Heart continued pumping dense waves of brilliance that took this singular, newly formed concept and severed it fully. Until...
|The Severed Weavings of Ordo Ab Chao have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Ordo Ab Chao has opened.|
In his Mundi of Power, the white and black came together harmoniously.
Like two moons that clasped onto each other with a profound sense of balance and harmony.
And from them...brilliance of the highest order bloomed as Noah's body became covered by a white light!
|For any given moment of time, your existence will either be in the Cycle of Ordo or the Cycle of Chao.|

|In a Cycle of Ordo, the complexity of your weavings of existence becomes nigh impenetrable as you gain Absolute Infinitum Indestructibility. In exchange, you cannot personally deal any damage to the weavings of other complexities.|

|In a Cycle of Chao, the complexity of your weavings obtains Absolute Infinitum Penetration, allowing the output of your complexity to scale up from 1,000% to 1,000,000%. In exchange, the complexities of others can also damage your weavings by the product of a fourth of the Complexity Scale you attained.|
A fantastical new weaving of complexity bloomed as Noah looked at the blinding white light that covered him which could only mean...
|Your weavings of existence are currently in the Cycle of Ordo.|
His visage was made to be firm.
Akin to a piece of stellar wonder that could not be moved by anything- the weavings of Absolute Infinitum Indestructibility circling throughout his weavings as nothing...could damage him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3578 Defiant! I
paragraphs: Ordo Ab Chao!
A unique new addition to Noah's weavings as the moment they were born, they were severed and elevated to become a Pathway to the True Source!
They came in two parts.
Either a Cycle of Ordo, or a Cycle of Chao!
Currently, he was bathed with an incandescent white brilliance as he was in a state of Ordo, and he did not know when this state would change.
It could be minutes, hours, or days!
But in this state, he was impervious to the weavings of others.
He held Absolute Infinitum Indestructibility!
Even if he faced Bob once again right now, Bob would not be able to hurt his weavings.
Was this not all part of True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence? His power scaling up rapidly and powerfully to catch up to an enemy that he could not even see?
And even this was just half of it.
There was the Cycle of Chao where he would attain Absolute Infinitum Penetration, allowing the output of his complexity to scale up from 1,000% to 1,000,000%.
But in exchange, the complexities of others can also damage his own weavings by the product of a fourth of the Complexity Scale he attained.
For example.

If he was in the Cycles of Chao and released a single attack equivalent to a Greater Source- the complexity, not damage mind you, but the complexity of the output of these weavings could be multiplied by 500,000%!

But in exchange, if there was an enemy Greater Source opposite him, this being would also be able to gain an advantage of a fourth of the Complexity Scale he obtained. Meaning against him, the output of their complexity would be increased by 125,000%.
Basically, The Cycle of Chao was a glass cannon, while the Cycle of Ordo was a tank that could never be moved!

But even in the Cycle of Ordo, where he held Absolute Infinitum Indestructibility but could not damage anyone with his own personal weavings...nothing prevented him from, let's say, throwing an already designed Bomb towards an enemy.
A bomb like the Tzar Versepiercer.
His eyes were sharp as he enjoyed the feeling of the Cycle of Ordo while his weavings churned.
After all, he now contained the weavings of Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter!
His musings were buzzing.
The three states of matter buzzed within him as with every passing second, there was an impact of his three states of Existence that released an outburst of energy!
After all, when they met, there was annihilation. An output of energy.
Within the Tzar Versepiercers, the Infiniverse Megalos contained this explosive energy by binding it with a String of Existence and the aura of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
So what about Noah?
|Your Truly Severed Weavings have attained a state of harmony with all three states of existence.|
|Every passing moment, the three states of existence clash and release a burst of complexity.|
|You have attained the Absolute Infinitum Existentialism!|
HUUM!
His figure continued to emanate profound waves of incandescence as...
DUM!
His heart beat.
DUM!
His heart beat again.
And with every beat of his Heart, he felt his weavings of Existence become that much more complex!
|With your weavings attaining Absolute Infinitum Existentialism, there will be a constant and continual increase of your complexity with every passing moment.|
Constant. Continual!
He did not have to do anything. He could close up shop and go to sleep for the next age to come, and he could wake up unfathomably stronger than he was currently!
But if he did this, he may just wake up to entirely altered weavings of existence as when he arrived at this point, this body of his within the Megalos Nihilos looked up.
And a moment later, he disappeared while still holding the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence in his hands.
It took but a moment before he crossed the layers of existence to instantly arrive...in the Expanse.
The Expanse filled with gaps as Strings of Existence were snapped.
It looked darker and less filled with life, gray cracks still present here as Noah had the visage of Ruination appear beside him.
Her gaze was on the dazzling Spoke in his hands as he threw it towards her, her small hands reaching out while the Spoke itself raged with white gold flames as if it was about to burn her!

But the moment it landed in her hands, these raging flames diminished as if they never existed, and the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence turned docile in the hands of Ruination as if it was just being held by another Piece of the Wheel!
Noah stared at such a scene with bright eyes as he spoke out.
"Erase the fractures within the Expanse. We do not know what Bob may do, but we can at least ensure that this entire frequency of existence is free of the effects of the Change."
WAA!

A fearsome task was designated to Ruination as she nodded with heavy determination, her hands twirling the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence in her hands as if it were a chopstick- its size becoming more and more massive before she stopped its spinning and pushed down.
WU!

Its tip buzzed as circular waves of frequencies began to originate from it and spread out towards the stretches of the Expanse, the gray fractured lines beginning to burn and be scorched out of existence!
From here and outward. Throughout the whole Expanse, all signs of the change would be eradicated as this Frequency in particular would be isolated from any foreign interferences that would come.
And this whole time.

As Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos analyzed just how the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence could be utilized on a large scale, they knew that they would likely find out as a consequence since at this moment...Noah knew the weavings of Bob were not staying still!
Whatever he planned to do...had already begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 3579 Defiant! II
paragraphs: In the Prime Frequency of Life.
Azzurra stared at the vast stretches of Dark Towers occupying the spaces around her, as well as the countless Lifeforms that were no longer Faceless.
They had come out of their veiled suits as many held unique titanic forms that were circular in size- with their bodies looking like wriggling round black masses that floated gloriously!

They had faces with vibrant expressions as currently, a few dozen circular black masses were smiling as they helped each other set up a construct that was the size of a universe with pieces they brought out from the Dark Tower.
A citadel for them like they knew it before.

Such projects were occurring throughout the Prime Frequency of Life, where the weavings of the flow of the Wheel did not affect them anymore, and Azzurra could even see smaller obsidian circular lifeforms moving about in droves as they studied everything with bright eyes.

Many ran around as from their black masses, tentacles erupted out like hands as they spun across space as if to just feel its wonder and safety- as if just the existence of this space was a luxury for them!
Some chased each other as they moved many times faster than light, the bigger blobs that were enacted citadels yelling at them as they caused disruptions all around.
But in the air, there was joy. There was freedom. There was a sense of liberation expressed by countless life forms!

In the distance, she saw Giuseppe surrounded by supremely powerful Sources in the form of black masses, one particular entity retaining their veiled suit with the white bar on its head that was cognizant of Faceless Lifeforms as they discussed things.
At such a time.
HUUM!

A unique weaving that even caused Azzurra to feel a sense of oppression descended on Giuseppe and many of the Lifeforms surrounding him, their eyes quickly lighting up as they looked at each other before they dispersed and began to move!
Giuseppe came to Azzurra with a bright gaze as she asked.
"What is it?"
The descent of heavy weavings she had just felt.
Giuseppe smiled while embracing her figure as he spoke beside her ear.
"We have received a new directive. We must prepare to clear out the last force that still has significant control over the flow of the Wheel of Existence- the Singed!"
His eyes radiated brightness as he said this, Azzurra looking into them as she tried to see the same light she knew again and again.
She thought it was always there, the same as always, but...the more she talked with him. The more she was around him.
She gradually sensed a sense of something that was foreign! Something she did not recognize.
It made her unbearably sad even though she did not show it, doing her best to keep things moving as she asked.

"The one who just sent down those weavings. Who are they, really? If all of us follow him, why does he never show himself or make any of these moves with us? Why won't he move against the Singed himself?"
She asked in a low tone, but Giuseppe let go of her while his eyes came to lock on deeply with her, his gaze serious as he shook his head.

"He has never led us to the wrong path, and currently...he is taking time to get back to his old self. Azzurra...the mission has always stayed the same, with me working to make sure that I secure an unshakable future for us. Please, wait for me just a bit more. Once all of it is done, we will have a whole Frequency just for me and you. Just us...forever."

He made a promise once more as Azzurra smiled at him and nodded, his strong hands wrapping around her head as he kissed her before he returned to the group of Lifeforms who began to plan while getting ready for something grand!

She looked at all this and stared at countless Lifeforms moving all around her once more as the more she looked at how their weavings operated, the more foreign it felt as she could not shake a sense of dissonance!
She felt a sense of something she could not shake as in the next moment...
'Huh?'
She blinked as her terrifying complexity felt something cross a vast distance and resonate with her.
It was not harmful to her weavings in any way, but it carried a penetrative light of complexity that seemed to be entangled with her in a unique way!
She became curious about this as she had very few entanglements, so she wanted to see what this one was about as in the next moment, a dazzling Rune flashed in her eyes.
A Rune that was severed many times over as even more recently, a grandiose change had bloomed within it!
The glorious Rune of Amarantos flashed as a part of the weavings of Azzurra found themselves pulled into an entirely new place!
A part of her weavings.

They blinked their eyes and came to as they realized they were in a place filled with white gold clouds, powerful roilings of complexity surging all around as the space above was covered with a hazy silver-gold light.
Azzurra's eyes became cold at this as she looked around while speaking out coldly.
"A dream? Who is so daring as to pull upon an entanglement to dream?"
Her voice was vibrant as it echoed out, not being able to see anyone here at this moment but...a voice echoed out right after!
"You have been looking to end my weavings this whole time but you don't even recognize them when they are next to you? McAllister hyped you up too much."
WAA!
A regal, dominant voice.

Azzurra became stern when she heard it as she turned around amidst the cluster of white gold clouds, her figure seeing a glorious visage of a man sitting down grandly atop a cluster of clouds as he looked down towards her!

His eyes were cold as he pulled upon an entanglement made more solid by many weavings of information taken from McAllister, and a recent eruption of Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity took yet another part of him and opened it up to a shocking Pathway that allowed him to pull upon entanglements...and dream of them!
